rows.title: Commercial Insights Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Commercial Insights Analyst, PermanentAt Costa Coffee, we’re on a mission to reimagine coffee experiences across the globe. From bustling cities to local communities, we’re creating meaningful coffee moments, powered by innovation and driven by purpose.
As a proud part of the Coca-Cola system and working hand in hand with our pioneering partners, we’re in over 50 countries and counting. Whether it's served in-store, from a machine, at home, or on the go, every cup is thoughtfully crafted by our passionate teams who put heart into every moment.
Our teams truly make a difference. Whether it's pioneering new tech for the perfect pour, launching award-winning campaigns, developing exciting new menu items, or supporting our people to grow – together, we stir up success.
This newly created role sits within our Global Revenue Growth Management Centre of Excellence, driving data-led decision-making to unlock value across our global markets. The position plays a pivotal role in strengthening our end-to-end revenue management processes through advanced analytics, smart pricing expertise, and cross-functional collaboration to identify growth and efficiency opportunities. By translating complex data into clear insights and actionable recommendations, the role will help create a continuous improvement cycle that enhances performance, control, and commercial impact worldwide.
We value curiosity, inclusivity, and a problem-solving mindset. If you thrive in a fast-paced, global environment and are excited to make a meaningful impact, we encourage you to apply.
With inspiring experiences, development programmes, and our apprenticeship scheme, your career can grow far beyond the day-to-day.
What you’ll doBeing a Commercial Insights Analyst is about so much more than bringing our coffee to the world. It’s your chance to stir up real success - which means you’ll be:
Driving Global Revenue Management performance. Lead robust analysis to support monthly reviews of proposed business changes, assess performance against agreed KPIs, and ensure delivery against Revenue Management targets through clear, data-driven recommendations.Deliver insightful product and promotional analysis. Evaluate promotional and trial performance versus KPIs, provide clear next-step proposals, and identify scalable opportunities across global markets to optimise NSR and margin.Provide pricing optimisation recommendations. Become a Smart Pricing expert, utilising Costa’s Smart Pricing Tool to work with a range of Global markets, modelling price changes to providing optionality and recommendations through a data-led approach.Enhance pricing, segmentation and margin performance. Monitor internal performance across products, price, promotion and segmentation, using store and SKU-level data, alongside external and competitor data, to identify underperformance, unlock growth opportunities, and achieve margin targets.Strengthen governance, control and cross-functional alignment. Monitor cost price inputs and operational inefficiencies (e.g. over-ordering, bottom-performing stores), partner with Category Managers and cross-functional teams to resolve issues, and present clear, professional insights to drive informed decision-making and continuous improvement.
Who you are:It’s your unique ingredients we’re interested in:Strong commercial and financial acumen, with an understanding of pricing, promotional mechanics, margin, OI, volume, rebates and price elasticity. Experience within retail, category, finance or similar analytical environments advantageous.Advanced Excel-led analytical capability. Highly proficient in Excel as a core tool, with the ability to manipulate and interpret large datasets and present commercial and insight-driven recommendations clearly.Effective communicator and collaborative stakeholder partner. Able to translate data into clear, accessible insights and work cross-functionally with a range of stakeholders, building strong working relationships to support informed decision-making.Organised and process-driven. Structured and detail-oriented, capable of managing multiple priorities, tracking performance and maintaining data accuracy and governance across end-to-end processes.Curious, analytical and solutions-focused mindset. Comfortable navigating complexity, able to juggle large datasets, interrogate what the data is signalling, and proactively identify risks and opportunities
So, why Costa? We didn’t become a global coffee brand by sitting back. When you work here, you join a community that values passion, progression, and integrity—with some brilliant perks to sweeten the deal. We work in a hybrid environment, giving us the flexibility to balance life while still spending meaningful time together and building strong connections:Own a piece of Costa’s success by becoming a share owner in Coca-Cola with our Share Investment Plan (SIP)An annual discretionary bonus scheme, based on business results and individual contribution.A smart pension that saves you money on tax and national insurance, and matches your contributions up to 10%The Costa Financial Support Fund, supporting team members who find themselves in unexpected financial pressure50% discount in all Costa-owned stores, and 25% off in other participating storesPrivate medical cover thanks to our Private Healthcare schemeAnd that’s not all. Explore even more of our perks here: https://bit.ly/costaperks
Location - Where you’ll work:Right now, our Support Centre teams work flexibly, blending home working with in-person time whenever it matters most – whether that’s a team moment, a creative session, or simply coming together to share ideas.
We’re excited to be moving into a new home for our brand in St Albans in January 2027 – an inspiring space from which our Support Centre teams will work three days a week to connect and collaborate in-person to bring our bold ambition to life.
For any reasonable adjustments and general queries, please get in touch with costa.recruitment@costacoffee.com
We believe in living life with heart – and that starts with our people.By showing up as our authentic selves, we create a culture where everyone belongs. We celebrate diversity in all its forms and are committed to building an equitable and inclusive environment—one that embraces the unique blend of experiences, identities, and perspectives each person brings. This rich diversity strengthens our teams and reflects the spirit of our global brand.Grounded in our core values – Disciplined to Deliver, Passion for Progress, Win with Warmth, Courage to Challenge, and Trusted Team Players - we strive to make a meaningful impact in everything we do. From empowering communities through the Costa Foundation to supporting local initiatives, we’re committed to changing lives in coffee-growing regions and right here at home

rows.title: Graduate Data Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
The OpportunityOur client is looking for a Data Analyst who thinks like a researcher: someone who can structure messy problems, build analyses that hold up, and explain them to people who don't speak in code. We care more about how you think than about a specific pedigree, and we especially value people who apply ideas from one field to solve problems in another.
What You'll Be DoingProblem Framing: tackling complex problems with little description or supporting information and shaping them into clear research questions, then finding your own route to a solution.Data Analysis: Working with raw data to identify patterns, build models, and produce analysis that holds up to scrutiny.Cross-Field Application – Bringing methods from one discipline to bear on problems in another, using unexpected tools to solve them.Coding & Tooling – Building and running analysis primarily in Python and SQL.Client Communication – Explaining technical work and findings clearly to non-technical members of clients' teams.Continuous Learning – Picking up new domains and techniques quickly as the work demands, changing from client to client.
What We're Looking ForA STEM background (physics, mathematics, engineering, biology, or chemistry)Experience in applying ideas from scientific fields to tackle problems in other areas, bringing creative insights to the problem-solving process.Research-based experience such as lab internships, research fellowships, publications, or time at research institutions leading research and experimentation.Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, including solving problems without explicit instructionsPython (essential); SQL desirable but not criticalExcellent knowledge of Cryptocurreny, Blockchain and Web 3.0Basic knowledge of data engineering and infrastructure concepts, such as AWS.A solid grasp of core programming concepts; exposure to lower-level languages such as C++, C, or Fortran is a plusExcellent numerical and written communication skills, and confidence presenting to non-technical audiences

rows.title: Analytics Consultant
rows.descriptionText:
Manchester, hybrid

DEPT® is a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, our 4,000+ specialists deliver growth invention services across Brand & Media, Experience, Commerce, CRM, and Technology & Data. We’re 50|50 tech and marketing, partner-led, and first to move. Clients include Google, Lufthansa, Meta, eBay, and OpenAI. We have been certified B Corp and Climate Neutral since 2021.

Job Purpose

At DEPT®, we create platforms and campaigns for our clients that don't just look pretty, but are highly effective. We are looking for an experienced Analytics Consultant to join our team in the Netherlands to bring the best data setups to digital projects and guide clients through the innovating world of Analytics, someone who understands or wants to learn about client-side and server-side setups, have expertise in different Analytics platforms, and possess an interest in Cloud platforms such as BigQuery on Google Cloud Platform.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

You will be joining a highly skilled group comprising Analytics Consultants who work across various different countries in Europe.Your core focus will be a data measurement, collection and processing & activation.Use strategic and technical thinking to help clients define KPIs, execute complex measurement plans, and guide them through the evolving world of data.Advising clients on how to adapt, testing new (Google) features or products, setting up first-party data collection processes, and implementing compliant user consent processing.


What You Bring

At least 2 years of experience in a digital marketing, data, or analytics-related role (preferably at a digital agency).A strong consulting mindset, proactive attitude, and excellent communication skills to host workshops and guide clients.Hands-on experience with Google Analytics and Google Tag ManagerExcellent Dutch language knowledge for the Dutch office


WE OFFER

A flexible, hybrid working policy (2-3 days from the office, depending on location) and the opportunity to work from abroad for 13 weeks a year. 24 vacation days per year and the possibility to buy an unlimited number of extra vacation days.DEPT®/YOU Learning Menu and DEPT®/YOU Special Programs. Develop your skills with courses and programs tailored to your needs.Stay happy and healthy with a contribution to your health through the OpenUp platform, gym and wellness discounts, and healthy lunches at the office.Get a discount on your lease bike and ride in style. You can also enjoy hassle free-commutes with an NS Business Card. A reputation for doing good. DEPT® has been a Certified B Corp® since 2021, has been named a Great Place To Work since 2022 in the Netherlands and named ‘Agency of the Year’ at both The Lovies and The Webby Awards.Awesome clients. Whether big, small, local or global — at DEPT® you’ll get the opportunity to work with all of them. And we celebrate all of our successes together!You can discover even more employee benefits here.


WHY DEPT®?

We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.

We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.

At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.

DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION 

At DEPT®, we take pride in creating an inclusive workplace where everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive. We actively seek to recruit, develop, nurture, and retain talented individuals from diverse backgrounds, with varying skills and perspectives.

Not sure you meet all qualifications? Apply, and let us decide! Research shows that women and members of underrepresented groups tend not to apply for jobs when they think they may not meet every requirement, when in fact they do. We believe in giving everyone a fair chance to shine.

We also encourage you to reach out to us and discuss any reasonable adjustments we can make to support you throughout the recruitment process and your time with us.

Want to know more about our dedication to diversity, equity, and inclusion? Check out our efforts here.

rows.title: Customer Performance Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Join us at Entrust 

At Entrust, we’re shaping the future of identity centric security solutions. From our comprehensive portfolio of solutions to our flexible, global workplace, we empower careers, foster collaboration, and build solutions that help keep the world moving safely. 

  

Get to Know Us 

Headquartered in Minnesota, Entrust is an industry leader in identity-centric security solutions, serving over 150 countries with cutting-edge, scalable technologies. But our secret weapon? Our people. It’s the curiosity, dedication, and innovation that drive our success and help us anticipate the future. 

Help Shape Exceptional Customer Experiences Through Data

At Entrust, we're committed to enabling trusted identities, secure payments, and data protection for organizations worldwide. As a Customer Performance Analyst, you'll play a key role in ensuring our products consistently deliver exceptional performance for our customers.

This is an exciting opportunity for a naturally curious and analytical professional who enjoys solving complex problems, uncovering insights from data, and partnering with cross-functional teams to drive meaningful outcomes. You'll become a trusted advisor on product performance, helping identify trends, resolve customer-impacting issues, and improve the overall customer experience.

What You'll Do

As a Customer Performance Analyst, you'll combine data analytics, customer engagement, and cross-functional collaboration to proactively improve product performance and customer satisfaction.

Customer Support & Performance Insights

Develop a deep understanding of Entrust products and performance metrics.Analyze customer performance data to identify trends, opportunities, and potential risks.Provide evidence-based recommendations to help customers achieve their objectives.Build strong relationships with customers through clear, timely, and empathetic communication.

Data Analysis & Problem Solving

Investigate large and complex datasets to uncover actionable insights.Translate ambiguous problems into structured analyses and meaningful recommendations.Challenge assumptions and proactively identify root causes of unexpected results.Drive investigations through to resolution, ensuring stakeholders are informed throughout.

Product Performance Monitoring

Monitor key product performance indicators and identify emerging issues.Escalate concerns and coordinate with engineering, product, and support teams when required.Help establish best practices for proactive performance management and reporting.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner closely with Support Engineers, Software Engineers, Product Managers, Customer Success Managers, and other stakeholders.Communicate technical findings effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.Act as the central point of coordination for customer-impacting performance issues.

Ownership & Continuous Improvement

Take ownership of investigations from initial problem definition through to resolution.Demonstrate sound judgment regarding when to escalate issues and when to independently drive solutions.Continuously seek opportunities to improve processes, reporting, and customer outcomes.

Required Qualifications

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to derive insights from large datasets.Experience using Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, or similar tools for data analysis and reporting.Excellent written and verbal communication skills.Ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.Comfortable working in both structured and ambiguous environments.Self-motivated with a proactive, "can-do" attitude and a growth mindset.Collaborative team player who thrives in cross-functional environments.Fast learner with a passion for continuous development.

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in a STEM discipline or another field with a strong analytical focus.Experience with Looker or similar business intelligence and analytics platforms.Working knowledge of SQL.Previous experience in a data analytics, business analytics, or performance analysis role.Exposure to technology organizations, particularly working alongside Engineering, Machine Learning, or Product teams.

Why Join Entrust?

At Entrust, you'll have the opportunity to work with industry-leading technologies that help secure identities, payments, and data around the world. You'll be part of a collaborative team where your insights directly influence customer success and product performance.

We believe in empowering our employees through continuous learning, career growth, and meaningful work that makes a global impact.

At Entrust, we don’t just offer jobs – we offer career journeys. Here is what you can expect when you join our team: 

Career Growth: Whether you’re a budding developer or a seasoned expert, we’re invested in your professional journey. With learning-forward initiatives and exciting challenges, your growth is our priority.  Flexibility: Life is all about balance. Whether you’re remote, hybrid, or on-site, we offer flexible options that fit your lifestyle.  Collaboration: Here, your voice matters. Our teams thrive on sharing ideas, brainstorming solutions, and working together to build a better tomorrow.  

We believe in securing identities—but it doesn’t stop there. At Entrust, we’re passionate about valuing all identities. Our culture is built on diversity, inclusion, and respect. From unconscious bias training for our leaders to global affinity groups that connect colleagues across the globe, we’re creating a community where everyone is encouraged to be themselves. 

Ready to Make an Impact? 

If you’re excited by the prospect of innovating, growing your career, and collaborating in a dynamic environment, Entrust is the place for you. Join us in making a difference. Let’s build a more secure world—together. 

  

Apply today! 

For more information, visit www.entrust.com.  Follow us on, LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube

For US Roles, Or Where Applicable

Entrust is an EEO/AA/Disabled/Veterans Employer

For Canadian Roles, Or Where Applicable

Entrust values diversity and inclusion and we are committed to building a diverse workforce with wide perspectives and innovative ideas. We welcome applications from qualified individuals of all backgrounds, and we strive to provide an accessible experience for candidates of all abilities. 

If you require an accommodation, contact accessibility@entrust.com.

rows.title: Graduate Intelligence Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Please read the job description, criteria and application process notes carefully before applying. This role has a fixed start date of 11 January 2027 and is based full-time on-site in Central London. Closing date for applications will be mid October.

About Prevail Partners

Prevail Partners is a leading British intelligence, security and operational support company. We help governments, NGOs and commercial organisations operate safely and effectively in some of the world's most complex environments by combining intelligence, technology and operational expertise. Our teams deliver actionable insight that helps clients manage risk, make informed decisions and achieve meaningful operational impact where it matters most. 

Our shared mission is to deliver unrelenting excellence in everything we do, underpinned by integrity, curiosity, accountability and care.

About The Role

The Graduate Intelligence Analyst Programme is an opportunity for people looking to start their career in intelligence analysis to develop their problem-solving and analytical skills while gaining practical insight into the intelligence field. At Prevail, the Graduate Intelligence Analyst will apply skills developed through study, professional experience, or personal research to help solve complex client problems through structured training and on-the-job learning.

The programme includes an initial three-month training phase with structured lessons, rotations through project teams working on live operations and deliverables, and exposure to supporting functions such as Geospatial and Data. This is followed by a three-month probationary period as a Graduate Intelligence Analyst within one of Prevail's teams, applying training with support from peers, the manager, and a dedicated Mentor Analyst.

Key Responsibilities:

Conduct Open-Source Intelligence (OSINT) collection and analysis to support live client operations. Contribute to intelligence products and reports that inform client decision-making. Support 24/7 monitoring activity by identifying, assessing, and escalating relevant developments. Collaborate with supporting functions, including Geospatial and Data, to enrich analysis and outputs. Present findings clearly and confidently in written reports and verbally to internal teams and, where relevant, clients. Continuously develop analytical tradecraft by incorporating feedback from the Mentor Analyst, manager, peers, and wider team. 

Requirements

Essential Skills and Experience: 

Recent university graduate, or professional actively seeking a career change into intelligence with proven self-study and research in a related field. Understanding of Open-Source Intelligence (OSINT) collection, tools, and analysis. Proactive, curious mindset, with the ability to learn quickly, innovate, contribute fresh ideas, challenge existing processes, and improve workflows. Strong understanding of current affairs, geopolitical trends, and national security issues, with the ability to analyse global events and international relations and assess their relevance to intelligence operations. Able to achieve SC security clearance, including meeting UK residency and vetting requirements. Available to start full-time work on 11 January 2027 and able to commute to and work on-site daily in a Central London office. Willing to join the team's weekend duty rota after completing probation (time off in lieu for weekend hours worked). Strong IT literacy, including the Microsoft Office Suite. Able to handle sensitive information with discretion, professionalism, and respect for confidentiality

Desirable Skills and Experience: 

Foreign language skills, particularly French, Russian, Arabic, or Farsi. Experience with data visualisation tools such as Tableau or Power BI for presenting intelligence findings. Experience analysing large datasets and identifying trends Familiarity in tools such as Excel, SQL, or Python 

About You

We are looking for someone who is intellectually curious, analytical, and motivated by complex problem solving. You will be proactive in building your intelligence tradecraft, open to feedback, and comfortable working in a structured team environment where accuracy, judgement, and discretion are essential.

You will bring:

curiosity, proactivity, and a commitment to continuous learning. clear and confident communication skills, both verbally and in writing. professionalism, discretion, and the ability to work responsibly with sensitive information. 

Application Process 

 Application: Apply with your CV and a cover letter, along with your answers to the accompanying application questions. In your cover letter, tell us about the relevant knowledge you've built, whether through formal study or your own learning, and how it supports your ambitions for a career in intelligence Initial screen: A 30-minute video call with a member of the team. We'll talk about your background, your motivation and your understanding of the role Second stage: A 30-minute video call focused on your skills. We'll talk through how you approach problems, looking at your technical know-how, problem-solving and proactivity Final stage: A one-hour in-person interview, including a practical assessment. You'll be set a task on the day and given 30 minutes to work out your approach, then talk us through it

Benefits

Prevail Partners believes in recognising and rewarding our people. Our benefits package is designed to support your wellbeing, financial security, professional development, and life beyond work.

Our Benefits Package Includes:

AXA Private Medical Insurance: Fully funded private healthcare cover through AXA. Health Shield Cashback Plan: Claim cashback on everyday healthcare costs including dental, optical, physiotherapy, prescriptions, and more. Salary Sacrifice Pension Scheme: A tax-efficient way to save for your future through pension contributions. Employee Assistance Programme: Confidential mental health, legal, financial, and wellbeing support through Health Hero. Enhanced Leave Entitlements: Supporting you through important life moments with flexibility and care. Professional Development Days: Dedicated time off to focus on your personal and professional growth through training, courses, or self-directed learning. Cycle to Work Scheme: Tax-efficient savings on bikes and accessories, available post-probation. Season Ticket Loans: Interest-free loans to support annual commuting costs. Socials & Team Culture: Company socials every other Thursday, regular run club meetups, plus summer and Christmas events that bring the team together. Culture & Development: A values-led culture with collaborative initiatives and meaningful opportunities for personal and professional development.

rows.title: Data Selections Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
About The Team

We have big goals over the next few years.

We're going to be fighting for mental health in a way we never have before.

Together we'll be working to make sure everyone experiencing a mental health problem gets the support and respect they deserve.

Team information

Will you join us?

Are you confident working with data, have a strong eye for detail and enjoy solving data problems?

We're looking for a Data Selections Analyst to join our Data & Analytics team within Supporter Experience and Data.

Data plays an important role in how we understand and communicate with our supporters. In this role, you'll help make sure our fundraising campaigns and supporter communications reach the right people, at the right time, using accurate and well-managed data.

You'll work closely with colleagues across Fundraising, Communications and Supporter Experience to understand their campaign requirements and turn these into accurate audience selections and data outputs.

You'll use data selection and analysis tools, including FastStats, alongside our CRM to produce and validate supporter data. You'll also investigate data issues, manage competing campaign deadlines and help us maintain high standards of data quality.

You don't need to have worked in the charity sector before or know all of our systems from day one. We're interested in people with transferable data skills who are curious, methodical and keen to develop their knowledge.

This is a hybrid role and you'll be required to work from our Stratford office for a minimum of two days per week.

This role will also requires a DBS check.

Key duties and responsibilities

The Post Holder Will

Produce accurate and timely audience selections and segmentation for fundraising campaigns and supporter communications.Work with stakeholders to understand campaign requirements and translate them into appropriate data selections and outputs.Carry out thorough validation and quality-control checks to ensure data is accurate and complete before it is released.Manage multiple data requests and competing priorities to meet agreed campaign deadlines.Use our CRM and data tools to investigate and resolve data issues, escalating more complex issues when appropriate.Deliver accurate data to internal teams and approved third-party fulfilment partners.Apply appropriate consent, communication preferences, exclusions and suppressions to supporter selections.Help identify data quality issues and contribute to maintaining accurate supporter records.Work collaboratively with colleagues across Data & Analytics, Fundraising, Communications and Supporter Experience.Contribute to improving our data selection processes, documentation and ways of working.

What are we looking for?

Do you enjoy working with data and checking the detail to make sure things are right? Can you organise your workload when several deadlines are competing for your attention? Are you comfortable investigating data when something doesn't look quite right?

We'd particularly like to hear from you if you have:

Experience of using data selection or analysis tools to produce audience selections or data outputs. Experience of FastStats would be helpful, but equivalent tools are equally relevant.Strong attention to detail and a methodical approach to validating and quality-checking data.Experience of managing multiple pieces of work and delivering accurate outputs to deadlines.Experience of using a CRM or customer/supporter database and an understanding of good data quality.Experience of investigating and resolving data issues using appropriate data tools.The ability to understand stakeholder and campaign requirements and translate these into appropriate data outputs.Good communication skills and the ability to work with both technical and non-technical colleagues.An understanding of audience segmentation and targeted supporter or customer communications.An understanding of data protection and the importance of handling personal data appropriately.

Experience in fundraising, marketing, membership, charities or another customer-focused environment would be useful, but it is not essential.

If you enjoy working with data, solving problems and want to use your skills to support work that makes a difference, we'd love to hear from you.

Mind's equity statement

Mind is committed to equality of opportunity for all staff, and applications from individuals are encouraged regardless of age, disability, sex, gender reassignment, sexual orientation, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief and marriage and civil partnerships.

Please refer to the Job Description while completing your application as candidates will be shortlisted based on how closely they match the criteria in the personal specification.

We are looking for a strong self-starter with a genuine passion for data and a drive to produce results. Client firstResults and impact drivenSelf-motivatedContinuous improvement

rows.title: Data and Insights Associate
rows.descriptionText:
By clicking the “Apply” button, I understand that my employment application process with Takeda will commence and that the information I provide in my application will be processed in line with Takeda’s Privacy Notice and Terms of Use. I further attest that all information I submit in my employment application is true to the best of my knowledge.

Job Description:

Takeda is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace, valuing the unique backgrounds and perspectives of our employees. We proudly support our Takeda Resource Groups (TRG), employee-led networks promoting dialogue and professional growth. We encourage all candidates, regardless of background, to apply and explore opportunities to contribute to and benefit from our TRGs and inclusive initiatives. We are dedicated to providing accommodations and support during the recruitment process.

About the role:

Are you an early-career to mid-level analytics professional who is passionate about using data to solve business challenges and improve outcomes for patients?

As a Data & Insights Associate:, you will work under the guidance of senior Data & Insights colleagues and alongside commercial teams to deliver analyses, support projects, and generate insights that inform strategy, optimise brand performance, and enable data-driven decision-making across Takeda UK & Ireland.

In this role, you will analyse market, customer, and competitor data to identify opportunities, evaluate commercial performance, and contribute to strategic planning. You will also have the opportunity to develop your skills in forecasting, market research, strategic analytics, and stakeholder engagement while playing an active role in fostering a culture where insights drive action and innovation.

This is a 12-18 months fixed-term contract.

How you will contribute:

Deliver market, brand, customer, and competitive analyses that support commercial strategy and operational planning.Monitor brand performance through KPI tracking and provide clear insights and recommendations to stakeholders.Support the design, execution, and management of market research and third-party analytics projects that address key business questions.Generate analytics and reporting that support decision-making across Takeda's commercial portfolio.Help maintain and enhance reporting, dashboarding, and data management capabilities, working closely with the wider Data & Insights team.Partner with commercial and DD&T stakeholders on customer engagement initiatives, including segmentation, targeting, campaign optimisation, and data-driven decision support.Contribute to cross-functional projects and provide support across the DD&T function when required.Continuously develop new skills, explore emerging technologies, and stay informed on developments in analytics, data, and the pharmaceutical industry.

What you bring to Takeda:

Experience:

2+ years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, market research, data analysis, forecasting, reporting, or another quantitative or data-focused role.Experience working with analytical tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Qlik, advanced Excel, or similar reporting platforms.Experience with SQL, Python, Databricks, or similar data platforms would be desirable but is not essential.Exposure to forecasting, market research, commercial analytics, or healthcare/pharmaceutical data is advantageous.

Technical and business expertise:

Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with the ability to interpret data and identify meaningful business insights.Understanding of data analysis, reporting, and performance measurement principles.Knowledge of pharmaceutical or healthcare data sources is beneficial.Curiosity about commercial strategy, marketing effectiveness, and business performance.Strong digital literacy, including proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and data visualisation tools.

Skills and behaviours:

Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain insights clearly to a range of audiences.Comfortable working in a dynamic environment with evolving priorities and ambiguity.Strong prioritisation, organisational, and problem-solving skills.Proactive, curious, and committed to continuous learning and self-development.Able to build relationships, influence stakeholders, and contribute effectively within cross-functional teams.Willing to challenge constructively, embrace diverse perspectives, and advocate for data-driven decision-making.Demonstrates accountability, adaptability, and a collaborative approach to delivering results.Comfortable seeking coaching and feedback while steadily building independence and expertise.

Empowering our people to shine:

At Takeda, we earn the trust of society and our customers through our values of Takeda-ism Integrity, Fairness, Honesty, Perseverance. We incorporate these values in everything we do. They represent who we are and how we act. They help us make decisions that we can be proud of today and in the future. We enable our employees to develop their full potential. rows.title: Data, Analytics & Reporting Analyst - Data Engineering Team
rows.descriptionText:
About Columbia Threadneedle Investments

Working at Columbia Threadneedle Investments you'll find growth and career opportunities across all of our businesses.

We're intentionally built to help you succeed. Our reach is expansive with a global team of 2,300 people working together. Our capability is diverse with more than 550 investment professionals sharing global perspectives across all major asset classes and markets. Our clients have access to a broad array of investment strategies, and we have the capability to create bespoke solutions matched to clients' specific requirements. Our unwavering focus on our clients and strong financial foundation connects each of our enterprise businesses — Ameriprise Financial, Columbia Threadneedle Investments and RiverSource Insurance and Annuities.

Job Description

Join our Data Engineering team and help shape the data, analytics and reporting capabilities that support investment oversight, research, portfolio construction and manager selection.

You will partner with Coverage Analysts, Investment Strategy & Research and Multi-Manager Solutions professionals to translate complex business needs into high-quality data solutions, quantitative models and actionable reporting. This hands-on role offers meaningful ownership, cross-functional influence and the opportunity to strengthen data quality, automate critical workflows and introduce innovative analytical capabilities.

You will contribute directly to how our investment teams generate insights and make informed decisions while continuing to grow your technical and investment expertise.

Responsibilities

Partner closely with Coverage Analysts, Investment Strategy & Research and Multi-Manager Solutions professionals to understand analytical needs and translate them into effective data solutions, models and reporting.

Participate in research discussions and project planning, aligning data and analytical capabilities with investment oversight, research, portfolio construction and manager selection priorities.

Source, validate and maintain investment data across platforms and databases, ensuring quality, consistency, accessibility and reliable data feeds for investment teams and broader stakeholders.

Build, maintain and enhance quantitative models, analytical tools and performance attribution systems, including solutions that support backtesting, scenario analysis and factor-based research.

Automate recurring analytical and reporting workflows to improve efficiency, accuracy and timely delivery of performance reports, risk metrics and strategy dashboards.

Design and maintain dashboards and data visualisations that give investment professionals ready access to decision-useful information.

Apply sound model governance practices, including clear documentation, version control and validation protocols.

Drive process improvement by evaluating new technologies and methodologies, including artificial intelligence and machine learning, and support product development and market research through data analysis and quantitative modelling.

Collaborate with Enterprise Technology, Information Technology and Investment Risk Management teams on technology enhancements, platform development and analytical needs, while coordinating effectively with colleagues across Boston, New York, London and India.

Required Qualifications

Prior experience in data analytics, quantitative development or reporting within investment management or financial services, with strong knowledge of investment data, portfolio analytics, performance attribution and risk.

Bachelor's or Master's degree in mathematics, statistics, computer science, data science or a related quantitative field.

Advanced proficiency in Python, R and Structured Query Language (SQL), together with experience using database platforms.

Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences and collaborate across functions and locations.

Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, deliver high-quality work to deadlines and demonstrate initiative, intellectual curiosity and a practical problem-solving mindset.

Preferred Qualifications

Professional certification such as Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA) or Financial Risk Manager (FRM) is preferred.

Experience with cloud platforms such as Amazon Web Services or Microsoft Azure, big data technologies or business intelligence tools is preferred.

Experience with investment data platforms such as Bloomberg, FactSet, Morningstar, eVestment or Aladdin is preferred.

Background in investment consulting, multi-manager investing or investment operations is preferred.

In-Office Collaboration

We are a client-centric, relationship-based business. Working together, in-person, is foundational to how we achieve results. By fostering a culture of face-to-face collaboration, idea sharing, productivity and personal connection, we deliver for our stakeholders - clients, advisors, employees and shareholders. Our employees work in the office at least four (4) days per week, with flexibility to work from home one (1) day per week. Some roles may require additional in-office time or different in-office expectations, and specific requirements will be discussed during the hiring process.

Full time

rows.title: PCM / SCM Manager (Procurement & Capacity Manager)
rows.descriptionText:
Who is DHL Global Forwarding?

DHL Global Forwarding (DGF) is part of the DHL Group. While the DHL Group employs more than 580,000 people globally, DGF has around 31,000 freight forwarding experts in more than 190 countries around the world, with around 1,000 of us based in the UK across 15 Sites. As the experts in Freight Forwarding since 1815, we are the global specialists in Air, Ocean and Rail Freight.

You name it, we’ve shipped it - from brown bears to aircraft engines, to lifesaving medicines and luxury cars! We are also proud to partner with some of the well-known global sporting series, movie franchises and music tours.

Our people are at the heart of what we do, and we’re committed to helping our Forwarders to realise their full potential, supported by our own development journey - Certified International Forwarder (CIF).

Our Values 

Every day we are guided by our values: Passion, Entrepreneurship, Excellence and Teamwork.

We are extremely passionate about our people and what we do, which is why DHL Global Forwarding is recognised as a Top Employer and a Great Place to Work, because we are specialists in providing Excellence, Simply Delivered.

In addition to our values, we promote an open and honest feedback culture based on Respect & Results, whereby our employees embrace diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging, while ensuring that we never compromise our integrity and compliance.

Role

Role Overview 

The PCM/SCM Manager is responsible for delivering airfreight procurement and carrier management strategies that optimise cost, capacity, and service performance. Working closely with operational teams, stations, gateways, and airline partners, the role drives effective pricing, supplier performance, and consolidation planning. The successful candidate will provide market insight, manage carrier relationships, and support the wider UK network to achieve commercial and operational objectives.

Key Responsibilities:


Execution of Global procurement strategy directly linked to airline support.Management of “Best pricing” through contract and/or spot process.Planning of consolidations & protection of capacity working directly with the Operations and stations.Optimisation of consolidations / Volume paid controlCommercial management off all Gateway shipments, consolidation and some back to back’s. Defines and management of internal rates.Performs market and customer analysis to meet supply/demand.Initiates local corrective action or raise to Global.Maintains and offers market information.Offers guidance & support to DGF UK networkManagers carrier performance from internal reports.Ensures that all interactions are compliant with DPDHL Code of Conduct and other compliance requirements e.g. anti-corruptionContribute to the First Choice continuous improvement program


Skills and Experience: 


Excellent commercial understanding of the Airfreight industry (5 yrs. preferable)Excellent communication skills, key to the role both internally and externallyStrong team player with a positive “Can do attitude”Customer focussed.Good operational understanding and skillsetAbility to build strong relationships with suppliers and colleaguesA good “IT” awareness preferableStrong problem solverStrong negotiation skillsResults driven


Benefits:


A competitive salaryGenerous holiday entitlementPension scheme which includes life assurance Access to professional employee assistance and wellbeing programmeA competitive package of voluntary benefits including retail, entertainment, gym membership, cycle to work scheme, contribution to eye care costs, and many more discounts Training and Development opportunities with a strong focus on internal promotion


HOURS/SHIFT PATTERN: 37.5 hours per week

REPORTS TO: PCM/SCM Team Lead

Please note: Due to the nature of our business we are regulated by the CAA (Civil Aviation Authority), therefore it is compulsory for all applicants once offered employment to provide a full 5 year employment history. Additional to this we are required to carry out a Criminal Record Check.

What’s Next?

If you would like to be considered for this position, then please apply via our careers website with a copy of your CV outlining your experience to date and suitability for the role.

DHL is the leading global brand in the logistics industry. Our DHL divisions offer an unrivalled portfolio of logistics services ranging from national and international parcel delivery, e-commerce shipping and fulfillment solutions, international express, road, air and ocean transport to industrial supply chain management. DHL connects people and businesses securely and reliably, enabling global sustainable trade flows.

Our culture is focused on personal commitment – to our customers, to each other, to our communities and to the environment. We reward excellent work and we nurture the talents of our employees. This enables you as an employee to develop your expertise and your career in different areas or divisions – and even in other countries.

We are committed to creating a workplace that ensures mutual respect and is focused on results. We hire talented people from all backgrounds – irrespective of gender, disability, nationality, ethnicity, social background, religion and beliefs, age or sexual orientation and identity. Diversity enriches our workplace, drives our success, and helps us deliver excellence.

By submitting your application, you agree that DGF UK will process your personal data for the purpose of recruitment and selection. We handle all data in accordance with the UK GDPR and Data Protection Act 2018. To understand what information we collect, how we use it, and your rights, please read our full Privacy Policy.

rows.descriptionText:
About 1st Formations

At 1st Formations, we empower entrepreneurs to start, run, and grow their businesses with confidence.

Running a business shouldn’t be slowed down by company formation, statutory compliance, accounting, or payroll. From day one, these essentials should be seamless, reliable, and intelligently handled — freeing founders to focus on building and scaling.

We’re a leading UK provider of company formation and compliance services, building a modern, fully integrated technology platform that supports founders at every stage of their journey. Our platform brings together formation, compliance, accounting, payroll, and ongoing business support in one cohesive experience.

No stitched-together services.

No legacy workflows disguised as software.

Just a single, scalable platform built for ambitious founders who want to move fast, stay compliant, and grow with confidence.

Why Join Us Now?

You’ll be joining a business with strong momentum, clear direction, and real opportunity for progression.

£18m annual revenue, including £9m ARROver 1 million companies formedCertified B Corp and Carbon Neutral BusinessForecast to grow 5x–10x over the next three years

The Role

The Email Marketing Executive supports the Head of CRM & Lifecycle Marketing in delivering retention and engagement activity across 1st Formations’ client base of hundreds of thousands of customers. This is a hands-on, delivery-focused role suited to someone early in their CRM or lifecycle marketing career who wants to build deep, practical expertise in campaign execution, segmentation and reporting within a fast-growing, data-driven marketing function.

Key Responsibilities

Build, schedule and QA automated email journeys and triggered campaigns within the CRM platform (e.g. HubSpot), under the direction of the Head of CRM & Lifecycle MarketingSupport the ongoing maintenance and accuracy of client segmentation and list hygiene, ensuring campaigns reach the right audienceAssist with the design and set-up of A/B and multivariate tests across messaging, timing and subject lines, and help compile resultsPull and organise campaign performance data, producing regular reporting packs on open, click, conversion and churn-related metricsCoordinate with design and copy resources to ensure campaign assets are delivered on time and to brand standardMonitor day-to-day campaign performance and flag anomalies, deliverability issues or underperforming journeys to the Senior ManagerMaintain up-to-date documentation of live journeys, workflows and segmentation logicSupport the wider Marketing team with ad hoc administrative and campaign coordination tasks as requiredHelp ensure all client communications comply with GDPR and relevant marketing regulations

What We Are Looking For

Some hands-on experience with a CRM or email marketing platform (e.g. HubSpot, Mailchimp, Klaviyo or similar), gained through a role, placement or personal project. Familiarity with HubSpot specifically is preferred.Strong attention to detail, particularly when building or QAing campaigns before they go liveComfortable working with data in spreadsheets (Excel/Google Sheets), including basic formulas and pivot tablesGood written communication skills, with an ability to proofread and adapt copy for different audiencesA proactive, organised approach and the ability to manage several campaigns or tasks in parallelAn interest in customer retention, lifecycle marketing or CRM as a long-term career pathPrevious experience in a marketing assistant, coordinator or executive role, ideally in a subscription, SaaS or high-volume consumer businessBasic understanding of HTML/CSS for email template editsExposure to SQL or a willingness to learnAwareness of GDPR and email marketing compliance principles

What We Offer

£35-38k and comprehensive benefits packageHybrid Role – 3 days in the office and 2 days from home.Real opportunities for progression as the business scalesThe chance to influence both customer experience and product developmentA culture that values ownership, impact, and continuous learning

Equal Opportunities

1st Formations is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We consider all applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, criminal history, disability, or gender identity. We encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

rows.title: Membership Strategy Manager
rows.descriptionText:
The Role..

The Membership Strategy Manager is responsible for delivering Soho House’s global membership strategy across a set of key Houses, translating centrally designed frameworks into locally relevant plans that protect and grow membership revenue. Houses and areas of focus are assigned by the Global Membership Strategy Manager and Chief Membership Officer according to what the role’s base geography allows, and may change over time in line with business need.

Reporting to the Global Membership Strategy Manager, the role takes agreed global strategy — across retention and engagement, intakes and applications, and new House openings — and leads its execution across its assigned Houses in partnership with the Regional Membership Director, House Membership teams and the Soho Support Member Success function.

The role is the strategic link between global strategy and local delivery. It applies global frameworks to the specific conditions of its assigned Houses, manages the data and performance cycle behind each initiative, and feeds on-the-ground insight, barriers and opportunities back into global planning.

The role is responsible for the delivery and success of membership strategy across its assigned Houses. Accountability for regional membership performance sits with the Regional Membership Director and their teams.

Key Accountabilities..

Delivery of Global Strategy Across Assigned Houses

Take agreed global membership initiatives and objectives and lead their delivery across its assigned Houses, translating global frameworks into practical local plans with membership and operations teamsPrioritise and sequence global initiatives according to House-level risk, opportunity and operational capacityFeed on-the-ground insight, local nuance and delivery barriers back into global strategy developmentAct as the primary point of contact across its assigned Houses for global membership strategy, ensuring House teams understand what is being asked of them and why

Retention, Churn & Engagement

Deliver its assigned Houses’ contribution to the global membership retention targetLocalised: design and run churn toolboxes that reduce churn among high-risk member groups across its assigned Houses, tracking and evolving these approaches as performance data emergesCentralised: drive engagement against the globally defined attrition indicators, closing the gap between local execution and target.Data: manage pre and post-initiative data for its assigned Houses, adjusting continually with local teams to protect the retention goalStrengthen onboarding and first-three-year engagement across its assigned Houses, using behavioural insight to intervene at the highest-risk stages of membership.Partner with the Data Team and the Soho Support Member Success function so that proactive intervention is targeted where it delivers the greatest impact across its assigned Houses

Intakes & Applications

Partner with local teams to track and deliver budgeted intakes for its assigned Houses, de-risking revenue shortfall from missed intake targetsLeverage seasonality and local cultural calendars to maximise application volumesExecute acquisition strategies that deliver the required Every House mix across its assigned HousesRun scenario-based local offers, adapting approaches proven elsewhere in the groupIdentify emerging risk to intake or revenue early and escalate to the Membership Strategy Manager (Global) with a recommended recovery plan

New Openings & Hypercare

Apply the global opening framework to pre-opening acquisition and membership success planning for openings within its assigned Houses.Lead membership-side opening implementation and hypercare across its assigned Houses.Partner with pre-opening, marketing and House teams so that application, intake and early engagement targets are met at opening.Capture what worked and what did not at each opening and feed it back into the global opening playbook

Data, Insight & Performance

Track and report performance across its assigned Houses, spanning onboarding, engagement, retention, renewals, applications and intakesTranslate House-level data into clear, commercially focused recommendations for both local teams and global strategyPartner with the Data Team on member segmentation and predictive churn models, ensuring local nuance is reflectedPresent regional performance and recommendations to senior stakeholders

Partnership & Cross-Functional Working

Partner with the Regional Membership Director, who holds accountability for regional membership performance, to ensure strategy is delivered effectively across its assigned HousesWork with House Membership teams, Member Relations, Operations, Marketing, Communications and Digital to remove barriers to retention and acquisition across its assigned HousesProvide clear prioritisation and targeting guidance so House teams can execute global initiatives consistentlyAct as escalation point across its assigned Houses for retention performance, cohort risk and engagement challenges

Continuous Improvement & Innovation

Identify and test improvements to member engagement, retention and acquisition across its assigned HousesMeasure effectiveness and hand successful approaches to the Membership Strategy Manager (Global) for scaling across other regionsChampion a culture of continuous improvement within its assigned Houses’ membership teams

Benefits…

rows.title: Commercial Insights Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Commercial Insights Analyst, PermanentAt Costa Coffee, we’re on a mission to reimagine coffee experiences across the globe. From bustling cities to local communities, we’re creating meaningful coffee moments, powered by innovation and driven by purpose.
As a proud part of the Coca-Cola system and working hand in hand with our pioneering partners, we’re in over 50 countries and counting. Whether it's served in-store, from a machine, at home, or on the go, every cup is thoughtfully crafted by our passionate teams who put heart into every moment.
Our teams truly make a difference. Whether it's pioneering new tech for the perfect pour, launching award-winning campaigns, developing exciting new menu items, or supporting our people to grow – together, we stir up success.
This newly created role sits within our Global Revenue Growth Management Centre of Excellence, driving data-led decision-making to unlock value across our global markets. The position plays a pivotal role in strengthening our end-to-end revenue management processes through advanced analytics, smart pricing expertise, and cross-functional collaboration to identify growth and efficiency opportunities. By translating complex data into clear insights and actionable recommendations, the role will help create a continuous improvement cycle that enhances performance, control, and commercial impact worldwide.
We value curiosity, inclusivity, and a problem-solving mindset. If you thrive in a fast-paced, global environment and are excited to make a meaningful impact, we encourage you to apply.
With inspiring experiences, development programmes, and our apprenticeship scheme, your career can grow far beyond the day-to-day.
What you’ll doBeing a Commercial Insights Analyst is about so much more than bringing our coffee to the world. It’s your chance to stir up real success - which means you’ll be:
Driving Global Revenue Management performance. Lead robust analysis to support monthly reviews of proposed business changes, assess performance against agreed KPIs, and ensure delivery against Revenue Management targets through clear, data-driven recommendations.Deliver insightful product and promotional analysis. Evaluate promotional and trial performance versus KPIs, provide clear next-step proposals, and identify scalable opportunities across global markets to optimise NSR and margin.Provide pricing optimisation recommendations. Become a Smart Pricing expert, utilising Costa’s Smart Pricing Tool to work with a range of Global markets, modelling price changes to providing optionality and recommendations through a data-led approach.Enhance pricing, segmentation and margin performance. Monitor internal performance across products, price, promotion and segmentation, using store and SKU-level data, alongside external and competitor data, to identify underperformance, unlock growth opportunities, and achieve margin targets.Strengthen governance, control and cross-functional alignment. Monitor cost price inputs and operational inefficiencies (e.g. over-ordering, bottom-performing stores), partner with Category Managers and cross-functional teams to resolve issues, and present clear, professional insights to drive informed decision-making and continuous improvement.
Who you are:It’s your unique ingredients we’re interested in:Strong commercial and financial acumen, with an understanding of pricing, promotional mechanics, margin, OI, volume, rebates and price elasticity. Experience within retail, category, finance or similar analytical environments advantageous.Advanced Excel-led analytical capability. Highly proficient in Excel as a core tool, with the ability to manipulate and interpret large datasets and present commercial and insight-driven recommendations clearly.Effective communicator and collaborative stakeholder partner. Able to translate data into clear, accessible insights and work cross-functionally with a range of stakeholders, building strong working relationships to support informed decision-making.Organised and process-driven. Structured and detail-oriented, capable of managing multiple priorities, tracking performance and maintaining data accuracy and governance across end-to-end processes.Curious, analytical and solutions-focused mindset. Comfortable navigating complexity, able to juggle large datasets, interrogate what the data is signalling, and proactively identify risks and opportunities
So, why Costa? We didn’t become a global coffee brand by sitting back. When you work here, you join a community that values passion, progression, and integrity—with some brilliant perks to sweeten the deal. We work in a hybrid environment, giving us the flexibility to balance life while still spending meaningful time together and building strong connections:Own a piece of Costa’s success by becoming a share owner in Coca-Cola with our Share Investment Plan (SIP)An annual discretionary bonus scheme, based on business results and individual contribution.A smart pension that saves you money on tax and national insurance, and matches your contributions up to 10%The Costa Financial Support Fund, supporting team members who find themselves in unexpected financial pressure50% discount in all Costa-owned stores, and 25% off in other participating storesPrivate medical cover thanks to our Private Healthcare schemeAnd that’s not all. Explore even more of our perks here: https://bit.ly/costaperks
Location - Where you’ll work:Right now, our Support Centre teams work flexibly, blending home working with in-person time whenever it matters most – whether that’s a team moment, a creative session, or simply coming together to share ideas.
We’re excited to be moving into a new home for our brand in St Albans in January 2027 – an inspiring space from which our Support Centre teams will work three days a week to connect and collaborate in-person to bring our bold ambition to life.
For any reasonable adjustments and general queries, please get in touch with costa.recruitment@costacoffee.com
We believe in living life with heart – and that starts with our people.By showing up as our authentic selves, we create a culture where everyone belongs. We celebrate diversity in all its forms and are committed to building an equitable and inclusive environment—one that embraces the unique blend of experiences, identities, and perspectives each person brings. This rich diversity strengthens our teams and reflects the spirit of our global brand.Grounded in our core values – Disciplined to Deliver, Passion for Progress, Win with Warmth, Courage to Challenge, and Trusted Team Players - we strive to make a meaningful impact in everything we do. From empowering communities through the Costa Foundation to supporting local initiatives, we’re committed to changing lives in coffee-growing regions and right here at home

rows.title: Data Selections Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
About The Team

We have big goals over the next few years.

We're going to be fighting for mental health in a way we never have before.

Together we'll be working to make sure everyone experiencing a mental health problem gets the support and respect they deserve.

Team information

Will you join us?

Are you confident working with data, have a strong eye for detail and enjoy solving data problems?

We're looking for a Data Selections Analyst to join our Data & Analytics team within Supporter Experience and Data.

Data plays an important role in how we understand and communicate with our supporters. In this role, you'll help make sure our fundraising campaigns and supporter communications reach the right people, at the right time, using accurate and well-managed data.

You'll work closely with colleagues across Fundraising, Communications and Supporter Experience to understand their campaign requirements and turn these into accurate audience selections and data outputs.

You'll use data selection and analysis tools, including FastStats, alongside our CRM to produce and validate supporter data. You'll also investigate data issues, manage competing campaign deadlines and help us maintain high standards of data quality.

You don't need to have worked in the charity sector before or know all of our systems from day one. We're interested in people with transferable data skills who are curious, methodical and keen to develop their knowledge.

This is a hybrid role and you'll be required to work from our Stratford office for a minimum of two days per week.

This role will also requires a DBS check.

Key duties and responsibilities

The Post Holder Will

Produce accurate and timely audience selections and segmentation for fundraising campaigns and supporter communications.Work with stakeholders to understand campaign requirements and translate them into appropriate data selections and outputs.Carry out thorough validation and quality-control checks to ensure data is accurate and complete before it is released.Manage multiple data requests and competing priorities to meet agreed campaign deadlines.Use our CRM and data tools to investigate and resolve data issues, escalating more complex issues when appropriate.Deliver accurate data to internal teams and approved third-party fulfilment partners.Apply appropriate consent, communication preferences, exclusions and suppressions to supporter selections.Help identify data quality issues and contribute to maintaining accurate supporter records.Work collaboratively with colleagues across Data & Analytics, Fundraising, Communications and Supporter Experience.Contribute to improving our data selection processes, documentation and ways of working.

What are we looking for?

Do you enjoy working with data and checking the detail to make sure things are right? Can you organise your workload when several deadlines are competing for your attention? Are you comfortable investigating data when something doesn't look quite right?

We'd particularly like to hear from you if you have:

Experience of using data selection or analysis tools to produce audience selections or data outputs. Experience of FastStats would be helpful, but equivalent tools are equally relevant.Strong attention to detail and a methodical approach to validating and quality-checking data.Experience of managing multiple pieces of work and delivering accurate outputs to deadlines.Experience of using a CRM or customer/supporter database and an understanding of good data quality.Experience of investigating and resolving data issues using appropriate data tools.The ability to understand stakeholder and campaign requirements and translate these into appropriate data outputs.Good communication skills and the ability to work with both technical and non-technical colleagues.An understanding of audience segmentation and targeted supporter or customer communications.An understanding of data protection and the importance of handling personal data appropriately.

Experience in fundraising, marketing, membership, charities or another customer-focused environment would be useful, but it is not essential.

If you enjoy working with data, solving problems and want to use your skills to support work that makes a difference, we'd love to hear from you.

Mind's equity statement

Mind is committed to equality of opportunity for all staff, and applications from individuals are encouraged regardless of age, disability, sex, gender reassignment, sexual orientation, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief and marriage and civil partnerships.

rows.title: Community Database Administrator
rows.descriptionText:
Our Community Data Administrator will be responsible for the quality, coverage, depth and development of Cogora’s HCP community. The role will ensure we have a high-quality, accurate, comprehensive, current, relevant and growing audience that meets the needs of the business and our clients.
Salary: £30,000 - £35,000. 
They will develop a detailed understanding of Cogora’s HCP data and the wider addressable HCP market, identifying where we have strong coverage, where gaps exist and what actions we can take to address them. They will use first- and third-party data, market intelligence and behavioural and engagement data to understand the composition and health of our community and identify opportunities for growth and improvement.
This is a highly analytical role for someone who loves working with data, numbers and solving problems. They will interrogate datasets, spot patterns and anomalies, assess data quality and freshness, identify gaps and translate findings into clear actions.
Working closely with teams across Cogora, they will help source and evaluate new data, improve HCP profiling and segmentation, strengthen our understanding of audience engagement and ensure our HCP community becomes increasingly accurate, complete, current and commercially valuable.
Key responsibilities:Data Quality: Take ownership of the overall health of Cogora’s HCP database, including accuracy, completeness, recency, duplication, consistency, consent and compliance. Establish clear definitions and standards for data quality and regularly measure the database against them, including agreed definitions for active HCPs, inactive HCPs, dormant records, complete profiles and verified HCPs. Identify data quality issues and work with relevant teams to implement solutions and continually improve the reliability of our data.
Data Coverage: Build a detailed understanding of Cogora’s coverage of the HCP market and identify gaps by profession, specialty, geography, seniority and other relevant characteristics. Develop clear, data-led plans to address priority audience gaps and measure the impact of actions taken.
Data Enrichment: Identify opportunities to enhance existing HCP records with additional data points and attributes, improving the completeness and depth of our profiles. Determine which additional attributes would provide the greatest audience, editorial and commercial value and identify appropriate sources for obtaining them.
Data Freshness & Engagement: Assess HCP recency and frequency of interaction with Cogora, developing a consistent engagement score using behavioural signals across the business. Use engagement data to understand the active audience and identify opportunities to increase engagement.
Audience Re-engagement & Cleansing: Identify inactive, ageing, duplicate, incomplete or low-confidence records. Work with relevant teams to determine appropriate approaches for re-engagement, verification, consolidation, suppression or removal. Monitor the effectiveness of re-engagement and cleansing activity and use the findings to continually improve our approach.
Segmentation & Audience Insight: Develop meaningful HCP segments based on profession, specialty, geography, seniority, demographics, behaviour, engagement, recency and other relevant characteristics. Analyse these segments to identify patterns, opportunities and changes in audience behaviour. Translate complex data into clear insights that can be understood and acted upon by teams across the business.
Data Acquisition & Gap Closure: Research and evaluate new first- and third-party data sources that could strengthen Cogora’s HCP community. Assess potential sources based on quality, coverage, accuracy, recency, compliance, cost and likely incremental value. Develop data-led recommendations for acquiring or generating data to address identified audience gaps and measure whether those interventions successfully improve coverage.
Commercial Audience Analysis: Work closely with our commercial teams to understand current and emerging client audience requirements. Translate these requirements into data needs and assess Cogora’s ability to reach relevant HCP audiences. Identify areas where strengthening our data could create new commercial opportunities or improve our existing audience proposition.
Reporting: Develop and maintain reporting on the health and development of Cogora’s HCP community. Monitor key metrics including database size, net growth, coverage, completeness, duplication, freshness, active and inactive audiences, engagement and enrichment. Move beyond simply reporting numbers by identifying what the data tells us, highlighting emerging issues and opportunities and making clear recommendations for action.
Internal expertise: Become Cogora’s internal authority on our HCP community. Develop a comprehensive understanding of what data we hold, where it comes from, how reliable and current it is, how our audiences engage with Cogora, where gaps exist and what opportunities there are to improve the data. Support teams across the business with questions about HCP audience size, composition, coverage and engagement.
We’re looking for someone who is naturally curious and genuinely enjoys working with data. You’ll have a highly analytical mind, an exceptional eye for detail and a tendency to ask ‘why’ and ‘what does this tell us?’ rather than simply accepting the numbers at face value. You’ll enjoy getting into the detail of datasets, spotting patterns and inconsistencies and solving problems. You’ll be organised, methodical and comfortable working with large volumes of data, but equally able to step back and see the bigger picture.
Most importantly, you’ll be someone who lives and breathes data – excited by numbers, curious about what they can tell us and always looking for ways to make our data better and more current.

Knowledge and Skills Requirements:

Deep understanding of Talent Intelligence, Planning, Talent Analytics, Workforce Evolution and Talent Strategy.Strong consulting, stakeholder management, and executive influence capabilities.Ability to align talent analytics outcomes with broader business objectives.Strong commercial acumen and understanding of organizational transformation.
