rows.title: Open Source Engineer - Go

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
About The Company

Braintrust is the agent observability platform. By actively applying intelligence to agent traces and automatically surfacing the most critical patterns, Braintrust gives teams the visibility to understand how agents behave in production and the tools to improve them.

Teams at Notion, Stripe, Box, OpenAI, and Cloudflare use Braintrust to trace their agents, find the issues in their observability data, and run evals that tell them how to improve.

About The Role

We’re hiring engineers to build the open-source libraries that customers use to observe, understand, and optimize how AI operates inside their production applications. These SDKs are a critical part of Braintrust’s platform. They power evaluation and observability pipelines across a wide range of environments, frameworks, and AI providers.

This role is ideal for engineers who are passionate about developer experience, API craftsmanship, and building fast, reliable, and idiomatic libraries. You’ll own the full SDK lifecycle: design, implementation, release, documentation, and community support. Your work will be embedded in thousands of applications and help define how AI is adopted and operationalized across industries.

What You’ll Do

Build elegant, idiomatic, and resilient SDKs that power Braintrust’s LLM evaluation and AI observability platform. Ensure our libraries are easy to use, efficient to run, and a delight to work with, prioritizing developer experience and performance. Integrate with major AI providers, frameworks, and platforms our customers rely on, such as OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini. Build tools and automation to improve testing, profiling and simplify release workflows. Collaborate closely with backend, platform, and product teams to ensure a cohesive and polished developer experience. Be a great community ambassador: talk with our users, understand their issues, help them get their fixes merged and have deep empathy for our users. 

You Might Be a Fit If You:

Are customer-obsessed and passionate about solving real-world problems for developers. Have deep expertise in Go and understand what it takes to build fast, idiomatic, and reliable libraries in that ecosystem. Are proficient with the tooling needed to build robust SDKs, such as testing frameworks, profilers, CI/CD pipelines, and packaging systems. Care deeply about developer experience, from clean APIs and clear docs to thoughtful error handling and backward compatibility. Know how to wrap, patch, or extend existing frameworks and SDKs to inject observability and control without breaking developer workflows. Have experience maintaining or contributing to production-grade open-source libraries, ideally used across multiple environments. Bonus: You’ve contributed to popular open source projects, led SDK adoption at your organization, are familiar with tracing and observability tools like OpenTelemetry, or worked on tools in the LLM/AI ecosystem. 

Benefits include

Medical, dental, and vision insuranceDaily lunch, snacks, and beveragesFlexible time offCompetitive salary and equityWifi & cellphone stipend 

Equal opportunity

Braintrust is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

rows.title: AI Engineer Internship | Undergraduate or Graduate - Summer 2027
rows.descriptionText:
About The Role

Endeavor's Platform team builds the data, tools, and AI infrastructure that powers our global network across 50+ markets. With Claude Enterprise now deployed to 390+ staff across 43+ markets, access to AI is no longer our constraint. The next challenge is organizational: converting that access into institutional capabilities that one team can build, another market can reuse, and Endeavor retains when people move on.

We're looking for a curious, hands-on, builder-minded intern to help create Endeavor's AI organizational infrastructure: the reusable capabilities, templates, governance rails, and enablement systems that let our local offices and functional teams design their own AI-augmented processes safely and effectively, instead of 50 markets reinventing the same tools in isolation.

This is not a shadowing role. It is a hybrid role between discovery and applied AI engineering. You will interview local offices and functional departments to understand their workflows and what infrastructure they actually need, and you will get your hands dirty: prototyping agentic workflows, Claude skills, MicroApps, and retrieval systems on Endeavor's enterprise AI stack (Claude Enterprise, MCP integrations, Snowflake, Salesforce, and Notion). You will also support the Platform team's deeper work on knowledge capture and institutional memory, helping turn the network's interactions into structured, trusted, actionable knowledge.

By the end of the internship, you'll have shipped real capabilities used by teams across markets, creating a tangible output with lasting impact on how nearly 500 Endeavor colleagues work worldwide. This internship is ideal for someone excited by applied AI, organizational systems, and building things that scale globally, while gaining real responsibility and visibility inside a mission-driven organization.

Key Responsibilities

Responsibility #1: Discover What Teams Actually NeedLead structured interviews with local offices and functional departments to map their workflows, pain points, and existing AI experiments. Find where a shared, governed capability would beat fifty isolated ones, and identify what infrastructure, training, or guardrails each team needs to build effectively on their own.Responsibility #2: Build Reusable AI CapabilitiesPrototype agentic workflows, Claude skills, MicroApps, and retrieval features on our enterprise stack (Claude Enterprise, MCP, APIs), always choosing the lightest technical pattern that supports the behavior we want. Package what works so another market can adopt it without rebuilding it.Responsibility #3: Create the Enablement InfrastructureHelp create the templates, playbooks, starter kits, and documentation that let teams self-serve: how to build a skill, an Artifact, a plugin, etc.; how to connect to governed data and use our MCPs; and how to stay within Endeavor's AI Policy. Make the right way the easy way.Responsibility #4: Support Knowledge Capture & Institutional MemorySupport the Platform team's work on turning captured knowledge (meetings, founder ratings, network interactions) into structured, actionable intelligence, including retrieval pipelines and early knowledge graph work that makes institutional memory usable at the moment of key decisions.Responsibility #5: Govern and Evaluate What You ShipDefine what "working" means for the capabilities you build: success metrics, output quality checks, and simple eval loops. Contribute everything to Endeavor's AI Registry so it is human-owned, tracked, permission-aware, and auditable in line with Endeavor's AI Policy.
Skills And Qualifications - Who You Are

Student Status: Undergraduate Junior or Senior, or Graduate student in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Business, or a related field; candidates from other disciplines with relevant skills and demonstrated building experience are encouraged to apply.Interests / Areas of Focus:Strong interest in applied AI and how organizations, not just individuals, adopt it: workflows, governance, change management, and knowledge systems.Hands-on experience building with LLMs beyond casual chatting: class projects, hackathons, or personal projects involving prompting, agents, RAG, or API integrations (Anthropic/Claude, OpenAI, or similar). Fluency with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor) is a strong plus. Things you have shipped matter more than credentials.Working knowledge of Python or TypeScript/JavaScript and basic SQL, enough to build a prototype and query data with AI assistance.Ability to understand technical architectures (APIs, databases, retrieval systems) and explain them clearly to non-technical colleagues; much of this role is translating between technical and non-technical worlds.Exceptional written and verbal communication with an analytical-first mindset; comfortable asking "why" to get to the root of a problem and turning research into actionable recommendations.Comfortable working in a multilingual, global, cross-cultural environment and incorporating feedback from multiple stakeholders.Nice to have: familiarity with Git, Snowflake, Salesforce, Notion, or workflow automation tools; interest in entrepreneurship or the startup ecosystem.Must be legally eligible to work in the U.S. We will not be able to interview or select candidates without valid U.S. work authorization for the 2027 year.
HIRING TIMELINE

Applications close: October 7, 2026 at 11:59pmInterview process: Initial Phone Screen: A 30-minute introductory conversation with a member of the Platform team to discuss your background and interest in the role.Final Interview: A 1-hour deep dive with the Hiring Manager covering discovery thinking, research methodology, and technical literacy, plus a short practical exercise. Using AI tools during the exercise is expected and encouraged; we want to see how you drive them.Offer extension: November 16, 2026 
Internship Program Overview

The Endeavor Summer Internship Program gives students 10 weeks to do more than just watch from the sidelines. You'll be put side by side with our Headquarters teams in NYC, San Francisco, London, Dubai, or Singapore, owning meaningful projects that move Endeavor forward.

You'll contribute to real work from day one, and by the end of the summer, you'll present it directly to our CEO. Along the way you’ll get access most internships can’t offer, including fireside chats with our CEO, candid conversations with category-defining Endeavor Entrepreneurs, and face time with executives across our global HQ. You’ll leave with new skills, relationships across 50+ countries, and a much deeper understanding of how entrepreneurship works around the world.

This is your front-row seat to how a global organization helps ambitious entrepreneurs build, scale, and shape what’s next.

Program Duration: June 7th, 2027 to August 13th 2027Pay: New York State minimum wage ($17/hr), up to 40 hours/weekStructure: This is a hybrid internship in New York City, with three days per week to be spent at Endeavor Global’s HQ office in Downtown ManhattanRead more about out program here

About Endeavor

WHO WE ARE: Endeavor is the leading network of entrepreneurs scaling exceptional businesses around the world.

OUR MISSION: We exist to develop thriving entrepreneurial ecosystems in places where talent is abundant, but capital and opportunity are not.

OUR MODEL: At Endeavor we:

Select the highest-potential scale-up founders as Endeavor Entrepreneurs (EEs), including some of the fastest-growing AI companies in our markets.Support EEs through pivotal moments as they go big.Invest in EEs through our pioneering co-investment fund, Endeavor Catalyst, with $840M+ AUM across five funds.Elevate the top entrepreneurs as role models.Advance the field of global entrepreneurship through data-driven research and thought leadership, including measuring entrepreneurs’ Multiplier Effects across ecosystems.

Endeavor Entrepreneurs (EEs) prove that category-defining companies can come from anywhere in the world. Since our founding 29 years ago, Endeavor has selected 3,100+ Endeavor Entrepreneurs across 50+ countries, including the founders of 100+ Unicorns (companies valued at $1B+)

rows.descriptionText:
Start your software career with a company whose entire business is launching them.
SkillStorm builds technology talent for Fortune 100 enterprises and U.S. government agencies. Join the pioneering AI Foundations Research team at IBM Research and contribute to shaping the future foundations of artificial intelligence. rows.descriptionText:
Junior Machine Learning Engineer – Medical ImagingHolobeam Technologies | Bethpage, NY
Holobeam Technologies is developing advanced medical imaging technologies designed to improve how medical images are processed, analyzed, and used in clinical care.We are looking for a Junior Machine Learning Engineer – Medical Imaging who wants to do more than maintain existing models. This is a hands-on research and development role for someone interested in building and testing new approaches in medical imaging, computer vision, and machine learning.
You will work with real medical imaging datasets, develop and evaluate ML models, investigate new research ideas, and help turn promising concepts into reproducible imaging pipelines.As you grow in the role, we want you to be able to take ownership of a research direction understand the relevant literature, reproduce or modify published approaches, design experiments, train models, investigate failures, and determine what actually works.
What You’ll DoReview and validate medical imaging datasets, metadata, annotations, and model outputs.Develop, train, benchmark, and evaluate computer vision and medical-image models using Python and PyTorch.Work with X-ray, CT and other medical imaging data, including DICOM studies, annotations, masks, and volumetric data.Build reproducible preprocessing, training, inference, and evaluation pipelines.Implement and evaluate methods from research papers and investigate ways to improve them.Design controlled experiments to compare architectures, preprocessing methods, loss functions, training strategies, and datasets.Perform detailed error and failure analysis rather than relying only on aggregate model metrics.Identify problems involving data quality, preprocessing, labeling, distribution shift, and model generalization.Develop automated quality-control and data-validation tools.Document experiments, methods, decisions, failures, and results so work can be reproduced.Work directly with technical and clinical team members to determine whether experimental results are meaningful.Take increasing ownership of an individual research and model-training direction as your experience grows.What We’re Looking ForStrong Python programming skills.Hands-on experience with PyTorch.Experience training and evaluating computer vision or deep-learning models.Understanding of common architectures used for tasks such as classification, detection, or image analysis.Experience working with image data and image-processing pipelines.Ability to independently debug problems involving data, code, training, and model outputs.Understanding of proper experimental design, including train/validation/test separation, evaluation metrics, and error analysis.Ability to read technical papers and translate an algorithm or research approach into working code.Strong curiosity and willingness to investigate why an approach works or fails, rather than simply running an existing pipeline.Ability to communicate experimental results clearly and document work reproducibly.
Particularly Valuable ExperienceYou do not need to have everything below. Experience in one or more of these areas will make you especially interesting to us:Medical imaging: X-ray, CT, MRI, PET, ultrasound, OCT, or CBCTDICOM and medical-image preprocessingImage reconstruction or inverse problemsImage registrationDiffusion models or other generative models3D computer vision or volumetric imagingScientific image processingGPU training and CUDAReproducing or extending published ML researchResearch resulting in a thesis, publication, conference paper, or substantial independent project
Who Might Be a Great FitYou might be finishing a bachelor’s or master’s degree, working toward or recently completing a PhD, or already have early-career industry/research experience.We care more about what you have actually built and investigated than the exact title of your degree.
For example, we’d be interested in someone who can say:“I implemented a segmentation paper and discovered why it didn’t generalize to my dataset.”“I built a preprocessing and training pipeline for CT or MRI data.”“I trained a model, analyzed its failure cases, changed the approach, and demonstrated why the new version was better.”
“I found a problem with the dataset or its preprocessing that was causing the model to fail and fixed it.”“I took a research idea from literature review through experimentation and evaluation.”That kind of technical ownership and curiosity is important to us.
What Makes This Role DifferentThis is not primarily a data-labeling, data-cleaning, or model-monitoring position.Those activities are part of developing reliable medical-imaging AI, but our goal is to develop someone who can become an independent ML researcher/engineer capable of owning an experimental direction.
You will have the opportunity to work on difficult imaging problems where the answer may not already be known. You’ll be expected to experiment, question assumptions, learn new methods and help determine which approaches deserve further development.About Holobeam
Holobeam Technologies is a medical technology company developing advanced imaging technologies with the goal of improving clinical care and helping save lives.Our team works at the intersection of medical imaging, computer vision, machine learning, image processing and emerging imaging technologies.

Our innovative products and solutions promote healthy living, elevating the lives of consumers every day. This business unit includes Braun, PUR, Honeywell, Vicks, Hot Tools, Drybar, Curlsmith, and Revlon brands, and this role may support one or more of these brands.

Look around your home, and you'll find us everywhere, in your kitchen, living room, bedroom, and bathroom. We are already making your everyday lives better. We are powered by knowledgeable, enthusiastic, and forward-thinking people committed to developing a culture of inclusion. Whether you are just starting your career or in need of a challenge, we recognize, develop, and empower talent!

Position: Associate Media Manager, Wellness

Department: Marketing for PUR, Braun, Vicks & Honeywell

Work Location: Marlborough, MA or Boston, MA (Hybrid; 3 days onsite per week). Employees based in Boston will be expected to work from the Marlborough office one day per week.

Hybrid Schedule: At Helen of Troy, we embrace a flexible hybrid work model designed to support collaboration and productivity. For roles eligible for hybrid work, our standard schedule includes in-office collaboration from Tuesday through Thursday, with the option to work remotely on Mondays and Fridays. Any updates to this model will be communicated in advance. Please note that hybrid eligibility and schedules may vary based on business needs and manager expectations.

What You Will Be Doing

We are seeking a data-driven and collaborative Associate Media Manager to support paid media strategy and execution for the Beauty & Wellness portfolio, including medical devices and air & water solutions. This role will help drive brand awareness, consumer acquisition, and revenue growth through optimized media campaigns across digital channels. The Associate Media Manager plays a pivotal role in shaping how consumers discover, engage with, and ultimately choose our portfolio of brands. As the day‑to‑day connective tissue between Brand Marketing, Sales, Creative, Analytics, and our media agency partners, you’ll help bring breakthrough campaigns to life and ensure they perform against business goals. This is an ideal role for someone who loves data-driven insights, thrives in cross‑functional environments, and wants to help build the future of wellness through smart, data‑driven activation.

The ideal candidate brings experience in consumer products or regulated categories, strong analytical skills, and a passion for improving consumer experience through effective media strategy.

Media Planning & Execution 

Support development and execution of full‑funnel paid media campaigns across digital, social, search, retail media, programmatic, and emerging channels for Wellness Brands. Translate brand and business goals into actionable media plans, calendars, and launch requirements. Partner closely with our media agency to ensure activation excellence, accurate flowcharts, and on‑time delivery for annual and tentpole campaigns. 

Performance Management & Optimization 

Monitor in‑flight performance across channels, tracking KPIs such as ROAS, CTR, CPC, conversion rate, and New‑to‑Brand sales for Beauty & Wellness, with a focus on Amazon media. Vet live tactics with agency partners and recommend agile optimizations to improve efficiency and scale. Build clear, insight‑driven reporting for internal teams with actionable next steps. 

Insights, Forecasting & Strategy Support 

Leverage consumer insights, market trends, and competitive intelligence to inform media strategy. Support testing agendas (A/B creative testing, audience segmentation, channel mix) to drive continuous improvement. Cross-Functional Collaboration

Serve as the day‑to‑day bridge between Brand, Sales, Creative, eCommerce, and the media agency. Provide creative teams with channel specific guidance to ensure assets meet platform best practices. Budget & Vendor Management 

Track pacing, actualization, and budget adherence across campaigns. Support agency management, ensuring clarity on deliverables, timelines, and performance expectations. Investigate performance trends and push partners toward continuous improvement.

rows.title: Implementation Specialist, Travel - US
rows.descriptionText:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

The Role

The Implementation team is responsible for the onboarding of all our Premium and Pro customers on the TravelPerk platform. The Implementation team takes new customers from signup to launch, providing administrative, technical, and educational support to maximize the client’s experience with the TravelPerk platform.

What you’ll be doing:

You will ensure that new clients are fully prepared to use TravelPerk to book their business travel, in both technical configuration and user readiness. You will configure client accounts to their specifications & requirements and set them up to meet client needs. You will also coordinate, tailor, and perform training sessions with Admins, Travelers, and other key client stakeholders to optimize their use of TravelPerk, as well as provide client-specific recommendations for how they execute their rollout, guiding their implementation and roll-out timeline, and internal communications.

The Implementation Specialist role requires strong project and change management skills and excellent problem-solving skills. This role requires keen attention to detail, creativity in solutions, and proactivity to identify areas where they can provide improvements to their clients & their internal team.

Implementation specialists work across multiple teams in a collaborative environment both internally & externally, manage key internal and external stakeholders, and use change management to drive successful client rollouts and enable long-term success.

Your responsibilities include:

Providing the first impression of TravelPerk to all customers in your portfolio and serving as the first point of contact for clients during the implementation process.Carrying out consultative conversations with customers to collect their requirements.Answering client requirements with your experience & data-driven best practice recommendations.Managing the rollout of a new platform for your clients; providing guides, templates, and recommendations to the client for how to ensure adoption & long-term success of the platform.Coordinating & conducting training sessions for newly onboarded customers, including executive-level stakeholders and company-wide training.Providing technical support to clients as they set up integrations to marketplace partners or custom-built API solutions.Validating client configuration & account satisfaction by monitoring client booking behavior post-implementation & proactively offering support or recommendations.Collaborating with multiple different departments in the TK organization, including within the Revenue organization (Sales and Account Management), Product, Builders (Engineering), and Finance.Analyzing completed implementation work to find ways to improve your own process & that of the team.Embracing a pattern of execute, assess, improve, repeat & evolving as the team & organization evolves.

What we look for:

A customer-first mentality; you’ll focus on ensuring a smooth onboarding for your clients and must understand what they need to be a happy customer for the long term.Proven track record of successfully managing and delivering complex projects in a fast-paced environment.Demonstrated ability to work with C-level stakeholders to collect their requirements and or concerns in a clear, concise, and professional manner.Ability to develop relationships with all levels of the organization, both internally and externally, and adapt communication & approach accordingly.A proactive approach to making recommendations to both clients & internal stakeholders.Willingness to seek out ways to improve & a mindset of continuous improvement.Excited by challenges and have a personal drive to make a difference.

What do we offer?

Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in PerkRest and recharge with our generous allocation of 20 vacation days and 12 public holidaysEnjoy the flexibility of three medical plans to choose from, with company contributions and an HSA when enrolling in an HDHP medical planTake control of your physical health with additional comprehensive benefit plans, covering dental, vision and Wellhub’s gym subscription from your start dateRest assured that you’re covered by life and disability policies from your start date, with options to add extra protection through voluntary buy-up plansPlan for your future with our 401(k) plan with company matching contributionsCare for your furry friends through partner discounts on pet insuranceJoin our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer partyAlways feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved onesFocus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leaveContribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causesBroaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year

Compensation: 

Compensation for this role is a combination of salary, commissions, and stock options. The base salary is $79,000, and the OTE is $91,000 (base + commission), plus equity. The commission structure will be tied to achieving revenue & retention targets.

AI at Perk

AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

Compensation Range: $91K

rows.title: Onboarding Specialist
rows.descriptionText:
The Onboarding Specialist is responsible for the coordination and completion of all aspects of the onboarding process for new hires and rehires within UG2, including conducting social security number verification and submission of applicable background check requests. The Onboarding Specialist is responsible for understanding and effectively interpreting and applying UG2’s hiring policies and procedures, ensuring that all required clearances are completed and accurately documented within the HR guidelines. The Onboarding Specialist will ensure that no individual commences their employment/engagement with UG2 unless each step has been satisfactorily completed as per the hiring policy.

Job Responsibilities

Serve as primary contact for the onboarding process for new hires and rehires, from generating conditional offer of employment letters to ensuring the accurate completion of all required paperwork, verification of acceptable employment documentation and onboarding process steps. Respond to various requests regarding onboarding procedures and UG2 related policies from new hires and managers. Conduct pre-employment verifications such as social security number and background screening. Responsible for accurate and timely data entry of onboarding documents information into ADP System to ensure timely activation within payroll, IT and other UG2 systems as required. Maintain the accuracy and compliance of all new hire personnel folders; paper and or electronic file including scanning as required. Perform filing of new hire personnel folders and I-9 forms. Responsible for self-auditing own data entry and employee files for accuracy and required documentation. Deliver an excellent customer service experience by facilitating a welcoming and seamless onboarding experience. Build and maintain strong working relationships with key UG2 stakeholders. Attend start-up onboarding sessions to collect necessary paperwork (local and travel).Coordinate with new managers monthly onboarding paperwork training.Other duties as assign by the Team Lead.

Key Interactions

Engage with all leaders and stakeholders. Engage with new and current employees.Partner with VP of People and HR Team.

Requirements (Knowledge, Abilities, Skills, And Education And/or Experience

One to two years of onboarding and/or HR related experience is preferred.Must be able to work in a structured and process driven environment that demands high quality standards.Demonstrated service delivery experience to include direct engagement with internal and external customers.Excellent communication and people skills; must be able to effectively communicate at all levels of the organization.Proficiency in Microsoft Office and other related products.Ability to meet multiple deadlines and identify/solve problems accordingly.Good analytical thinking and attention to detail skills.Discretion with confidential information.Good verbal and presentation skills.Bilingual – English/Spanish.

Working Conditions And/or Physical Requirements

Office-based role with potential for occasional visits to operational sites.Ability to lift up to 45 pounds.Attention to detail, organization skills, and the ability to work in various physical positions, including standing, sitting, and walking.

About UG2

At UG2, a leader in facility services, we are committed to innovation, excellence, and client satisfaction. We are committed to developing the strongest customer relationships and the highest service delivery benchmarks in the marketplace.

Founded in 2012, UG2 is privately held and headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts. We also have regional offices in Chicago, Washington, D.C., New York City, West Palm Beach, Los Angeles, Sunnyvale, and Dallas.

rows.title: Salesforce Consulting Senior Associate
rows.descriptionText:
At PwC, our people in business application consulting specialise in consulting services for a variety of business applications, helping clients optimise operational efficiency. These individuals analyse client needs, implement software solutions, and provide training and support for seamless integration and utilisation of business applications, enabling clients to achieve their strategic objectives.

As a Salesforce consulting generalist at PwC, you will possess a broad range of consulting skills and experience across various Salesforce applications. You will provide consulting services to clients, analysing their needs, implementing software solutions, and offering training and support for effective utilisation of Salesforce applications. Your versatile knowledge will allow you to assist clients in optimising operational efficiency and achieving their strategic objectives.

Focused on relationships, you are building meaningful client connections, and learning how to manage and inspire others. Navigating increasingly complex situations, you are growing your personal brand, deepening technical expertise and awareness of your strengths. You are expected to anticipate the needs of your teams and clients, and to deliver quality. Embracing increased ambiguity, you are comfortable when the path forward isn’t clear, you ask questions, and you use these moments as opportunities to grow.

Skills

Examples of the skills, knowledge, and experiences you need to lead and deliver value at this level include but are not limited to:

Respond effectively to the diverse perspectives, needs, and feelings of others.

Use a broad range of tools, methodologies and techniques to generate new ideas and solve problems.

Use critical thinking to break down complex concepts.

Understand the broader objectives of your project or role and how your work fits into the overall strategy.

Develop a deeper understanding of the business context and how it is changing.

Use reflection to develop self awareness, enhance strengths and address development areas.

Interpret data to inform insights and recommendations.

Uphold and reinforce professional and technical standards (e.g. refer to specific PwC tax and audit guidance), the Firm's code of conduct, and independence requirements.

The Opportunity

As part of the Salesforce Consulting team you develop and implement scalable technical solutions that meet client requirements. As a Senior Associate, you guide and mentor junior team members while navigating complex challenges to deliver quality work and build meaningful client relationships.

Responsibilities

 Analyze and interpret data to provide actionable insights Develop strategies to enhance Salesforce applications Uphold professional standards and exemplary practices in consulting Proactively identify and address potential project risks

 Bachelor's Degree 3 years of experience

rows.title: Implementation Specialist, Travel - US
rows.descriptionText:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

The Role

The Implementation team is responsible for the onboarding of all our Premium and Pro customers on the TravelPerk platform. The Implementation team takes new customers from signup to launch, providing administrative, technical, and educational support to maximize the client’s experience with the TravelPerk platform.

What you’ll be doing:

You will ensure that new clients are fully prepared to use TravelPerk to book their business travel, in both technical configuration and user readiness. You will configure client accounts to their specifications & requirements and set them up to meet client needs. You will also coordinate, tailor, and perform training sessions with Admins, Travelers, and other key client stakeholders to optimize their use of TravelPerk, as well as provide client-specific recommendations for how they execute their rollout, guiding their implementation and roll-out timeline, and internal communications.

The Implementation Specialist role requires strong project and change management skills and excellent problem-solving skills. This role requires keen attention to detail, creativity in solutions, and proactivity to identify areas where they can provide improvements to their clients & their internal team.

Implementation specialists work across multiple teams in a collaborative environment both internally & externally, manage key internal and external stakeholders, and use change management to drive successful client rollouts and enable long-term success.

Your responsibilities include:

Providing the first impression of TravelPerk to all customers in your portfolio and serving as the first point of contact for clients during the implementation process.Carrying out consultative conversations with customers to collect their requirements.Answering client requirements with your experience & data-driven best practice recommendations.Managing the rollout of a new platform for your clients; providing guides, templates, and recommendations to the client for how to ensure adoption & long-term success of the platform.Coordinating & conducting training sessions for newly onboarded customers, including executive-level stakeholders and company-wide training.Providing technical support to clients as they set up integrations to marketplace partners or custom-built API solutions.Validating client configuration & account satisfaction by monitoring client booking behavior post-implementation & proactively offering support or recommendations.Collaborating with multiple different departments in the TK organization, including within the Revenue organization (Sales and Account Management), Product, Builders (Engineering), and Finance.Analyzing completed implementation work to find ways to improve your own process & that of the team.Embracing a pattern of execute, assess, improve, repeat & evolving as the team & organization evolves.

What we look for:

A customer-first mentality; you’ll focus on ensuring a smooth onboarding for your clients and must understand what they need to be a happy customer for the long term.Proven track record of successfully managing and delivering complex projects in a fast-paced environment.Demonstrated ability to work with C-level stakeholders to collect their requirements and or concerns in a clear, concise, and professional manner.Ability to develop relationships with all levels of the organization, both internally and externally, and adapt communication & approach accordingly.A proactive approach to making recommendations to both clients & internal stakeholders.Willingness to seek out ways to improve & a mindset of continuous improvement.Excited by challenges and have a personal drive to make a difference.

What do we offer?

Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in PerkRest and recharge with our generous allocation of 20 vacation days and 12 public holidaysEnjoy the flexibility of three medical plans to choose from, with company contributions and an HSA when enrolling in an HDHP medical planTake control of your physical health with additional comprehensive benefit plans, covering dental, vision and Wellhub’s gym subscription from your start dateRest assured that you’re covered by life and disability policies from your start date, with options to add extra protection through voluntary buy-up plansPlan for your future with our 401(k) plan with company matching contributionsCare for your furry friends through partner discounts on pet insuranceJoin our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer partyAlways feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved onesFocus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leaveContribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causesBroaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year

Compensation: 

Compensation for this role is a combination of salary, commissions, and stock options. The base salary is $79,000, and the OTE is $91,000 (base + commission), plus equity. The commission structure will be tied to achieving revenue & retention targets.

AI at Perk

AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

Compensation Range: $91K

This role is responsible for maintaining strong relationships, ensuring accurate and timely contract processing, and resolving post-sale issues to deliver high-quality client experience throughout the contract lifecycle.

Frequent use of keyboard, mouse, phone, and standard office equipment. Occasional standing, walking, bending, and lifting of standard office materials up to 25 poundsSchedule expectations: Standard business hours with flexibility as needed for client, supplier, contract-processing, or issue-resolution needs

 What else can we offer you?

Job Description Summary

Focus Partners is seeking a Client Service Associate to join our growing team! The Client Service Associate role is an exciting opportunity to work with a team that takes a comprehensive approach to financial planning, delivering personalized advice aligned with each client’s goals and long-term priorities.

In this role, you will partner closely with Wealth Advisors to support and strengthen client relationships, serving as the primary point of contact for operational and service needs. You’ll take ownership of requests from start to finish, manage multiple timelines, and ensure work is completed accurately and thoughtfully. This is a role for someone who takes pride in getting the details right, communicates clearly, and who has the desire to grow within a collaborative team.

Focus provides team members the flexibility to work a hybrid schedule. Our hybrid model is defined as 3 days in office work required per week, while giving team members the option to work remotely 2 day per week, or as assigned by their team leader.

Job Description

Primary Responsibilities

Deliver accurate, timely service to advisors and clients with a “one-contact resolution” mindset, taking full ownership of issues through final resolution.Serve as the primary liaison among custodians, the operations team, advisors, and clients, providing end-to-end operational support including account openings, maintenance, asset transfers, money movement, required documentation, and proactive follow-through on client- and advisor-initiated requests.Act as a strong advocate for our clients, demonstrating empathy and understanding of their requests and needs.Manage and prioritize multiple advisor and client requests across email, Microsoft Teams, phone, and Salesforce while providing excellent service.Maintain clear, proactive communication with advisors and clients, providing timely updates and managing expectations.Ensure precision and consistency in processing requests and transactions, recognizing the importance of accuracy in a fiduciary environment.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree with 1+ years relevant experience (including internships).Strong self-initiated follow-through, time management, and problem-solving skills, with consistent accuracy and care.Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, and proven ability to learn other software and technology. Salesforce experience preferred. Clear and effective written and verbal communication skills. Demonstrates sound judgment and discretion when handling sensitive client information and financial transactions.Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment while working both independently and collaboratively.Strong interest in financial planning and investments, with a desire to grow and develop in the role.

This position is a non-exempt position. The annualized base pay range for this role is expected to be between $60,000-$65,000 base salary compensation range. Actual base pay may vary based on factors including, but not limited to, experience, subject matter expertise, geographic location where work will be performed, and the applicant’s skill set. The base pay is just one component of the total compensation package. Other rewards may include an annual cash bonus and a comprehensive benefits package, including but not limited to medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and 401(k). rows.descriptionText:
Applicants for this position must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship. Trinity is unable to consider candidates requiring sponsorship for visas, including but not limited to TN, H1-B, F-1, and STEM OPT.

Position Summary

We are seeking talented and committed individuals with strong analytical and critical thinking skills to join our Primary Market Research (PMR) practice area as Associates. With a primary focus on PMR responsibilities, the PMR Associates will interact closely with other staff, management, and leadership to deliver actionable and insight driven solutions for clients. This environment provides Associates with exposure to a wide variety of primary market research methods and an opportunity to gain in depth knowledge of how PMR insights drive commercial decision making in the life sciences industry. On each project, Associates help gather information, create and interpret analyses, and develop presentations of research findings. Their work is the base upon which our strategic recommendations that drive our client’s decisions are ultimately grounded. Associates develop their skills through undergoing comprehensive formal and informal training, as well as receiving mentorship that encourages them to stretch their skills.

Essential Functions

Draft materials for research (screeners, discussion guides, stimuli, surveys)Support field work and recruiting of PMR respondentsAnalyze qualitative and quantitative primary market research dataHelp craft takeaways and implications for the client based on study findingsDevelop a highly visual PowerPoint presentation of study findings

Work Experience: 0-2 years of experience in consulting, primary market research or other relevant areas within the life sciences industry

Other Skills

Trinity powers the future of life sciences commercialization through the fusion of human and artificial intelligence. By blending deep therapeutic expertise and trusted human ingenuity with a purpose-built technology platform, Trinity accelerates clarity and confidence at every step of the commercialization journey—from pre-launch to scale to loss of exclusivity. For more than 30 years, the world’s leading pharmaceutical, biotech, and medtech companies have relied on Trinity’s foresight, execution, and partnership to deliver confident product launches, decisive market advantage, and measurable patient impact. During that time, Trinity expanded from its first office in Waltham, MA to 1,300 professionals across 14 offices and five continents, setting new industry standards in quality, responsiveness, and client partnership. rows.descriptionText:
About Morgan Stanley

Morgan Stanley is a leading global financial services firm providing a wide range of investment banking, securities, wealth management and investment management services. For further information about Morgan Stanley, please visit www.morganstanley.com.

Parametric is part of Morgan Stanley Investment Management, the asset management division of Morgan Stanley. A leader in custom solutions for more than 30 years, we help investors access efficient market exposures, solve implementation challenges, and design multi-asset portfolios that respond to their evolving needs. We also offer systematic alpha and alternative strategies to complement clients' core holdings.

This role is part of Parametric's hybrid working model, which includes working in the office 3 days a week and choosing to work remotely or in the office the remaining days of the week.

About The Role

The Analyst, Client Reporting is primarily responsible for client reporting, qualitative and quantitative analysis for the Institutional and Wealth Management sales organizations. The position will require teamwork and collaboration with multiple departments. Although interactions with the end client are limited, the role is focused on providing exceptional client service through timely and accurate analysis and reporting.

Primary Responsibilities

Prepare quarterly, monthly and ad hoc analysis and client reporting for institutional and/or wealth management clients.Perform detailed review of client deliverables.Design, prepare and review custom institutional client reports utilizing Factset, Excel, and Word.Assist with designing tactical reporting solutions for new products.Manage the timely and accurate delivery of all requests.Investigate portfolio specific inquiries.Develop a specialized knowledge of all relevant Parametric products and strategies.Uphold department reputation through professionalism, accuracy, responsiveness and commitment to client service.Develop a full working knowledge of the firm's structure, key personnel and organizational policies and procedures, in addition to a functional knowledge of a professional services environment.Assume other responsibilities as required.

Job Requirements

4-year degree, preferably in related discipline such as economics or finance.2-4 years of industry experience.Strong math/quantitative skills and analytical writing ability.Proficient in Excel including using V-Lookup and PivotTables.Ability to excel independently and in ambiguous situations.Ability to maintain productivity and strong work ethic under minimal supervision.Working knowledge of statistics and familiarity with the principles of portfolio management.Possess excellent communication and organizational skills and be able to handle a heavy, deadline-oriented workload.Ability to successfully manage and coordinate simultaneous multiple-level projects and tasks with internal departments.High attention to detail and strong sense of urgency.Must possess a high level of initiative.Familiarity with Factset, Bloomberg and other analysis tools is a plus.Proficiency in macro and code writing is a plus.Completion of Level I or higher of the CFA program a plus.

What You Can Expect From Morgan Stanley

Our values - putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back - aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. Salary range for the position: $60,000-$90,000/Yr. The successful candidate may be eligible for an annual discretionary incentive compensation award. Morgan Stanley offers a full spectrum of benefits, including Medical, Prescription Drug, Dental, Vision, Health Savings Account, Dependent Day Care Savings Account, Life Insurance, Disability and Other Insurance Plans, Paid Time Off (including Sick Leave consistent with state and local law, Parental Leave and 20 Vacation Days annually), 10 Paid Holidays, 401(k), and Short/Long Term Disability, in addition to other special perks reserved for our employees. rows.title: Data Scientist I
rows.descriptionText:
Salary Range: $91,500 - $104,000 per year

Location: Boston, MA

This is a Boston based opportunity with a 4 day in office expectation (Monday - Thursday) with 1 day remote (Friday).

At this time, Wayfair will not sponsor applicants for employment authorization for this position for the following work visas: STEM OPT EAD, H-1B, H-1B1, E-3, O-1, J-1, or TN.

Wayfair is continuing to expand our commitment to hiring and supporting talent early in their careers, focusing on filling opportunities with recent graduates who have 0-3 years of work experience. We are continually recruiting candidates for this position on a rolling basis as we have a high volume of openings that become available.

Who We Are

Wayfair is on a mission to find the most talented engineers entering the tech world! Do you love innovating and creating new tools from scratch? We’re looking for engineers who love

Wayfair is looking for candidates who are passionate about programming, and have strong core fundamentals. If you feel confident in your knowledge of object oriented design, data structures, & algorithms and your ability to grow your skills over time, please apply! We want to connect with developers who are eager to work in a highly collaborative team and add to Wayfair’s culture. You will have the opportunity to work on one of the following teams:sharing ideas, collaborating to improve them, and being a part of the full software development process. Our engineers are enthusiastic problem solvers and our teams are highly collaborative.

What You’ll Do

Build scalable analytics products in SQL, Python, and G-Suite visualization platforms (LookerStudio, Looker) that enable leadership and other internal customers to understand and manage performance, including forward looking models that evaluate the impact of our strategy on fulfillment activities, resourcing, and costsBuild automated infrastructure in Google Cloud Composer to load and transform data, run models or analytical frameworks, and update front end dashboards. Perform statistical analysis across large data sets to develop performance insights and forward looking projections of business outcomesMake demand forecasting model enhancements to account for new business strategies that drive specific demand patternsBuild segment level performance projections to develop holistic views which indicate company wide trajectory across various operational KPIEstablish data structures that enable scalability in the processes and tools to monitor CG inventory performance across key KPIs (turns, availability, penetration, positioning) and allow for adjacent teams to consume that dataCommunicate findings with colleagues from computer science, operations research and business backgrounds

What You’ll Need

Basic Qualifications

MS in a quantitative field (Engineering, Operations Research, Mathematics, Economics) with a strong academic recordA highly analytical individual who can give structure to complex and often ambiguous data and modeling problemsExceptional analytics skill set, including a high degree of comfort / expertise with Python and relational databases (SQL) on a daily basis with proven track record of insight development leading to actionComfort operating with large data sets to identify trends, drill into specific details, make recommendations, and deliver upon desired outcomesHigh attention to detail with ability to appropriately manage and prioritize projects and tasks appropriately that leads to resultsInnovative problem-solving skills with a tenacity to develop ideas independently and thrive in a fast-paced start-up environmentPassionate about tackling complex supply-chain business problems from problem definition and business-case development to implementationAuthorization to work in the United States without visa sponsorship by Wayfair now or in the future. This includes the following work visas: STEM OPT EAD, H-1B, H-1B1, E-3, O-1, J-1, or TN.

Preferred Qualifications

Demonstrated ability to design, build, and own data pipelines end-to-end, ensuring data accuracy, scalability, and reliabilityDemonstrated curiosity and interest in Artificial Intelligence and its applications in analytics and business

Possible placements span both our Technology and Commercial & Operations organizations. On the Technology side, you may join customer-facing teams that power our storefront experience or our fintech and loyalty products, building data foundations, experimentation frameworks, and analytics that shape how customers discover, shop, and pay at Wayfair. On the Commercial & Operations side, you may work on teams focused on supply chain, forecasting and replenishment, network planning, or broader operations analytics, using data to optimize inventory, delivery speed, cost, and overall customer experience. Team placement is finalized during the hiring process, and all roles offer close partnership with product, engineering, and business stakeholders.

Why You’ll Love Wayfair

Benefits & Perks

Full health benefits available (Medical, Dental, Vision, HSA/FSA) on day one for eligible employees.No-cost access to 2nd.MD, a virtual expert medical consultation and navigation service.Global Traveler Health Insurance through GeoBlue.24/7 access to mental, financial, physical and emotional wellbeing support, plus an enhanced offering of therapy and coaching.Automatic enrollment into Basic Life and Accidental Death & Disability Insurance.401(k) matching with immediate vesting.Paid Parental Leave, Surrogacy & Adoption Reimbursement and Caregiver Services.Tuition Reimbursement.Wayfair Employee Discount.Gym/Fitness Discounts.Exclusive access to thousands of perks & discounts through BenefitHub.Yearly match up to $500 for personal donations made by employees to registered 501(c)(3) nonprofits.

Purpose & Inclusion At Wayfair

At Wayfair, we pride ourselves on fostering an environment where every individual experiences a fair and equitable employee journey. We do this by leveraging our best assets, such as collaborating with leading nonprofit organizations, coordinating in-kind product donations, empowering our employees to get involved through paid volunteer time off programs, and encouraging our customers to donate. rows.title: Claims Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
The Claims Analyst will be responsible for supporting the effective management of claims portfolios through data analysis, forecasting, and reporting, providing insights into claim trends and financial performance to inform decision-making in line with Group Claims processes.
ResponsibilitiesAnalyze claims data across managed portfolios to identify trends, patterns, and key drivers of loss performanceSupport claims forecasting activities, including projections of loss development, reserves, and financial outcomesPrepare and maintain regular management reporting on claims performance, key metrics, and emerging trendsPartner with Claims, Finance, Actuary, IT, and Operations teams to validate data accuracy and ensure consistency across reporting outputsMonitor and analyze variances between actuals and forecasts, providing insights and recommendations to support decision-makingDevelop and enhance reporting tools, dashboards, and data models to improve visibility into claims performanceSupport the identification and remediation of unreconciled data, reporting, and systems-related gaps impacting claims analytics and forecasting capabilitiesContribute to initiatives aimed at improving consistency and standardization across claims processes, including controls, KPIs, and governance practicesProvide analytical support for portfolio reviews, including evaluation of resource needs, alignment with forecasted claims outcomes, and overview of portfolio performanceAssist in tracking and prioritizing operational and reporting improvements to enhance readiness, scalability, and overall claims performanceEnsure data integrity and compliance with internal controls, reporting standards, and Group Claims policiesWork with external stakeholders to fulfill any claims related requests, including loss runs, data calls and other time-sensitive mattersSupport ad hoc analysis requests related to claims performance, portfolio trends, and emerging risks

rows.title: Data Automation Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Company Overview:Cerulli Associates (CA) is a research and consulting firm, headquartered in Boston, specializing in product and distribution analysis for the global asset management industry. Since 1992, we have blended primary research and data analysis to bring perspective to current market conditions and forecasts for future developments. With a suite of research publications, an interactive data platform, and custom research and consulting offerings, we provide financial services firms with unparalleled guidance in strategic positioning and new business development.
Cerulli Associates is a 2023, 2024, and 2025 Boston Globe Top Places to Work. We are proud to be recognized for our outstanding employee engagement, management, work-life balance, and benefits.
Our clients include virtually all the top 50 global asset management firms, as well as industry service providers, management consulting companies, banks, broker/dealers, insurance companies, investment consulting firms, and private equity firms.
Position Overview:The Data Automation Analyst will help expand and strengthen Cerulli Associates’ data automation capabilities. Their primary focus will be on reusable data-processing, benchmarking, reporting, and validation workflows that support the firm’s research, publishing, and consulting work.
The successful candidate will combine hands-on technical implementation with careful analytical judgment. This person will work within an evolving modern data environment, contribute to the adoption of stronger data and development practices, and help improve the reliability, scalability, and usability of Cerulli’s data products and workflows. This role will help strengthen the reliable, reusable data foundation needed for analytics, automation, and emerging AI-enabled capabilities.
This role is designed for someone with experience working with real business data and recurring workflows who wants to grow from strong implementation into greater technical ownership and solution development. The position reports to the Associate Director, Data Strategy, and is based in the Boston office. Cerulli operates a hybrid work model, with employees working in the office two days per week.
Responsibilities and Duties:Build, run, validate, and improve reusable data automation and reporting workflowsUse Python and SQL to transform, reconcile, and prepare data for analysis and business deliverablesContribute to cloud-based data pipelines, transformation models, notebooks, and configuration-driven processesDevelop and improve automated checks, regression tests, diagnostics, and validation proceduresInvestigate data and workflow issues through structured root-cause analysis and implement practical correctionsStandardize and align data across reporting periods to support consistent historical analysisMaintain clear technical documentation, process guides, configuration files, and data definitionsPartner with research analysts, Editorial, survey specialists, IT, and other stakeholders to understand workflow requirements and validate outputsIdentify recurring issues, edge cases, and opportunities that should become shared logic, tests, or reusable enhancementsCompare implementation options, communicate tradeoffs, and constructively identify risks, gaps, or assumptions requiring reviewSupport selected improvements to data access, data products, pipeline performance, and AI-assisted data experiences as priorities evolve
Qualifications:Bachelor’s degree in computer science, data analytics, information systems, statistics, or a related field2 to 4 years of relevant professional experience in data analytics, data engineering, process automation, business intelligence, or a related field; candidates with at least 1 year of especially relevant experience may be consideredStrong fundamentals in Python and SQLAbility to troubleshoot systematically and communicate findings clearlyAbility to collaborate with technical and nontechnical stakeholders, ask effective questions, and challenge assumptions constructivelyExperience with dbt, Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, Git, or similar data platforms and development practices is preferredExperience with survey data, longitudinal data, wide datasets, configurable reporting, or automated document generation is preferredExperience with financial services, market research, publishing, consulting, or data products is a plus
Salary:$80,000 – $100,000

rows.title: Senior Analyst, Paid Media
rows.descriptionText:
Location: Cambridge, MA / Hybrid

(This role requires working in-office 3 days per week: Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday.)

About Us

EverQuote is a leading AI-powered growth solutions partner for regulated property and casualty insurance entities, enabling the largest insurance carriers and thousands of agents to maximize customer acquisition across digital channels. Fueled by our proprietary data assets and our AI traffic engine, EverQuote is transforming the way providers attract and engage consumers to grow market share.

Joining our team puts you at the forefront of this transformation. You will collaborate with a group of builders to solve complex problems and reshape a massive industry. If you want to drive real-world impact and do the best work of your career, you’ve found your home. We move fast, follow the data, and hold ourselves to high standards. If that's how you work too, this is the role for you.

About The Role

As Senior Analyst, Paid Media, you will own television, connected TV, streaming video, YouTube, and streaming audio for EverQuote’s consumer growth businesses. These are new and fast-growing channels for us, and you will be the single owner: planning, buying, optimizing, and proving out what works.

You will report to the Manager, Paid Media, and work closely with Data Science, Marketing, and Finance. This is a high-ownership role with significant budget and no existing playbook. We are looking for a hands-on video and audio buyer and a strong analyst who can show leadership where the channel works and how to scale it.

What You’ll Do

Own end-to-end planning, buying, and optimization of CTV, streaming video, YouTube, linear TV, and streaming audio campaigns.Manage budgets, flighting, and pacing against monthly and quarterly targets; forecast spend and flag risk early.Serve as the primary day-to-day contact for our media agency - brief campaigns, review media plans and post-logs, hold the agency accountable to performance and process commitments.Build and manage direct relationships with platform and publisher partners; evaluate new inventory, beta programs, and pricing opportunities.Partner with Data Science on measurement: incrementality and geo lift testing, media mix model inputs, reach and frequency management, brand lift studies, and cross-channel attribution.Work with creative to build a video and audio testing roadmap; manage asset specs, trafficking, and creative rotation.Report on channel performance to marketing leadership with a clear read on what is working, what is not, and what we are changing.Partner with finance on accruals, billing reconciliation, and budget re-forecasts.

What You Bring To The Team

2+ years of hands-on paid media experience with meaningful time spent on video and/or audio buying - not solely search or social.Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics or related field OR demonstrated analytical ability or equivalent hands-on professional experience.Demonstrated experience running CTV and YouTube campaigns, including hands-on work in the relevant buying platforms (for example DV360, Google Ads, Amazon DSP, The Trade Desk, Netflix, Hulu, or comparable).Experience managing or working closely with a media agency: briefing, plan review, negotiation, and performance management.Experience working directly with platform, publisher, or network partners.Comfortable owning a substantial budget with accountability for efficiency metrics, not just execution.Strong analytical skills - able to work in spreadsheets and BI tools, interrogate performance data, and connect channel metrics to business outcomes.Clear written and verbal communication; able to present a point of view to leadership and push back on an agency.

Nice To Have

Streaming audio buying experience (for example Spotify, Pandora, iHeart, Audacy, or podcast networks).Linear TV and Connected-TV experience, including national and local buying.Direct-response or performance-oriented TV and audio background rather than purely brand.Experience with incrementality or geo-based testing methodology.Insurance, fintech, or another high-consideration, heavily regulated category. (good to have, not required)Familiarity with ad ops and measurement tooling relevant to video and audio.Exposure to attribution solution such as Media mix modeling 

The base salary actually offered for this position is determined by several factors, including the applicant's job-related skills, relevant experience, education or training, and work location. The base salary for this full-time hybrid role is $90,000 - $115,000.

In addition to base salary, our total compensation package may include participation in variable cash bonus programs, equity, and a comprehensive range of health, welfare, and wellbeing benefits based on eligibility which are designated by role.

Your recruiter can provide more details about additional compensation components, such as OTE structure, bonus targets, or equity, during the hiring process.

This position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship, now or in the future. Candidates must be able to work in the U.S. without the need for employer-sponsored visa support.

Reasonable accommodations are available for applicants with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs or practices, upon request.

For more information, visit https://investors.everquote.com and follow on LinkedIn.
