 Builds multiple versions of planograms based on pre-established assortment, clustering nuances, fixture variations, merchandising guidelines, and retailer-specific requirements, while simultaneously developing customer-specific Gold Standard POG recommendations that optimize product flow, brand blocking, adjacencies, capacity, and execution feasibility to drive immediate merchandising objectives and support long-term category growth, shopper navigation, and strategic retailer goals. Reviews, validates, and revises planograms for adherence to retailer strategy, merchandising standards, fixture /labor realities, and execution readiness. Manages relay execution for assigned categories, including workload forecasting, project coordination, deadlines, and issue resolution required for successful implementation. Provides planogram support for display merchandising where applicable, including virtual store environments, 3D product builds, video tours, promotional concepts, and customer-facing visual assets that communicate the merchandising story.

Assortment, Layout & Shelf Strategy Support

 Supports assortment and layout strategy development by translating shopper, category, retailer, and performance insights into informed shelf recommendations. Contributes to planogram testing, heat mapping, clustering evaluations, fixture alternatives, and shelf construct analysis to improve category and brand outcomes. Provides analytical support for innovation, renovation, and new item/segment display considerations as needed.

Reporting, Analytics & Decision Support

 Conducts ad hoc analytics to answer business questions from Customer Merchants, Category Advisors, Category Leadership Managers, and non-advising teams. Supports business reviews and insights development using available resources such as Circana, JDA/Blue Yonder, retailer data, and internal reporting. Measures effectiveness of planogram, assortment, and shelving actions by connecting execution outputs to performance indicators where available.

Tools, Data & Capability Enablement

 Helps develop and improve the planogram toolbox, including standardized tables, templates, reporting views, process documents, and shared knowledge resources. Identifies opportunities to test, validate, and scale tools or automation that improve planogram development, reporting, and execution efficiency. Supports onboarding, training content, and best-practice sharing for analysts, field category teams, and partners using planogram or space planning tools. Maintains strong relationships with Shopper MX and key internal stakeholders to optimize merchandising tools, data integrity, digital assets, and operational processes, driving efficiencies, improving execution quality, and identifying scalable, cost-effective solutions that advance category management capabilities and customer outcomes.

Collaboration & Thought Leadership

 Acts as an efficient collaborator by sharing reporting, best practices, learnings, and reusable tools across divisions and customer teams. Brings forward-thinking recommendations through proposals, planogram testing insights, heat mapping, and scalable process improvements that support total Nestlé growth. Builds trusted relationships with Category Leadership, Space Planning Management, field sales, and cross-functional partners to improve quality, speed, and alignment.

Requirements

Education & Experience

 Bachelor’s degree in related field preferred, or equivalent combination of education and experience. 2+ years of experience in Space Management and/or Category Management; CPG and/or food industry experience required, with demonstrated ability to influence merchandising recommendations through buyer-facing storytelling, cross-functional partnership, and category strategy application.

Technical & Analytical Skills

 Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, especially Excel; advanced analytical aptitude and ability to develop business and category knowledge, including the expertise to simplify complex data into clear visuals, shelf stories, and executive-ready recommendations. Experience with Blue Yonder/JDA Space Management preferred; ability to use SQL, Python, or similar tools to improve data extraction, analysis, or planogram workflows a plus. Ability to use retailer, marketplace, shopper, category, and performance data to address business questions and improve merchandising recommendations.

Core Capabilities

 Strong project management, prioritization, and change-management skills with the ability to manage multiple deliverables independently and in a team environment. Excellent presentation, verbal, and written communication skills with the ability to translate analysis into clear recommendations. Demonstrates a meticulous attention to detail when developing and validating planograms, ensuring accurate product placement, compliance with retailer requirements, and flawless execution of best-in-class merchandising recommendations Demonstrated initiative, tenacity, curiosity, and problem-solving; willingness to challenge current ways of working and help build future-state capabilities. Ability to collaborate across Category Leadership, Field Sales, and cross-functional partners while sharing knowledge and best practices.

Travel

Approximately 15–25% to include national meetings, local customer meetings, store visits, and other business needs.

Bonus Eligibility: Yes

Develop strong relationships with retailer marketing and commercial teams to unlock shopper activation opportunities, better placements, and joint growth opportunities. 

What are we looking for?

10+ years of experience in CPG, preferably across Shopper Marketing, Customer Marketing, Brand Marketing, and/or Trade Marketing. Proven experience developing and leading omnichannel shopper marketing programs, integrating in-store, eCommerce, retail media, and digital activation to drive conversion and brand growth. Strong experience integrating shopper marketing into customer business plans, Joint Business Plans (JBPs), innovation launches, and channel growth strategies, with the ability to influence customer and internal commercial agendas. Strong commercial acumen, with the ability to connect shopper activations to business outcomes including revenue growth, incrementality, ROI, TDP gains, velocity, and promotional efficiency. Hands-on experience developing and leading retail media campaigns, with strong understanding of audience strategy, media optimization, attribution, and lower-funnel conversion. Strong analytical and shopper insights capabilities, including proficiency in syndicated and retailer data sources such as Nielsen, Circana, panel data, loyalty data, and point-of-sale analytics. Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams, partnering effectively across Brand, Sales and Digital teams to drive alignment and execution. Experience working directly with major US retailers and their marketing/commercial teams, with strong understanding of customer-specific activation principles. Experience managing shopper marketing budget including investment planning, allocation, and management. 

What can you expect from Champion?

Function: Transportation

Who We Are

For more than a century, L’Oréal has devoted its energy, innovation, and scientific excellence solely to one business: Beauty. Our goal is to offer each person around the world the best of beauty in terms of quality, efficacy, safety, sincerity and responsibility to satisfy all beauty needs and desires in their infinite diversity.

At L'Oréal Operations, we create innovative, inclusive, and sustainable beauty together with our business partners by designing, developing, sourcing, manufacturing, and distributing over 6 billion products globally every year. We support over 36 brands across four L’Oréal divisions. We are consumer-oriented, and we act responsibly all along the value chain.  

What You Will Do

 

Are you ready to lead one of the most dynamic, large-scale consumer goods transportation networks in North America?

As the Head of North America Transportation, you will own and transform the end-to-end physical flow of goods. Reporting directly to senior operations leadership within North America Fulfillment Services (NAFS), you will serve as the executive leader bridging day-to-day operational execution (Operate) with strategic capability building, governance, and digital transformation (Build & Adapt / NOE).

Your scope spans the entire value chain: inbound freight from global suppliers into our manufacturing plants, plant-to-distribution center replenishment, and outbound delivery from our DC network to major retail partners, salons, specialty channels, and directly to consumers’ doorsteps.

You will lead the strategy and operational execution across three vital business mandates:

Cost-to-Serve Optimization: Partnering with Indirect Sourcing and commercial divisions to drive structural freight efficiencies, mode conversions (LTL to TL/Intermodal), and payload optimization.Customer Service Excellence: Driving flawless On-Time Pickup (OTPU) and On-Time Delivery (OTD) performance through carrier relationship management and tight integration with our distribution center network.Sustainable Logistics & Decarbonization: Leading the L'Oréal for the Future (L4TF) transportation agenda, implementing green freight initiatives, and meeting aggressive carbon reduction targets while supporting aggressive business growth.

Key Responsibilities

 End-to-End Operational Leadership (Operate)P&L and Financial Stewardship: Manage the North America transportation budget. Drive cost-to-serve reduction initiatives, eliminate operational waste (accessorials, detention, expedited freight), and ensure financial predictability.Network Execution & Performance: Lead domestic operations, international freight forwarding, dedicated fleets, and final-mile delivery across all North American channels (B2B, Retail, Specialty, and D2C).Service Delivery: Maintain top-tier SLA compliance, focusing on On-Time Pickup (OTPU), On-Time Delivery (OTD), carrier capacity commitments, and retailer compliance chargeback minimization.Carrier Strategy & Sourcing Alignment: In close partnership with Indirect Sourcing, drive strategic carrier allocation, master service agreements, rate negotiations, quarterly business reviews (QBRs), and performance scorecards.Cross-Functional Integration: Partner with Plant Managers, DC Operations Leaders, Customer Care, and Commercial Divisions to align shipping schedules, prebuild movements, and peak volume execution. Strategic Transformation & Network of Excellence (Build & Adapt)Global NOE Governance: Act as the North American leader for the Global Transportation Network of Excellence (NOE). Deploy global standards, KPI definitions, auditing frameworks, and operating methodologies across the zone.Digital Suite & Systems (TMS/SAP): Own the roadmap, rollout, and optimization of our next-generation Transportation Management Systems (TMS), tracking tools, parcel rate-shopping engines, and operational analytics platforms.Network Redesign & Growth Strategy: Partner with Engineering and Fulfillment NOE leaders on multi-year network studies, identifying optimal flow paths, cross-dock opportunities, and fulfillment center positioning.Systems Remediation & Continuous Improvement: Lead operational readiness, post-go-live stabilization, and data cleansing initiatives following enterprise ERP and WMS implementations. Sustainability & Innovation (L'Oréal for the Future)Decarbonization Roadmap: Lead the zone transportation sustainability strategy to achieve company Net Zero targets.Green Freight Solutions: Evaluate, pilot, and scale lower-emission alternatives, including fleet electrification, alternative fuels, intermodal expansion, and optimized route density to actively offset volume growth. People & Organization LeadershipLead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team across Domestic Operations, International Operations, Continuous Improvement, and Systems.Foster a culture of accountability, operational discipline, and cross-functional collaboration across plant, DC, and corporate teams.

Required Qualifications

What We Are Looking For

Experience: 12+ years of progressive leadership experience in transportation, logistics, or end-to-end supply chain within large-scale, high-velocity consumer goods (CPG), retail, or complex manufacturing environments.Financial & Scale Acumen: Proven track record managing large-scale freight budgets ($100M+) with deep knowledge of North American carrier markets, parcel networks, LTL/TL dynamics, and intermodal transport.Systems & Digital Fluency: Extensive experience with enterprise-grade Transportation Management Systems (e.g., SAP TM, OTM, Blue Yonder, Manhattan) and modern visibility/telematics platforms.Procurement & Negotiation: Demonstrated success collaborating with sourcing teams on multi-million-dollar RFP events, contract negotiation, and carrier relationship management.Operational Mindset: Strong root-cause problem-solving capabilities with a bias toward data-driven execution and operational discipline.Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, or related discipline (Master’s/MBA preferred).Authorization to work in the United States on a full-time, permanent, ongoing basis is required. No immigration support/sponsorship offered for this roleBeing present in the office three days a week is considered an essential function of all office-based roles for eligible full-time employees.

Preferred Attributes

Direct experience managing international freight, customs clearance, and global ocean/air lanes.Proven leadership in logistics sustainability programs (SmartWay, carbon accounting, alternative fleet deployment).High executive presence with the ability to influence cross-functional leaders, divisional general managers, and global stakeholders.Strong leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and motivate teams.Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, data analysis tools, and Solvace.

Who We Are

Colgate-Palmolive Company is a global consumer products company operating in over 200 countries specializing in Oral Care, Personal Care, Home Care, Skin Care, and Pet Nutrition. Our products are trusted in more households than any other brand in the world, making us a household name!

Join Colgate-Palmolive, a caring, innovative growth company reimagining a healthier future for people, their pets, and our planet. Guided by our core values—Caring, Inclusive, and Courageous—we foster a culture that inspires our people to achieve common goals. Together, let's build a brighter, healthier future for all.

The Global Consumer Affairs Brand Integration Specialist serves as the crucial liaison between Consumer Affairs and commercial and technical teams, including Global Marketing, CDO, R&D, and Supply Chain. This role translates global business initiatives into worldwide operational plans for consumer care support, encompassing needs identification, managing training development and delivery, preparing reference materials, preparing systems for standard and customized data capture, and planning for appropriate reporting. The Specialist oversees the global Voice of Consumer (VOC) program, advancing people centricity and brand building initiatives, and developing new analysis approaches by driving new methodologies, partnerships, and technologies. This role also oversees our critical global CSAT program, establishing consistent standards and best practices, and working with teams to detect, identify, and implement care improvements. This highly collaborative role involves participating on cross functional teams, interacting with Consumer Affairs operational teams around the world, and working with key vendors.

Responsibilities:

VOC Reporting and Advancing People Centricity: Direct Global Voice of Consumer reporting function for GCA. Define VOC needs for the global organization by aligning with internal stakeholders and ensure these needs are met. Champion and advocate for the consumer and work for the integration of consumer perspectives into business decision-making, ensuring that consumer experience is proactively managed and prioritized. Analyze on and report consumer feedback and insights and ensure analysis is actionable and driving effective business decision making. Direct and quality control the work of the CBS VOC team to ensure their work is aligned and effective. Identify and advance the use of effective and innovative methodologies for analyzing consumer data through the function. Appropriately identify and drive the use of new methodologies, partnerships, and technologies, such as AI, voice/text analytics, visualization, and predictive models. Market these activities internally to stakeholders by demonstrating value, and proactive identification of opportunities. Develop and promote programs and opportunities to drive people centricity and help the organization get closer to the consumer.

Master Data Management: Understand business and functional priorities and translate them into effective GCA CRM system setup and administration. Identify the need for system changes and follow processes for implementing those changes. Appropriately determine system needs that balance end user effectiveness with reporting efficacy. Approve requests for High Risk System changes as appropriate. Guide and coach data request submitters worldwide on change request process.

Infrastructure Support of 2030 Strategy and Commercial and Business Priorities: Working cross-functionally, provide and plan for effective Consumer Affairs support plans that ensure great consumer experiences, and operational effectiveness, including: coordinating global rollouts and company initiatives across all divisions/units, training planning and delivery, development of training and reference content (consistent messaging incorporating brand voice and appropriate for channel optimization, Q&As, Product Information Forms), system preparation (determining coding, special field or information capture), planning and implementing appropriate reporting mechanisms.

Manage global CSAT Program: Ensure CSAT program is effective, running smoothly, and generating actionable data. Establish and optimize best practices in CSAT measurement and ensure consistent and appropriate deployment globally. Work with GCA Teach Team to provide for smooth data transfer from global system into vendor platform to enable efficient surveying. Work with operational teams to detect, identify, and implement care improvements. Serve as liaison between vendor, GIT, and business unit Consumer Affairs teams. Track and report on global CSAT KPIs and performance.

Ensure compliance:  Understand and adhere to global SOPs in all activities, including consumer privacy, records retention, regulated contact handling, change management, validation; ensure compliance with Regulatory, Data Protection and other corporate legal requirements.

Required Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree. 4+ years of relevant work experience in either of these: Data analytics and Visualization, Voice of Consumer Reporting, Consumer Affairs/Customer service, or Consumer Insights. Experience in story telling, data interpretation and data visualization abilities (experience with tools like DOMO, Sigma and Snowflake). Proficiency in Google Suite: sheets, slides etc, excel (formulas, pivot tables). 

Preferred Qualifications:

Foundational understanding of SQL programming and relational databases. Experience reporting from CRM tools - Emplifi, Zendesk, Salesforce or equivalents. Understanding of contact center operations, customer service best practices, and regulatory compliance, ideally in a CPG environment. A detail oriented, rapid learner who is a self-starter that thrives in a fast-paced environment, works collaboratively, and has a constant thirst for knowledge with a continuous curiosity. This individual possesses excellent analytical aptitude, a natural curiosity and is passionate about people with a willingness to roll up your sleeves, experiment, act courageously and challenge the status quo. Excellent communication and writing skills with strong attention to detail. Ability to build and maintain relationships across cultural, geographical, language, and other divides. Master data management experience. CSAT measurement experience. Global operational experience and consumer/client service mindset. 

Compensation And Benefits

Salary Range $96,800.00 - $121,000.00 USD

Pay is determined based on experience, qualifications, and location. Salaried employees may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses, profit-sharing, and long-term incentives for Executive-level roles.

rows.descriptionText:
The Analytics Solution Architect is responsible for defining the architecture, standards and technology direction for analytics and AI solutions across Marks & Spencer. Working across Microsoft Fabric, Azure Databricks, Power Platform and Copilot technologies, the role provides technical leadership from concept through to production, ensuring solutions are scalable, governed, secure and aligned to enterprise strategy.

The role partners closely with business stakeholders, analytics teams, data engineers, platform engineers and technology architects to design AI-ready analytical ecosystems, evaluate emerging technologies, and establish reusable patterns that accelerate delivery across the federated analytics organisation.

Due to high interest, this role may close earlier than advertised. We recommend applying as soon as possible,

All the details

What You’ll Do

Your key accountabilities will include

Lead the design of end-to-end analytics and AI solutions across Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Power Platform and Copilot, guiding delivery teams from architecture through to production and ensuring solutions are scalable, secure and business aligned.Partner with data and analytics engineering teams to design AI-ready data architectures, including data structures, metric layers, semantic models and ontologies, while developing and evaluating proof of concepts to validate emerging technologies, architectural patterns and AI capabilities.Define and champion enterprise-wide standards, governance and best practices for analytics and AI platforms, creating reusable patterns, blueprints and playbooks that improve quality, consistency and delivery speed across federated teams.Drive platform strategy and optimisation across Power BI, Databricks, Copilot Studio, Power Platform and AI/BI workloads, shaping roadmaps and contributing to governance, monitoring, performance and cost management frameworks in partnership with platform engineering teams.Build organisational capability in analytics and AI through mentoring, training and hands-on solution leadership, supporting adoption of emerging technologies, while helping modernise the analytics estate through ongoing maintenance, re-platforming and decommissioning of legacy platforms.


Who You Are

Your skills and experience will include

An experienced Analytics Solutions Architect with a proven track record of designing and delivering enterprise-scale analytics and AI solutions, in a Microsoft-centric environment, using Microsoft Fabric, Azure Databricks, Power Platform and Copilot Studio.Ability to be strategic and hands-on. Can translate complex business challenges into scalable, secure and maintainable solution architectures, while remaining comfortable working close to delivery teams.An influential communicator and collaborator with the ability to engage senior stakeholders, build trusted relationships and communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.A champion of governance and engineering excellence, experienced in defining standards, best practices and reusable architectural patterns that enable teams to deliver consistently, securely and at scale. A strong technical practitioner with advanced skills in DAX, SQL and Python, combined with deep expertise in dimensional modelling and analytics data architecture design.

Being a part of M&S is exactly that – playing your part to bring the magic of M&S to our customers every day. We’re an inclusive, dynamic, exciting, and ever evolving business built on doing the right thing and bringing exceptional quality, value, service to every customer, whenever, wherever and however they want to shop with us.

Everyone's welcome

We are ambitious about the future of retail. We’re disrupting, innovating and leading the industry into a more conscientious, inspiring digital era. We’re transforming how we work together and offering our most exciting opportunities yet. rows.title: Agent2Agent EMEA Lead
rows.descriptionText:
Let’s be unstoppable together!

Circana is a leading provider of technology, AI, and data solutions for consumer packaged goods companies, manufacturers, and retailers. Our predictive analytics and Liquid Data® platform help clients measure market share, uncover consumer behaviour, and drive growth—powered by six decades of expertise and an expansive, high-quality data set.

At Circana, we are fueled by our passion for continuous learning and growth, we seek and share feedback freely, and we celebrate victories both big and small in an environment that is flexible and accommodating to our work and personal lives. We’re a global company dedicated to fostering inclusivity and belonging. We value and celebrate the unique experiences, cultures, and viewpoints that each individual brings. By embracing a wide range of backgrounds, skills, expertise, and beyond, we create a stronger, more innovative environment for our employees, clients, and communities. With us, you can always bring your full self to work. Join our inclusive, committed team to be a challenger, own outcomes, and stay curious together. Circana is proud to be Certified™ by Great Place To Work®. This prestigious award is based entirely on what current employees say about their experience working at Circana. Learn more at www.circana.com.

Role Overview

Circana is seeking a Senior Director II, A2A Lead for EMEA to drive the business strategy and requirements behind Circana’s Agent-to-Agent (A2A) technology enablement. This role translates client and market needs in the EMEA region into business and technical requirements that shape Circana’s agentic protocol capabilities, leads client-facing execution of A2A value across EMEA accounts, and communicates Circana’s A2A technical architecture to clients throughout the sales cycle.

This role partners closely with Circana’s Liquid AI, Engineering, and Product teams to co-own prioritization of what gets built next, and produces the regional enablement, demos, and client-facing materials that bring Circana’s A2A capabilities to life for EMEA clients and stakeholders.

Job Responsibilities

Strategy & Business Requirements

Translate EMEA client, market, and account needs into business and technical requirements that inform Circana’s enterprise A2A prioritization and roadmapServe as the EMEA voice in Circana’s shared, cross-regional A2A prioritization process, partnering directly with the Liquid AI, Engineering, and Product teams on what gets built nextPartner cross-functionally (Product, Engineering, Security, Legal, and Client Leadership) to drive adoption and value realization of A2A capabilities in region

Regional Enablement

Produce EMEA-specific enablement materials (demos, mock-ups, worked examples) that translate Circana’s A2A capabilities for regional client and internal audiencesEnsure regional enablement content is reviewed against the accuracy and consistency standard maintained centrally for Circana’s A2A capability and status

Client & Ecosystem Engagement

Serve as the executive lead on client engagements involving A2A capabilities in EMEA, from early conversations through deliveryCommunicate and translate Circana’s A2A technical architecture and capabilities to clients and prospects throughout the sales cycle, partnering with Liquid AI and Engineering to ensure technical accuracyRepresent EMEA client and market perspective in cross-functional discussions on security, governance, and data-access requirements for agent interactionsBuild Circana’s credibility as a trusted, forward-looking partner in the AI agent ecosystem with EMEA clients and prospects

Requirements

Required

Significant experience in a senior, client-facing or strategy role within enterprise SaaS, data/analytics, or technology-driven environments, translating business and client needs into product or technical requirementsExperience defining business or technical requirements for agentic systems and interoperability protocols (e.g., MCP, A2A)Demonstrated ability to partner effectively with Liquid AI, engineering, and product teams to shape and prioritize a roadmap from a business and commercial perspective; hands-on technical build experience is not requiredStrong executive presence, with a track record of leading senior client conversations throughout the sales cycle and representing complex, evolving technical architecture in clear business termsComfort operating in ambiguous, fast-changing environments, with the flexibility to adapt scope as Circana’s approach to agentic technology continues to evolveFluency in English (required)

Preferred

Familiarity with protocols such as MCP, A2A, and Agent–User Interaction Protocol (AG-UI)Familiarity with major AI agent ecosystems (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude) from a business or strategic vantage pointBackground in data-intensive, analytics-driven SaaS environmentsExperience serving CPG, retail, or manufacturing clients in the EMEA marketUnderstanding of CPG industry metrics (e.g., market share, distribution, syndicated data) and how they translate to client valueFluency in French or German a plus

Circana Behaviours

Beyond technical skills, experience, and role-specific attributes, these shared behaviours are fundamental to our culture and success. We seek individuals who consistently demonstrate and champion these behaviours in their daily work:

Stay Curious: Being hungry to learn and grow, always asking the big questions. Seek Clarity: Embracing complexity to create clarity and inspire action. Own the Outcome: Being accountable for decisions and taking ownership of our choices. Center on the Client: Relentlessly adding value for our customers. Be a Challenger: Never complacent, always striving for continuous improvement. Champion Inclusivity: Fostering trust in relationships engaging with empathy, respect, and integrity. Commit to each other: Contributing to making Circana a great place to work for everyone.

rows.title: Manager - Consumer Technology, Client Sales & Insights
rows.descriptionText:
Let’s be unstoppable together!

Circana is a leading provider of technology, AI, and data solutions for consumer packaged goods companies, manufacturers, and retailers. Our predictive analytics and Liquid Data® platform help clients measure market share, uncover consumer behavior, and drive growth—powered by six decades of expertise and an expansive, high-quality data set.

At Circana, we are fueled by our passion for continuous learning and growth, we seek and share feedback freely, and we celebrate victories both big and small in an environment that is flexible and accommodating to our work and personal lives.  We’re a global company dedicated to fostering inclusivity and belonging. We value and celebrate the unique experiences, cultures, and viewpoints that each individual brings. By embracing a wide range of backgrounds, skills, expertise, and beyond, we create a stronger, more innovative environment for our employees, clients, and communities. With us, you can always bring your full self to work.  Join our inclusive, committed team to be a challenger, own outcomes, and stay curious together. Circana is proud to be Certified™ by Great Place To Work®. This prestigious award is based entirely on what current employees say about their experience working at Circana.

Learn more at www.circana.com.

Our Critical Sales Skills

At the heart of our commercial success is a team of professionals who combine strategic insight, customer-centricity, and executional excellence. These skills represent the core capabilities required to drive value for our clients and sustainable growth for our business.

Effectively Presents Solutions: Delivers tailored, compelling solutions that align with customer needs and drive actionKnows the Buying Influences: Identifies key decision-makers and understands their motivations and influenceManages Buyer Indifference: Recognizes and explores customer hesitation to uncover new needs or opportunitiesUnderstands Customer Needs: Operates as a recognized expert to articulate customer needs in the customer's business language and business contextBeing Resilient: Bounces back from setbacks with composure and positivity; helps others stay productive during tough timesManages Ambiguity: Stays focused and calm in uncertain situations; guides others through change

What will you be doing?

This is an exciting opportunity to partner with some of the world's leading, most innovative, and fast-paced global technology brands. As a Manager, you will work closely with client stakeholders and internal teams to deliver data-driven insights, market intelligence, and strategic guidance that support business decisions across Consumer Technology categories.

You will support day-to-day client engagement through a combination of recurring reporting, customized analyses, presentations, and consultative recommendations. Success in this role requires balancing a high volume of standardized deliverables with ad hoc analytical requests while maintaining a high level of responsiveness, accuracy, and client service.

Beyond Technology market expertise, you will help clients understand how broader macroeconomic, retail, and consumer trends are influencing market performance, purchasing behavior, and business opportunities. This includes connecting Technology sales trends to shifts in the retail environment, promotional activity, consumer demand, economic conditions, and other external factors impacting the marketplace.

This role provides the opportunity to partner with stakeholders across multiple functions and levels, helping clients translate data into meaningful business decisions while strengthening Circana’s position as a trusted advisor.

Job Responsibilities

Build and maintain strong relationships with client stakeholders, developing a deep understanding of their business priorities, challenges, and objectives. Deliver recurring reporting, presentations, and insights that translate complex market and sales data into actionable business recommendations. Demonstrate curiosity and a foundational understanding of AI-enabled solutions, supporting the identification, positioning, and communication of Circana's AI. capabilities to clients while helping uncover opportunities to drive business value through AI-powered insights and analytics. Respond to ad hoc analytical requests and provide perspectives on market performance, competitive dynamics, and emerging opportunities. Analyze Consumer and B2B Technology sales data to identify trends, risks, and growth opportunities across categories, channels, and customer segments. Collaborate with internal Client Insights, Analytics, Product, Operations, and Sales teams to deliver high-quality solutions and an exceptional client experience. Actively contribute to client retention and business growth by identifying opportunities to expand the value Circana delivers, proactively bringing forward ideas and solutions that align with client needs and business objectives. Continuously seek opportunities to improve processes, enhance deliverables, and elevate the overall client experience. 

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree plus 2-4 years of prior experience in a market research, business management or client service role, with hands-on exposure to consumer and/or POS data a plus. Strong analytical and critical‑thinking skills, with a demonstrated ability to translate data into clear, actionable insights. Excellent communication and presentation skills, with comfort engaging clients and internal stakeholders through a consultative, insight‑led approach. Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to engage clients consultatively. Ability to manage multiple priorities independently while collaborating with cross-functional teams. Technical Ability: Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Microsoft Excel, Power Point, Co-Pilot, Teams, and Outlook. Highly organized and able to prioritize competing deadlines in a fast-paced environment. Thrives in a team-oriented culture that values accountability, collaboration, a strong work ethic, and the ability to balance delivering exceptional results while enjoying the people and partnerships that make the work rewarding. 

Circana Behaviors

As well as the technical skills, experience and attributes that are required for the role, our shared behaviors sit at the core of our organization. Therefore, we always look for people who can continuously champion these behaviors throughout the business within their day-to-day role:

Stay Curious: Being hungry to learn and grow, always asking the big questions. Seek Clarity: Embracing complexity to create clarity and inspire action. Own the Outcome: Being accountable for decisions and taking ownership of our choices. Center on the Client: Relentlessly adding value for our customers. Be a Challenger: Never complacent, always striving for continuous improvement. Champion Inclusivity: Fostering trust in relationships engaging with empathy, respect, and integrity. Commit to each other: Contributing to making Circana a great place to work for everyone. 

Location Remote, U.S. Candidates located in the Pacific Time Zone are preferred to align with client needs and stakeholder collaboration (though this is not a requirement).

The below range reflects the range of possible compensation for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. This range may be modified in the future. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, shift, travel requirements, sales or revenue-based metrics, any collective bargaining agreements, and business or organizational needs. The salary range for this role is $68,000.00 to $79,000.00 USD.

We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees.

An offer of employment may be conditional upon successful completion of a background check in accordance with local legislation and our candidate privacy notice. Your current employer will not be contacted without your permission.

You can apply for this role through the Circana careers website or Intranet site for internal candidates. This role is subject to AI-assisted screening. Circana uses artificial intelligence (AI) to assess resumes for alignment with job requirements by helping locate details in resumes that relate to the job description.

This position is expected to remain open for approximately 30 days and may close earlier if sufficient qualified candidates are identified.

rows.title: Vice President, Global Revenue Operations & Accounting
rows.descriptionText:
Vice President, Global Revenue Accounting

Let’s be unstoppable together!

Circana is a leading provider of technology, AI, and data solutions for consumer packaged goods companies, manufacturers, and retailers. Our predictive analytics and Liquid Data® platform help clients measure market share, uncover consumer behavior, and drive growth—powered by six decades of expertise and an expansive, high-quality data set.

At Circana, we are fueled by our passion for continuous learning and growth, we seek and share feedback freely, and we celebrate victories both big and small in an environment that is flexible and accommodating to our work and personal lives.  We’re a global company dedicated to fostering inclusivity and belonging. We value and celebrate the unique experiences, cultures, and viewpoints that each individual brings. By embracing a wide range of backgrounds, skills, expertise, and beyond, we create a stronger, more innovative environment for our employees, clients, and communities. With us, you can always bring your full self to work.  Join our inclusive, committed team to be a challenger, own outcomes, and stay curious together. Circana is proud to be Certified™ by Great Place To Work®. This prestigious award is based entirely on what current employees say about their experience working at Circana. Learn more at www.circana.com.

What will you be doing?

The Vice President, Global Revenue Operations & Accounting will lead Circana’s global Order-to-Cash organization and drive operational excellence across the revenue lifecycle. This leader will oversee billing, cash application, collections, revenue operations, and revenue accounting while ensuring globally consistent, scalable, efficient, and well-controlled processes. As a senior leader within the global Finance organization, this role will focus on accelerating cash conversion, driving automation, improving operational performance, and advancing a globally consistent revenue operating model while maintaining strong revenue accounting practices.

This leader will partner closely with Commercial, Sales Operations, Legal, FP&A, Treasury, IT, and regional controllership teams to improve operational performance and control effectiveness, eliminate friction points, enhance working capital outcomes, and support the Company’s long-term growth strategy.

Job Responsibilities

Oversee all aspects of the global revenue cycle, including revenue recognition and reporting, billing, collections, cash application, dispute resolution, and contract review, ensuring compliance with U.S. GAAP and internal control requirements. Ensure timely and accurate monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue close activities, including journal entries, reconciliations, reporting, and management review. Own the end-to-end Order-to-Cash operating model, ensuring efficient execution from contract review through invoicing, collections, cash application, and dispute resolution. Partner with Commercial and Sales Operations leadership to improve the customer experience and reduce operational friction throughout the revenue lifecycle. Maintain and enforce global revenue recognition policies and procedures, ensuring compliance with U.S. GAAP, ASC 606, SOX, and internal control requirements. Research and apply U.S. GAAP guidance to complex and non-routine revenue transactions, including deferred revenue, direct costs, revenue-sharing arrangements, barter transactions, and multi-element deliverables. Lead process improvement initiatives across global revenue operations, driving standardization, scalability, automation, and harmonization of revenue-related processes, controls, and reporting practices. Partner closely with IT and business stakeholders to implement and enhance systems, improve data quality, and develop scalable solutions that support efficient revenue operations and financial reporting. Leverage Dynamics CRM, NetSuite Advanced Revenue Management, NetSuite Billing, and other enabling technologies to drive automation, operational excellence, and continuous improvement across the revenue lifecycle. Develop KPIs, analytics, and reporting that provide actionable insights into revenue performance, cash conversion, trends, variances, and operational efficiency. Partner across Finance, Commercial, Sales Operations, Legal, Treasury, and IT to improve Order-to-Cash processes, resolve operational challenges, and support business growth. Collaborate with Commercial, FP&A, Legal, and Operations teams to understand contractual arrangements, ensure appropriate revenue recognition treatment, and support new products, offerings, and go-to-market strategies. Work closely with the Company’s external auditors on revenue recognition, related controls, and audit requirements, ensuring timely and effective support throughout the audit process. Provide leadership, direction, coaching, and development to global revenue operations, revenue accounting, and collections teams while evaluating organizational effectiveness and supporting future-state operating models. Develop and execute a multi-year global Revenue Operations transformation strategy. Evaluate opportunities to leverage AI, workflow automation, shared services, and outsourced support models to improve scalability, efficiency, and global consistency. 

Requirements

15+ years of progressive experience across Revenue Operations, Order-to-Cash, Shared Services, Finance Operations, Revenue Accounting, or related functions. 5+ years of experience leading managers and developing global teams in a senior leadership capacity. Significant experience driving global Order-to-Cash or Revenue Operations transformation initiatives, including process standardization, automation, customer invoicing, collections, cash application, dispute management, and working capital optimization. Proven track record of improving DSO, cash conversion, billing effectiveness, control effectiveness, and operational efficiency. Strong knowledge of ASC 606 and experience applying revenue recognition principles across software, service contracts, revenue-sharing arrangements, barter transactions, and multi-element deliverables. Deep working knowledge of NetSuite Advanced Revenue Management and NetSuite Billing required, including an understanding of system capabilities, reporting, workflows, and downstream process impacts. Experience with Microsoft Dynamics and modern Invoice-to-Cash technologies, such as AR automation, electronic invoicing and payment platforms, customer portals, and analytics solutions, preferred. Experience partnering effectively with cross-functional stakeholders, including Commercial, Sales Operations, Legal, Treasury, IT, FP&A, and regional controllership teams. Experience leading global teams and working with shared services, outsourced support models, or offshore resources. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence, challenge constructively, and collaborate effectively at all levels of the organization. Proven ability to lead complex initiatives, navigate change, and deliver results within a dynamic, highly matrixed global organization. Ability to balance technical revenue accounting expertise with operational leadership, systems knowledge, and strategic thinking. Demonstrated commitment to the highest ethical standards and professional integrity. 

Circana Behaviors

Beyond technical skills, experience, and role-specific attributes, these shared behaviors are fundamental to our culture and success. We seek individuals who consistently demonstrate and champion these behaviors in their daily work:

Stay Curious: Being hungry to learn and grow, always asking the big questions. Seek Clarity: Embracing complexity to create clarity and inspire action. Own the Outcome: Being accountable for decisions and taking ownership of our choices. Center on the Client: Relentlessly adding value for our customers. Be a Challenger: Never complacent, always striving for continuous improvement. Champion Inclusivity: Fostering trust in relationships engaging with empathy, respect, and integrity. Commit to each other: Contributing to making Circana a great place to work for everyone. 

Location: This position can be located in the following area(s): Remote, US (Central & Eastern time zones preferred, Chicago based is a plus)

The below range reflects the range of possible compensation for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. This range may be modified in the future. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, shift, travel requirements, sales or revenue-based metrics, any collective bargaining agreements, and business or organizational needs. The salary range for this role is $240,000 - $260,000 USD. This role is also eligible for bonus pay.

We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees. 

An offer of employment may be conditional upon successful completion of a background check in accordance with local legislation and our candidate privacy notice. Your current employer will not be contacted without your permission. 

You can apply for this role through the Circana careers website or Intranet site for internal candidates. This role is subject to AI-assisted screening. Circana uses artificial intelligence (AI) to assess resumes for alignment with job requirements by helping locate details in resumes that relate to the job description. 

This position is expected to remain open for approximately 30 days and may close earlier if sufficient qualified candidates are identified.

rows.descriptionText:
Description

At Audible, we believe stories have the power to transform lives. It’s why we work with some of the world’s leading creators to produce and share audio storytelling with our millions of global listeners. As a Senior Business Analyst within the Content Analytics team at Audible, you'll serve as an analytical leader and trusted thought partner for our senior Content leadership team, as well as the primary analytics conduit for European Content teams. You'll be responsible for designing, implementing, and continuously improving the analytical frameworks and reporting processes that deliver critical KPIs and business insights across our organization.

Working in complex and often ambiguous problem spaces, you'll transform multi-source data into clear, actionable recommendations that drive long-term strategy. Your deep expertise in the Content business — spanning audiobooks, physical books, and/or other digital media — will allow you to proactively anticipate leadership questions and surface insights before they're asked. As a content data SME, you'll help drive data quality standards within your domain while making insights readily accessible through efficient, scalable, self-service solutions.

You are an analytical leader who balances technical expertise with deep business acumen, particularly within the world of content. You excel at working cross-functionally, translating complex business challenges into robust analytical frameworks and long-term solutions. You're naturally curious, with a talent for looking beyond immediate data requests to identify the underlying strategic questions driving our Content business forward.

You thrive in ambiguous situations, delivering independently with strong judgment while continuously raising the bar on data processes and analytical best practices. Your communication skills are exceptional — you distill complex analyses into compelling, influential narratives for both technical and executive audiences. You build strong, trust-based relationships with stakeholders that position your insights to meaningfully influence business strategy and decision-making across the organization.

work with data owners to onboard new sources, guarantee data fidelity, and ensure consistency in metric definitions, documentation standards, and data quality Mentor and develop peers within your organization, modeling analytical best practices in design, delivery, and long-term scalability; develop clear documentation that enables both technical and non-technical stakeholders to understand and replicate reporting methodologies

We spark listeners’ imaginations, offering immersive, cinematic experiences full of inspiration and insight to enrich our customers daily lives.  Experience supporting executive reporting and business reviews, including ownership of MBR/QBR narratives or equivalent documents Demonstrated ability to drive operational excellence through process improvement, automation, or streamlining of data and business processes Understanding of data governance principles and practices, including metric definition standardization and data quality management Experience partnering with Business Intelligence Engineers or Data Scientists to apply advanced analytics techniques and unlock new data sources Ability to work a flexible schedule that occasionally accommodates US time zone meeting requirements Experience working with or supporting European markets or cross-regional teams

About This Role

As the Customer Fraud Investigation Lead for the Audible Fraud Defense Program, you will own fraud and abuse investigations on the customer side of Audible's business. That covers payment fraud in its various forms, including chargebacks, bad debt and payment defaults, and it covers abuse of Audible's services, such as return abuse, credit and membership abuse, and promotional and trial abuse. You will be the subject matter expert and primary point of contact for customer fraud, and you will build the investigation and enforcement capability for it rather than inherit a finished one.

A significant part of this role is net new. Audible does not have an established process for customer fraud termination appeals and the associated legal escalations, and you will design and stand it up. You will also work with product and engineering partners to turn investigative findings into targeted enforcement, and with Customer Service, Legal and Public Relations to make sure enforcement reaches customers with the right communication and the right handling when it does not land correctly.

In this role you will collaborate closely with partners and key stakeholders across Audible and Amazon to protect Audible's integrity and trustworthiness for customers and creators alike.

As a Customer Fraud Investigation Lead, you will...

 Own investigations into customer-side fraud and abuse, including payment fraud, stolen and compromised payment instruments, chargebacks, bad debt and payment defaults, and identify the modus operandi behind them rather than resolving cases one at a time Investigate and mitigate abuse of Audible's services, including return abuse, credit and membership abuse, promotional and free trial abuse, and account and subscription manipulation Partner with the relevant Amazon fraud, payments and risk teams on shared exposure. Bring Audible-specific patterns to them, take their intelligence back into Audible detection, and make sure Audible is represented where enforcement decisions are made centrally Build the process for customer fraud termination appeals and second tier review from the ground up, including intake, evidentiary standards, decision criteria and reversal paths, and work with Legal partners on escalations and litigation-track cases Work with product and engineering partners to translate investigative findings into targeted enforcement and controls, and specify what the enforcement needs to do, who it must not affect, and how you will know whether it worked Work with Customer Service, Legal and Public Relations on customer communication and response, so that enforcement decisions are explained accurately, appeals are handled consistently, and the customer impact of a false positive is contained Investigate review manipulation originating from customer accounts. Where review manipulation involves collusion between customer and creator accounts, or a single operation presenting as both, investigate jointly with the fraud investigation and operations lead Partner with the fraud investigation and operations lead on cases and modus operandi that span pillars. A single actor or organized group may operate as both a customer and a creator, and neither lead holds the full picture alone, so jointly scope those investigations, align on enforcement, and make sure detection built for one pillar accounts for the other Work with the risk management agents assigned to the fraud program to train them on customer fraud investigations and build the standard operating procedures they will follow, in partnership with the fraud investigation and operations lead who owns the operations framework Apply generative AI to your own work, integrating it into investigation and case workflow to increase the volume and speed of what a single investigator can cover, and anticipate adversarial use of it. Assume bad actors will use generative AI, synthetic identity and automation to get around Audible's controls, and build defenses ahead of that rather than in response to it Conduct internal fraud and abuse investigations as needed and as appropriate, working with the relevant partners on handling and confidentiality Serve as the subject matter expert for customer fraud. Job Description

 About the Role 

The Hearst Corporate Data Team is seeking a Senior Manager, Audience Strategy & Activation to serve as the strategic link between Hearst's enterprise audience platform and the commercial teams that bring its value to market. Reporting to the VP, Audience Analytics, this role will partner closely with Ad Sales and the Corporate Data Team to develop scalable audience products, enable revenue-generating sales opportunities, and operationalize enterprise audience activation across Hearst's advertising ecosystem.

As Hearst continues to expand its enterprise identity and audience capabilities, this role will ensure those capabilities are translated into advertiser-ready solutions. You will identify audience opportunities, develop standardized audience offerings, create sales enablement materials, coordinate audience activation, and work across business and technical teams to maximize the commercial value of Hearst's audience assets.

The ideal candidate combines expertise in audience strategy, advertising technology, and cross-functional program management with a strong understanding of digital advertising, consumer data, and audience activation platforms.

 Key Responsibilities 

 Partner with Ad Sales, and client-facing teams to identify advertiser needs and develop scalable audience solutions that support revenue growth.  Develop and maintain a portfolio of enterprise audience products, including standardized audience definitions, audience packages, and reusable audience segments that can be leveraged across Hearst's consumer divisions.  Create compelling sales enablement materials—including audience one-pagers, audience profiles, methodology documentation, and pitch materials—that clearly communicate audience composition, scale, insights, and business value.  Collaborate with the VP, Audience Analytics to evaluate audience performance, identify new audience opportunities, and optimize audience offerings based on advertiser demand and campaign outcomes.  Coordinate the activation of enterprise audiences across advertising platforms (GAM), clean rooms, demand-side platforms (DSPs), data management platforms (DMPs), and other activation technologies.  Serve as the primary liaison between Audience Analytics, Ad Sales, Product, and Engineering, to ensure audiences are accurately built, documented, governed, and delivered.  Manage the end-to-end lifecycle of enterprise audience products, including intake, prioritization, governance, documentation, activation, and ongoing optimization.  Establish best practices, documentation standards, and governance processes for enterprise audience development and activation across Hearst. 

 Qualifications 

 6–10 years of experience in audience strategy, advertising technology, marketing technology, customer analytics, audience development, sales strategy, or digital media.  Strong understanding of digital advertising ecosystems, audience segmentation, identity resolution, audience activation, and consumer data products.  Experience partnering with Ad Sales, Sales Strategy, Marketing, Product, or Analytics teams to develop advertiser-facing solutions and support revenue-generating initiatives.  Demonstrated ability to translate business needs into scalable audience products and operational workflows.  Experience working with ad sales and other audience activation platforms, including CDPs, DMPs, DSPs, clean rooms, identity platforms, or other advertising technology solutions.  Strong analytical skills with experience evaluating audience performance, campaign effectiveness, and audience utilization.  Excellent project management and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to coordinate cross-functional initiatives across business and technical teams.  Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, including experience creating executive presentations, sales collateral, and client-facing documentation.  Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree preferred.  Preferred experience in publishing, digital media, advertising technology, audience measurement, first-party data strategies, or enterprise audience platforms. 

Compensation & Benefits

In accordance with applicable law, Hearst is required to include a reasonable estimate of the compensation for this role if hired in New York City. The reasonable estimate, if hired in New York City, is $180,000to $200,000. Please note this information is specific to those hired in New York City. For candidates outside New York City, the salary range will be aligned with the specific location. A final decision on the successful candidate’s starting salary will be based on a number of permissible, non-discriminatory factors, including but not limited to skills, experience, training, certifications, and education. Hearst provides a competitive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance, 401(k), paid holidays and paid time off, employee assistance programs, and more.

rows.title: FinCrime Risk Manager (Fraud)
rows.descriptionText:
About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 80+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth,‌ 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About The Role

Financial Crime Operations is at the forefront of Revolut’s efforts to keep customers and their money safe. Team members work directly with customers to resolve issues and flag potential concerns. Using cutting-edge technology and sharp attention to detail, they help prevent financial crime and keep trust at the core of Revolut.

We’re looking for a Senior Financial Crime Risk Manager to partner directly with Product, Operations, Compliance, and Engineering teams to design, test, and optimise fraud prevention strategies.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let’s get in touch.

What You'll Be Doing

Owning jurisdiction-level fraud risk, and acting as the primary point of contact for fraud escalations and governance in-marketPerforming end-to-end fraud risk assessments for existing and new products and servicesAdvising and partnering with Product, Operations, Compliance, and Engineering on fraud risk exposure, scalable control design, and oversight of outsourced operational componentsSupporting the development of tech-enabled fraud prevention and detection solutions that can be deployed globallyReviewing fraud performance data to identify emerging typologies, attack patterns, and control gapsDriving root-cause analysis and remediation of high-loss scenarios or escalated fraud-related complaintsBalancing fraud loss reduction with positive customer outcomes and friction minimisationDelivering fraud MI, dashboards, and insights that support risk-based prioritisation and decision-makingConducting QA and scenario testing of fraud interventions to drive continuous improvementShaping jurisdiction-specific governance, performance metrics, and early leadership practices to enable the function to scale

What You'll Need

7+ years of experience in fraud risk within a 1LoD or product advisory functionExpertise in fraud typologies, detection strategies, and key customer risk indicators across retail and business bankingDemonstrated success driving measurable fraud loss reduction and control effectiveness improvementsFamiliarity with fraud analytics, detection models, rule design, or scenario tuningThe ability to convert fraud risks into tech-informed controls embedded into product experiencesSolid partnership skills with a track record of influence across Product, Data, Operations, and Compliance teamsExperience within a global bank or high-growth fintechA proactive, analytical mindset and to be comfortable making decisions in ambiguous situationsThe ability to mentor others and manage a local fraud team

Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

 Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment. Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

By submitting this application, I confirm that all the information given by me in this application for employment and any additional documents attached hereto are true to the best of my knowledge and that I have not wilfully suppressed any material fact. I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice

rows.title: Data Engineer
rows.descriptionText:
Company Description

This role is for Angstrom Sports, a proprietary sports pricing and product provider, building intricate, simulation driven pricing and risk systems to support the success of key sports brands across the Entain group.

Founded in 2018 and having established itself as a pioneer in player-level, play-by-play simulations and forecasting, Angstrom was acquired by Entain in 2023. Today, we are responsible for delivering the group’s most advanced pricing and risk capabilities with a focus on the US market. We’re committed to building the next generation of sports betting products - sports-first, recreationally-focused, and designed to make betting more engaging, more intelligent, and more fun.

We’re proud to be a high-performing, low-ego team where brilliant people are empowered and people work to become brilliant. While we’re ambitious and delivery-driven, we take real pride in how we operate and the health of our independent culture, underpinned by mutual trust and respect.

Job Description

The purpose of the Data Engineer is to implement and maintain data infrastructure that facilitates data-driven decision making, innovation and operational efficiency while ensuring that the data pipeline is secure, reliable, and scalable. The role holder will build and maintain high-performance data systems that are foundational to driving business growth and success.

The Key Responsibilities Will Include

Designing and implementing scalable data architectures and systems Developing and maintaining ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) pipelines. Managing data storage, backup, and recovery mechanisms Writing SQL queries to extract data for analysis.  Developing and implementing data security and privacy Interfacing with clients and end users to receive guidance on projects and deliverables.

rows.title: Data Engineer
rows.descriptionText:
Join us as a Data Engineer

This is an exciting opportunity to use your technical expertise to collaborate with colleagues and build effortless, digital first customer experiencesYou’ll be simplifying the bank by developing innovative data driven solutions, using insight to be commercially successful, and keeping our customers’ and the bank’s data safe and secureParticipating actively in the data engineering community, you’ll deliver opportunities to support the bank’s strategic direction while building your network across the bank

What you'll do

As a Data Engineer, you’ll play a key role in driving value for our customers by building data solutions. You’ll be carrying out data engineering tasks to build, maintain, test and optimise a scalable data architecture, as well as carrying out data extractions, transforming data to make it usable to data analysts and scientists, and loading data into data platforms.

Developing comprehensive knowledge of the bank’s data structures and metrics, advocating change where needed for product developmentPracticing DevOps adoption in the delivery of data engineering, proactively performing root cause analysis and resolving issuesCollaborating closely with core technology and architecture teams in the bank to build data knowledge and data solutionsDeveloping a clear understanding of data platform cost levers to build cost effective and strategic solutionsSourcing new data using the most appropriate tooling and integrating it into the overall solution to deliver for our customers

The skills you'll need

To be successful in this role, you’ll need a strong understanding of how data is used across teams and by end customers, with experience of extracting value and features from large scale datasets.

You’ll also have expertise in data integration, transformation, and orchestration within the Informatica Intelligent Data Management Cloud (IDMC) environment, combined with strong SQL skills and experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure or GCP.

You’ll also demonstrate deep technical expertise in:

Entity Resolution, including fuzzy matching, deterministic matching and machine learning-based matching techniques to identify and link records across multiple data sourcesDesigning and delivering data ingestion and integration solutions using Informatica IDMC, including Cloud Data Integration, Cloud Application Integration, APIs and real-time or batch processing patternsConfiguring and managing match rules, survivorship rules and clustering logic, while integrating Entity Resolution with Data Quality and downstream applicationsImplementing data quality frameworks to improve data accuracy, consistency and completeness before data is consumed by downstream systemsETL solution design, data quality testing, data cleansing, monitoring, data warehousing and data modellingModern software and data engineering practices, including programming languages, secure and scalable development approaches, and the ability to communicate effectively with a wide range of stakeholders

rows.title: Manager, Earner Marketplace
rows.descriptionText:
About The Role

We are seeking a highly strategic and outcomes-oriented Strategic Operations Manager to join the Earner Marketplace & Matching team within Uber's US & Canada Mobility business.

This team owns some of Uber's most important marketplace optimization challenges, shaping the strategies behind driver pricing, incentives, matching, positioning, and other marketplace levers that together determine marketplace reliability, efficiency, and long-term supply health. You'll partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Operations teams to define strategies for solving complex marketplace challenges, influencing the evolution of Uber's marketplace technology and operations to deliver meaningful business impact.

As a senior operations leader for Earner Pricing and Matching, you will identify the highest-impact opportunities across the marketplace, develop long-term strategy, and drive complex cross-functional initiatives from concept through implementation. You'll turn ambiguous business challenges into clear strategies, align stakeholders around a shared direction, and drive execution to improve outcomes for drivers, riders, and Uber.

This role requires someone who can operate at multiple altitudes: setting long-term strategic direction while diving deep into complex marketplace problems to identify structural opportunities, evaluate difficult tradeoffs, and develop data-driven solutions. You'll be expected to lead through ambiguity, influence senior stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Operations, and deliver lasting marketplace and business impact.

What You'll Do

Strategic direction: Define and drive the long-term strategy for Earner Pricing and Matching, identifying the highest-impact opportunities to improve marketplace performance. Define strategic priorities, influence Tech roadmaps, and drive cross-functional initiatives across Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Operations to improve reliability, marketplace efficiency, and earner outcomes. Deep marketplace expertise: Synthesize insights across pricing, matching, incentives, positioning, and quality to develop a holistic view of how these marketplace levers collectively drive outcomes. Use this perspective to identify structural opportunities, diagnose complex marketplace challenges through deep dives, and develop cohesive strategies that improve marketplace performance. Strategic problem solving: Lead the team's most complex and ambiguous work, framing problems, developing business strategy, and translating analytical insights into clear recommendations. Build compelling business cases, navigate difficult tradeoffs, and drive high-impact initiatives from concept through implementation. Strategic influence & communication: Champion the team's strategy through clear, compelling, and data-driven communication. Build alignment across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Operations, and leadership, influence key decisions and long-term priorities, and represent the team's perspective in high-impact forums. 

Basic Qualifications 

Education: Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, Economics, or a related field; MBA or advanced degree is a plus. Experience: 7+ years of experience in operations, product operations, analytics, strategy, management consulting, product management, or a similar role. 

Preferred Qualifications

About The Role

We are seeking a dynamic and analytical Sr Strategic Operations Associate to join the Earner Marketplace & Matching team within Uber's US & Canada Mobility business.

The Earner Marketplace & Matching team tackles some of Uber's most interesting marketplace optimization challenges. We shape the earner side of the marketplace through driver pricing, incentives, positioning, matching, and other marketplace levers-balancing reliability and efficiency today while supporting a healthy driver experience and sustainable supply over the long term.

Partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Operations, you will help launch and optimize sophisticated pricing and matching capabilities, investigate complex marketplace dynamics, and identify opportunities to improve how the marketplace works for drivers, riders, and Uber.

This is a highly analytical role in a complex, interconnected marketplace where changes in one area can have meaningful effects elsewhere. You will dig into large datasets, develop hypotheses, evaluate experiments and tradeoffs, and turn your findings into recommendations that shape real business and technology decisions. The ideal candidate enjoys getting deep into difficult problems, connecting the dots across systems, and working with others to turn insights into impact.

Marketplace performance: Develop a deep understanding of marketplace health and the performance of Driver Pricing and Matching. Spot emerging trends and opportunities, lead deep-dive investigations to understand what's driving them, and translate your findings into clear recommendations and action.

Data-driven decision making: Use data to unpack complex marketplace dynamics, test hypotheses, and inform important decisions. Evaluate experiments and rollout plans, understand how pricing, matching, incentives, and other marketplace levers interact, and anticipate the broader effects of changes across the marketplace.

The outputs of these models power the core trip flow experience for all products in the Rides & Eats businesses, and core internal decision systems such as pricing and matching.
