rows.descriptionText:
About The Role

Uber Grocery & Retail is scaling into a daily-use, trust-based delivery platform. Fulfillment Optimization is at the center of that ambition.

As Senior Product Manager, Grocery Fulfillment Optimization, you will own the systems and decision logic that determine last-mile order fulfillment and how reliably, efficiently, and cost-effectively it happens when conditions are imperfect.

This role sits at the intersection of marketplace algorithms, real-world logistics, and customer trust. You will work deeply with Marketplace and Data Science to design matching, batching, and recovery systems that adapt dynamically to supply, demand, store readiness, and inevitable failure modes, without degrading the customer or earner experience.

The work spans both physical-world execution (stores, couriers, timing, constraints) and abstract optimization (matching, batching, objective functions, cost-per-trip). The outcome directly impacts reliability, unit economics, and long-term platform credibility.

This is a senior IC role. We expect you to own ambiguous, cross-cutting problem spaces end-to-end, set direction for modeling and experimentation across teams, and influence roadmaps and prioritization well beyond your immediate scope.

What The Candidate Will Do

You'll tackle some of Uber's most complex fulfillment problems, where software decisions meet the realities of grocery stores, couriers, and time-bound customer expectations. In this role, you will:

 Own the decision logic behind grocery fulfillment: how orders are matched, batched, planned, recovered, and completed when real-world conditions change.  Partner closely with Marketplace and Data Science to define matching, batching, and assignment logic that balances reliability, cost-per-trip, earner experience, and store readiness, making tradeoffs explicit and testable in code, not debated in meetings.  Design resilient fulfillment systems that treat recovery and graceful degradation as core product surfaces. Build backup fulfillment paths, partial-fulfillment recovery, and risk-based reassignment that materially reduce cancellations, missed deliveries, and partial fulfillment.  Translate operational complexity into product and modeling requirements, ensuring systems behave predictably across edge cases, degraded states, and at scale.  Shift fulfillment from reactive to proactive - build systems that anticipate risk (scheduled orders, supply variability, store performance) and adapt before customers feel the impact.  Set direction for modeling and experimentation, influencing the roadmaps of partner teams (Matching, Pricing & Incentives, Ops Tech) to move the system as a whole. 

This role offers a rare opportunity to work simultaneously on logistics systems and optimization models, with direct influence on customer trust and business performance.

Basic Qualifications

 7+ years of product management experience delivering successful, durable products, with clear ownership and outcomes you can point to. Your fingerprints are all over what shipped, what scaled, and what materially improved the business.  Strong technical and operational fluency. You've built complex systems directly or worked close enough to real-world operations - last mile supply chain and logistics networks - to understand how theory breaks in practice. You can reason comfortably from high-level system design (distributed systems, event-driven architectures, APIs) down to edge cases, data flows, and how software behaves under real operational constraints and failure modes.  Experience building algorithmic or ML-adjacent products in close partnership with Data Science. You understand how objective functions, constraints, experimentation, and model tradeoffs translate into real marketplace and fulfillment outcomes.  Hands-on data fluency. You get the data you need on your own - SQL, dashboards, instrumentation - and turn it into insight that drives decisions, not analysis paralysis.  Exceptional attention to detail. You obsess over how systems behave in the real world across customers, earners, merchants, and operations, and you notice the gaps, edge cases, and failure modes others miss.  Customer obsession. You take on messy, high-stakes problems and find elegant, simple solutions so customers and partners don't have to carry platform complexity.  A strong driver mindset. You are biased toward action, a great collaborator, a master disambiguator and simplifier, and relentless about pushing work to clarity and delivery.  Sound judgment under ambiguity. You can reason through multi-sided tradeoffs - reliability, cost, customer experience, earner experience, and merchant outcomes - and make principled decisions with imperfect information.  Influence without authority. You move multiple teams in the same direction by setting clear strategy, raising the bar on quality, and earning trust through judgment and execution.  A consistently high bar. For your own contributions and for the products you ship.  A never-ending desire to learn and grow. You seek feedback, adapt quickly, and continuously sharpen your craft. 

Preferred Qualifications

 Direct grocery, last-mile, or supply chain fulfillment experience at scale. Dispatch, matching, routing, picking, or sortation systems in production, ideally with both system ownership and operations-side exposure.  Ownership of decision systems, not just diagnostic or detection tooling, the logic that decides what the system actually does when the plan breaks.  Experience launching products side-by-side with Data Science on optimization models: co-designing objective functions, constraints, and experimentation strategy.  Experience building products from 0→1 in ambiguous problem spaces, especially in marketplaces or multi-sided platforms.  Experience in grocery, retail, CPG, or e-commerce, especially where physical-world execution and software optimization intersect.

Join Barclays as a Mortgage Research VP, where you will develop and articulate investment strategies and produce and publish thematic research on mortgage-backed securities for internal and external audiences. Assess large and multi-layered datasets to identify market opportunities, risks, and emerging trends across mortgages and fixed income markets. Work with traders, salespeople, other research teams, and clients to provide actionable insights and recommendations. Evaluate market developments, macroeconomic trends, consumer behaviour, and credit dynamics impacting mortgage markets.

To be successful as a Mortgage Research VP, you should have experience with:


Ample communication, presentation, and writing skills with the ability to effectively communicate highly detailed market viewsDemonstrated experience in mortgages, RMBS/MBS, fixed income investing, or related marketsAttention to detail and ability to operate in a fast-paced, market-driven environmentAdvanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and BloombergExperience working with large and multi-layered datasets to support investment research and strategy-making


Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include


Proficiency in SQL and/or Python for data evaluation, automation, and research applicationsExperience leveraging data science, analytics, or AI tools to improve research workflows and investment processesCritical-thinking and problem-solving abilitiesBroad understanding of economics, credit markets, and mortgage-related productsDemonstrated curiosity and commitment to continuous learning


You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in this role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking, digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

This role is located in New York, NY.

This role is regulated by FINRA.

Minimum Salary: $155,000

Maximum Salary: $225,000

The minimum and maximum salary/rate information above include only base salary or base hourly rate. It does not include any other type of compensation or benefits that may be available.

Purpose of the role

To produce and deliver Research with differentiated market insights and actionable ideas to Barclays Clients.

Accountabilities


Analysis of market, sector, corporate and/or economic data to help develop investment theses for your coverage universe to produce best in class Research.Research may range from individual company or sector notes, through to long dated thematic reports.Presentation of Research views to Barclays Clients; this can be through direct, face to face and virtual interactions, Research hosted events and written communications.Engagement with Markets, Client Strategy and other stakeholders, to raise awareness of your Research both to Clients and internally. Prioritise interaction with the most relevant and valuable Clients for your Research.Provision of insights and Research views to internal Clients to help them navigate financial markets and risks.Collaboration with the Supervisory Analyst, Compliance and other stakeholders to ensure Research is produced and delivered to Clients and internal stakeholders in a compliant manner.


Vice President Expectations


To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.


All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

rows.title: Senior Analyst , Finance Performance Governance (HAFS)
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

Position Statement

HAFS is Hilton’s shared-services organisation for accounting and finance. Its service-delivery model includes Hilton centralised offices in the UK and USA, supported by shared services centres in India operated by a world-class business process outsourcing partner.

The role is responsible for producing trusted performance reporting, KPI analysis and actionable insights that help HAFS leaders understand service delivery, identify improvement opportunities and support a consistent customer-focused experience across assigned functional areas.

The Senior Analyst, HAFS Performance Governance, will be responsible for assigned day-to-day activities within the HAFS Performance Governance function. The role will provide metric and KPI reporting, data analytics and insight to support a customer promise-led delivery model.

Position Summary

Under the direction and guidance of the Manager, HAFS Performance Governance, the post holder will play a key role in executing HAFS’s metric reporting and analytics strategy to support delivery against business requirements. They will help provide a seamless, efficient and customer-focused experience that maximises output without compromising service quality. The post holder will assume day-to-day responsibility for delivering performance metric and KPI reporting and analytics for assigned HAFS functional areas. This will require meticulous attention to detail, the ability to interpret key business drivers within a shared services environment and a strong background in data analytics.

Success in the role will depend on the ability to collaborate and build strong relationships with business partners at various organisational levels, both internally and with external stakeholders. The post holder will need awareness of relevant projects, the ability to manage multiple tasks and the discipline to deliver against deadlines. They will contribute to a strong customer-focused ethos while supporting data integrity and the delivery of reliable, actionable performance analytics.

Key outcomes for the role include accurate and timely performance reporting, clear interpretation of KPI trends, reliable data inputs for decision-making and practical insight that helps HAFS functional leaders monitor service delivery and identify opportunities for improvement.

Direct Reports

None

Qualifications

Specific Job Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

 Proven ability to work using own initiative whilst thriving in a fast-paced environment, being able to handle multiple demands and appropriately prioritise responsibilities.  Commitment to customer service with the ability to build, manage and maintain relationships with business partners across the organisation, always projecting a hospitable service atmosphere.  Strong problem-solving skills, including the ability to effectively address any issue in collaboration with others.  Good project management skills, including the ability to manage details through to completion and ensure project deadlines are met.  Excellent communication skills in both written and spoken English.  Strong numeracy and analytical skills with some understanding of finance and accounting environments.  Proficiency in MS Office products, especially Excel; ability to quickly learn new programmes or features when required.  Proficiency in business intelligence/analytics software, particularly Microsoft Power BI. 

Preferred Qualifications

 Previous experience working within a Shared Services, Centre of Excellence or Business Process Outsourcing environment.  Hospitality industry experience.  Experience applying AI in a business intelligence or analytics context.  Experience with Microsoft Power Platform tools, such as Power Apps and Power Automate.  Proficiency with relational databases and SQL. 

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

About The Team

How We’ll Help You Thrive

Benefits

At Hilton, the hospitality we’re known for doesn’t end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members’ wellbeing, supporting you through all of life’s moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including*:

rows.title: Functional Developer II – Oracle ERP Finance
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

Our Opportunity

Every order a pet parent places at Chewy eventually becomes a financial transaction: a tax calculation, a cost calculation, a rebate accrual, an invoice match, a vendor payment, and an accounting entry. FinTech team owns the platforms that get all of it right, across billions of dollars in annual net sales and millions of transactions a month. That includes inventory adjustments streaming in from our warehouse management systems, and for our growing B2B business the full order-to-cash lifecycle, which we brought live recently and are still shaping.

We are hiring a Functional Developer II – Oracle ERP Finance to design and build on that platform. You will work deep in Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, General Ledger, Cash Management, Cost Management, and Fixed Assets and across the ecosystem that surrounds it: Coupa for procure-to-pay, Vertex for tax determination, and a growing layer of APIs, microservices, and event streams that extend Oracle ERP well past what it does out of the box.

This is not a keep-the-lights-on configuration seat. Our roadmap includes standing up the finance and tax architecture for Chewy’s new initiatives, migrating acquired businesses off legacy ERPs onto Oracle Fusion, modernizing how ERP data reaches the rest of the enterprise, and putting Oracle’s new AI and agentic capabilities to work on real close, reconciliation, and payables processes. You will own workstreams across all of it from the whiteboard through go-live and stabilization.

And if you know Oracle Financials deeply and you know tax Oracle Fusion Tax, Vertex, Indirect tax determination in a high-volume retail and e-commerce environment you will go straight to the top of our list.

What You’ll Do

End-to-end functional solution design across Oracle Fusion Financials: requirements, process design, configuration, functional specifications, data and integration requirements, testing, documentation, and production readiness.The partnership with Finance, Accounting, Tax, Product, and Engineering — translating complex accounting requirements into scalable solutions, and evaluating the accounting, operational, control, and downstream impacts of every design decision.Implementation of new Oracle modules and capabilities, plus continuous modernization of existing ones as the business grows and requirements change.Extending Oracle beyond standard functionality alongside Engineers and Architects REST APIs, microservices, event-driven and file-based integrations including the data mappings and accounting rules behind purchase orders, receipts, invoices, payments, journals, and cash receipts.Oracle BI Publisher reports and data models supporting Finance reporting, reconciliations, integrations, and daily operations.Merger and acquisition support: assessing acquired companies’ finance systems and processes, then designing and executing their migration into Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP.Finding and eliminating manual work simplifying processes, automating what should be automated, strengthening financial controls, and driving adoption of native Oracle capability over custom workarounds.Functional testing through SIT, UAT, and regression, plus defect resolution, deployment, and post-production stabilization with solutions that hold up to audit, data integrity, and segregation-of-duties requirements.Oracle Fusion quarterly releases and upgrades from the functional side: impact assessment, regression testing, new-feature evaluation, and adoption planning. When production breaks, you drive root cause with Oracle Support and internal Engineering.Evaluation of emerging Oracle Fusion capabilities AI, automation, and agent-based features and bringing the ones that actually matter into Finance and Accounting processes.

What You’ll Need

3+ years working with enterprise ERP or financial systems in functional consulting, implementation, solution delivery, or support including 3+ years hands-on with Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials.Deep functional expertise across multiple Fusion Financials modules — Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, General Ledger, Cash Management, Cost Management, Fixed Assets — and a real command of how transactions flow from subledgers into the General Ledger.A track record of turning complex Finance and Accounting requirements into configurations, functional specifications, workflows, integrations, and reports that survive contact with production.Experience defining functional requirements and data mappings for integrations between Oracle ERP and upstream and downstream enterprise applications.Hands-on experience building and supporting Oracle BI Publisher reports and data models.Experience across ERP implementations, module rollouts, upgrades, or migrations, plus production support — troubleshooting functional and data issues and working service requests with Oracle Support.Command of testing methodology (functional, integration, regression, UAT) and the discipline to design for financial controls and auditability from the start, not as a retrofit.Strong communication across Finance, Accounting, business, and Engineering teams, and the ability to independently own a workstream from requirements through production in a fast-paced Agile environment.Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, Accounting, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent professional experience.

Bonus

Oracle Fusion Tax, Vertex, or other indirect tax engines integrated with Oracle Fusion ERP or enterprise commerce platforms. This one counts for a lot on our team.M&A ERP integrations, financial-system consolidations, or migrations from legacy ERP platforms onto Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP.REST APIs, FBDI, ADFdi, and other Oracle integration frameworks from a functional design perspective.OTBI, Financial Reporting Center, and the broader Oracle reporting and analytics stack.Finance automation work: three-way matching, reconciliation, cash application, landed cost, or complex accounting integrations.One or more Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials certifications.Retail, e-commerce, marketplace, supply chain, or other high-volume transaction environments.

Chewy is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, gender, citizenship, marital status, religion, age, disability, gender identity, results of genetic testing, veteran status, as well as any other legally-protected characteristic. rows.descriptionText:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

About The Team And The Role

We are currently seeking a highly driven and proactive Senior Product Manager to join our Conversion Programs team at eBay. In this critical role, you will be at the forefront of crafting customer experiences through offer communications. Your mission will be to drive business growth and customer improvements by innovating and enhancing the multi-channel communications portfolio across Email, Push Notifications, and Native Hub Notifications. You will chip in towards revenue targets, long-term strategy, roadmap, and end-to-end execution for this multimillion dollar portfolio! This is a highly cross functional role, where you will get to influence and collaborate with partners across eBay.

What You Will Accomplish

You will build and complete the roadmap with engineering, data science, and design teams. Be the champion of execution excellence. Proactively find opportunities to increase test velocity and facilitate collaboration with cross-functional teams.Identify and size opportunities for portfolio improvements: use data to advise forecast business impact for your ideas. Prioritize features / improvements based on various factors like business value, user needs, effort, etc.Author A/B tests: build hypotheses, design test setup, define KPIs. Implement tests and customer experience improvements.Create PRDs, convey requirements to the Engineering teams and jointly work through execution.Create and maintain project plans; handle dependencies and ensure execution readiness; continuously find opportunities to improve. Raise and help resolve project blockers; update Jira boards and supporting documentation. Measure results: assess performance against benchmarks, make recommendations for scaling decisions. Continuously capture insights: analyze customer feedback for product improvements; conduct market research and competitor analysis, monitor industry trends for opportunities to innovate.


What You Will Bring

5+ years of experience in product, growth marketing, business, or consulting roles with a strong focus on customer conversion and performance optimization; 2+ years of experience in e-commerce or marketplace environments. Marketplace experience is strongly preferred.Proven experience owning and optimizing performance-based lifecycle communications (email, push, in-app, or similar), including audience strategy, trigger logic, messaging, and measurement.Strong experimentation perspective — ability to design hypotheses, forecast impact, run A/B tests, interpret results, and translate findings into scalable improvements.Deep comfort with metrics and data: defining success metrics, monitoring funnel and health KPIs, diagnosing performance issues, and making data-informed tradeoffs between short-term gains and long-term customer value.Excellent product sense — ability to understand user intent, problems, and context, and partner with design and product to deliver simple, effective customer experiences.Demonstrated ability to lead complex, cross-functional initiatives end-to-end, working closely with Product, Engineering, Analytics, Design, and Operations in fast-paced environments.Highly organized, passionate about achieving results, and attentive to details; takes initiative and seeks continuous improvement. Able to find the most efficient way to build impact while maintaining high quality.Familiarity with CRM, marketing automation, or experimentation platforms, and the ability to work optimally with technical partners on requirements, data dependencies, and implementation.


Additional Details

The base pay range for this position is expected in the range below:

$160,800 - $214,700

About The Role

In the Merchandise Coordinator role, you will work closely with a very passionate and collaborative group of team members. The Merchandise Coordinator will provide support and coordination for the Associate Buyer and Sr. Buyer in specified merchandise categories for all channels of sales. We strive for operational excellence while developing best in class merchandising strategies each season.

 Own sample management – communicating and partnering with our photo and warehouse teams to track sample positions  Work in Merchandise Buyer systems to set up and maintain all SKUs  Enter and maintain all price/cost changes for relevant categories  Prepare reporting as directed and assist Assistant Buyers with business opportunities  Maintaining data accuracy and integrity

rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

About the Team

You will be a key member of the Supply Chain Product Management team responsible for improving how Williams-Sonoma, Inc. plans, forecasts, allocates, replenishes, and manages inventory across brands, channels, categories, and fulfillment nodes. The team partners closely with Merchandising, Inventory Management, Planning, Allocation, Replenishment, Supply Chain, Stores, eCommerce, Finance, Analytics, and Technology to deliver scalable product capabilities that improve business planning, inventory productivity, forecast accuracy, in-stock performance, operational efficiency, and customer experience.

About The Role

Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is in the business of enhancing the quality of our customers’ lives at home. This Principal Product Manager role will be focused on driving product strategy and execution across core inventory management and planning capabilities, including Merch Financial Planning, Demand Forecasting, Assortment Planning, Allocation, Replenishment, and Inventory Optimization.

This role will help define and deliver capabilities that improve how the business plans demand, builds assortments, manages inventory investments, allocates product, replenishes inventory, and responds to changing customer, channel, and supply chain conditions. The right candidate will bring deep retail planning and inventory management experience, strong product management discipline, and the ability to translate complex business processes into scalable technology-enabled products and capabilities.

This role requires a product leader who can operate across strategy and execution: framing business opportunities, shaping roadmaps, aligning stakeholders, defining product requirements, evaluating solution alternatives, partnering with engineering and analytics teams, and ensuring delivered capabilities create measurable business value. Product strategy should start with the business problem, desired outcomes, and required capabilities rather than a predetermined technology solution.

Responsibilities


 Own the product lifecycle for inventory management from ideation through adoption, continuously measuring business outcomes, incorporating customer and stakeholder feedback, and evolving the product roadmap to maximize business value.  Drive the adoption of AI, machine learning, automation, and decision-support capabilities to improve planning quality, accelerate product delivery, reduce manual effort, and enable smarter business decision making. Partner with Analytics and Engineering teams to identify, prioritize, and deliver high-value AI use cases across the Inventory Management domain.  Leverage generative AI and modern product management tools to improve product discovery, requirements development, backlog quality, documentation, and team productivity while championing responsible AI adoption across the product domain.  Lead end-to-end product discovery by partnering with business stakeholders to define strategy, prioritize opportunities, and translate business needs into product roadmaps, epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, and measurable outcomes.  Partner with Engineering, Architecture, Analytics, and Program Management to execute product roadmaps, manage tradeoffs and dependencies, and deliver high-quality capabilities through Agile delivery.  Lead product strategy across demand forecasting, assortment planning, merch financial planning, allocation, replenishment, and inventory optimization to improve forecast accuracy, inventory productivity, service levels, and financial performance.  Advance merch financial planning capabilities that improve visibility into inventory investments, sales, margin, receipts, turn, open-to-buy, and related financial planning metrics.  Drive allocation and replenishment capabilities that improve product placement, inventory availability, inventory productivity, sell-through, and customer fulfillment outcomes.  Identify and prioritize opportunities to reduce manual work, spreadsheet dependency, process fragmentation, and operational friction across planning and inventory workflows.  Partner with Analytics and Technology teams to deliver advanced forecasting, optimization, decision-support, and automation capabilities through the most appropriate combination of internally developed products, commercial Inventory Management packaged solutions, platform extensions, data products, and other technology approaches.  Define product success metrics and measurement plans tied to forecast accuracy, in-stock performance, inventory productivity, sell-through, margin, planning cycle time, adoption, exception reduction, and operational efficiency.  Provide clear recommendations on roadmap priorities, sequencing, tradeoffs, dependencies, risks, solution alternatives, and value realization to business partners and senior Technology leadership.  Support organizational change management for new planning and inventory capabilities, including stakeholder alignment, process documentation, training, UAT, readiness, hyper-care, and adoption tracking.  Establish and maintain strong product management practices and documentation across Jira, Confluence, and related product management tools to improve backlog quality, transparency, knowledge sharing, and team productivity.  Ensure product capabilities are designed with appropriate controls, data quality, role-based access, audit considerations, and operational governance.  Remain current with retail, supply chain, planning, forecasting, allocation, replenishment, AI, and inventory optimization trends, and apply relevant external practices to WSI’s product strategy. 


Criteria


 10+ years of related experience in Product Management, Inventory Management, Merch Financial Planning, Demand Forecasting, Assortment Planning, Allocation, Replenishment, Supply Chain, retail technology, or a related techno-functional discipline, with demonstrated experience delivering enterprise-scale planning, inventory, merchandising, or supply chain capabilities.  Deep understanding of retail planning and inventory management, including financial planning, demand forecasting, assortment planning, allocation, replenishment, inventory optimization, and exception management.  Strong product management discipline, with demonstrated ability to translate complex business processes and customer needs into product strategy, roadmaps, requirements, epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, and measurable outcomes; experience using Jira, Confluence, or similar product management tools.  Strong analytical and business orientation, with the ability to use data, business metrics, financial impact, and operational performance to shape product decisions, prioritize investments, and measure value realization.  Experience applying AI, machine learning, automation, optimization, or advanced analytics to improve planning, product management, operational efficiency, or customer outcomes, with the ability to identify and prioritize high-value AI-enabled capabilities.  Demonstrated experience modernizing fragmented or manual planning processes into scalable, governed, system-enabled capabilities, including the ability to evaluate build, buy, extend, partner, and retirement options based on business value, architecture, risk, cost, and speed to value.  Strong cross-functional leadership and influence, with the ability to partner effectively with senior business, Analytics, Engineering, Architecture, and Program Management stakeholders, lead through ambiguity, manage tradeoffs and dependencies, and drive alignment across a matrixed organization.  Experience in large-scale, multi-channel or omnichannel retail environments strongly preferred, including experience with internally developed products, commercial Inventory Management packaged solutions, or hybrid technology approaches. Relevant retail planning consulting experience is also desirable.  Strong communication and delivery discipline, with experience across Agile, Scrum, Lean, and/or waterfall delivery models and the ability to clearly communicate product strategy, priorities, risks, tradeoffs, and business outcomes to stakeholders at all levels.  Bachelor’s degree or more in Supply Chain, Business, Finance, Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Analytics, or a related field or equivalent work experience.  This role requires being onsite in the San Francisco CA office Monday through Thursday.  Some travel may be required to WSI corporate, store, distribution, care center, manufacturing, or supply chain locations within the United States.

rows.title: Senior Manager, Technology Risk - Audit and Assurance
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

About the Team

Our Internal Audit team plays a strategic role in helping the business navigate risk while enabling growth and innovation. Working across global operations with colleagues based throughout the U.S. and Singapore, we bring diverse perspectives and deep expertise to deliver independent assurance, practical insights, and meaningful improvements across technology, finance, operations, and compliance.

About The Role

Technology is transforming every aspect of our business—from cloud computing and AI to digital commerce and cybersecurity. As Senior Manager, Technology Risk - Audit and Assurance , you will play a critical role in providing independent assurance over the company's technology risks, governance, and control environment while helping strengthen confidence in how technology enables our business.

Reporting to the VP of SOX & Internal Audit, you will lead our Technology Risk & Assurance program, including oversight of our global IT SOX program and risk-based technology assurance activities across modern technology environments. This role combines deep technical expertise with sound business judgment to evaluate technology risks, assess the effectiveness of controls, and provide meaningful insights that support executive leadership and the Audit Committee of the Board of Directors.

More than a traditional audit role, this position offers the opportunity to influence how technology risk is understood and managed across the organization. You'll partner closely with Engineering, Information Security, Product, Enterprise Technology, Finance, and external auditors to provide independent perspectives that strengthen governance while supporting innovation and business objectives.

We're looking for a collaborative leader who is intellectually curious, energized by emerging technologies, and passionate about continuously improving how assurance is delivered through automation, data analytics, and AI-enabled capabilities.

Responsibilities

Lead Technology Risk & Assurance


 Lead the company's Technology Risk & Assurance program, including technology audits, technology risk assessments, and oversight of the global IT SOX program.  Develop and execute a risk-based assurance plan focused on areas including cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), cybersecurity, DevSecOps, CI/CD, enterprise applications, AI governance, data privacy, and emerging technologies.  Perform assessments executed in accordance with Internal Audit methodology and professional standards while delivering practical, risk-focused insights.  Oversee the scoping, rationalization and execution of efforts over the SOX ITGCs and ITACs supporting SOX compliance. 


Deliver Strategic Risk Insights


 Evaluate technology processes, risks, and controls to identify opportunities to strengthen governance, improve operational effectiveness, and reduce risk.  Provide independent, pragmatic recommendations that balance risk management with business objectives.  Monitor emerging technology, cybersecurity, regulatory, and AI-related risks and incorporate them into assurance activities.  Translate technical findings into clear business insights for executive leadership and the Audit Committee. 


Build Trusted Partnerships


 Develop strong relationships with leaders across Engineering, Information Security, Product, Enterprise Technology, Finance, and Compliance while maintaining Internal Audit's independence.  Serve as a trusted advisor by providing independent perspectives on technology initiatives, system implementations, cloud migrations, and process changes.  Coordinate effectively with external auditors and other assurance providers to optimize assurance coverage and reduce duplication of effort. 


Drive Innovation Within Internal Audit


 Advance the Technology Risk & Assurance function through automation, continuous monitoring, AI-enabled audit techniques, and data analytics.  Identify opportunities to improve audit quality, increase efficiency, and enhance risk coverage through innovative approaches and technology.  Champion continuous improvement initiatives that modernize Internal Audit's capabilities and ways of working. 


Develop Talent


 Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team, fostering an environment of collaboration, accountability, and continuous learning. 


Criteria


 9+ years of progressive experience in Technology Risk, Technology Assurance, IT Audit, Cyber Risk, or IT SOX, including experience leading complex technology assurance engagements. A combination of public accounting and industry experience is preferred.  Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical discipline; CISA, CISSP, CISM, CPA, or other relevant certifications are preferred.  Strong knowledge of SOX compliance, IT General Controls (ITGCs), IT Application Controls (ITACs), technology risk management, and industry frameworks including COBIT, NIST, and ISO 27001.  Experience assessing modern technology environments, including cloud platforms, cybersecurity, identity and access management.  Familiarity with AI governance, AI risk, and assurance considerations related to emerging technologies is highly desirable.  Excellent project management, organizational, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to prioritize multiple initiatives.  Exceptional communication and executive presentation skills, including experience presenting technology risk and assurance topics to senior leadership.  Demonstrated ability to think strategically while remaining hands-on in executing complex assurance engagements.  A collaborative leadership style, intellectual curiosity, sound judgment, and a passion for mentoring and developing others.  This role is based in The Colony office, with onsite collaboration Monday through Thursday and flexibility to work remotely on Fridays. 


Why Join Us

This is an opportunity to help shape the future of Technology Risk & Assurance within a dynamic, technology-driven organization.

You'll work closely with senior technology leaders while maintaining the independence necessary to provide objective assurance and meaningful risk insights to executive leadership and the Audit Committee. You'll help modernize how assurance is delivered through data analytics, automation, and AI while evaluating some of the company's most significant technology initiatives and emerging risks.

If you're energized by technology, passionate about continuous learning, and motivated by the opportunity to influence governance and risk at the highest levels of the organization, we'd love to hear from you.

Our Culture & Values 

We believe that taking care of our people is vital to our success and we strive to offer equitable and transparent practices for all. We prioritize connection, growth, and wellbeing.

People First 

Putting People First means investing in overall well-being and opportunities to grow and advance within the organization. Depending on the position and location, here are a few highlights of what benefits may be available:

Benefits


 A generous discount on all WSI brands  A 401(k) plan and other investment opportunities  Paid vacations, holidays, and time off to volunteer  Health benefits, dental and vision insurance, including same-sex domestic partner benefits  Tax-free commuter benefits  A wellness program that supports your physical, financial and emotional health 


Continued Learning


 In-person and online learning opportunities through WSI University  Cross-brand and cross-function career opportunities  Resources for self-development  Advisor (Mentor) program  Career development workshops, learning programs, and speaker series 


 WSI will not now or in the future commence an immigration case or "sponsor" an individual for this position (for example, H-1B or other employment-based immigration). 

 This role is not eligible for relocation assistance. 

About Us

Our Company

Founded in 1956, Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is the premier specialty retailer of high-quality products for the kitchen and home in the United States. Our family of brands are Williams Sonoma, Williams Sonoma Home, Pottery Barn, Pottery Barn Kids, Pottery Barn Teen, Rejuvenation, West Elm, Mark & Graham, Outward, and GreenRow. These brands are among the best known and most respected in the industry. We offer beautifully-designed, stylish and functional products for every area of the home, including the kitchen, living room, bedroom, home office, closet, laundry room and even outdoor spaces. We've seen some big changes since our first brick-and-mortar store opened more than half of a century ago. What hasn't changed is our passion for high-quality products, functional design, outstanding customer service, and enhancing the lives of our customers and the communities where we operate. Today, we're a multi-brand, multi-channel, global enterprise supported by state-of-the-art technology and some of the most talented teams in retailing - and we're always looking for new energy and ideas.

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

Sr. Product Manager - Technical, Offers CRM Communications

About The Team And Role

This role is part of eBay’s Buying Conversion team and will lead the Buyer and Seller Initiated Offers CRM Communications portfolio. You will serve as the portfolio lead across strategy, roadmap, experimentation, execution, and measurable business impact for customer-facing communications that help buyers and sellers move through offer-based shopping moments.

Offers are one of eBay’s most important marketplace conversion mechanics. These experiences span email, push notifications, in-app notifications, and emerging CRM channels.

In this highly visible role, you will develop how eBay delivers the right offer, right message, and right timing to customers while balancing conversion growth, customer relevance, marketplace health, and notification fatigue. You will collaborate closely with Engineering, Build, Analytics, CRM, Data Science, and cross-functional product teams across the customer experience to improve the intelligence, quality, and efficiency of offer communications.

This is a product role for someone who enjoys operating at the intersection of marketplace dynamics, customer psychology, lifecycle communications, experimentation, and technical systems. You will help define how Offers experiences should leverage customer intent, offer signals, personalization, trigger logic, contact strategy, recommendation inputs, and platform capabilities to drive better customer and business outcomes.

If you are passionate about marketplace negotiation, customer-centric growth, and performance optimization, this is an outstanding opportunity. You can help build communications that guide customers to confidently take the next best action and influence how eBay’s offer-based conversion experiences evolve.

What You Will Accomplish

Lead the Offers CRM Communications area, including vision, strategy, roadmap, experimentation, performance, and measurable business outcomes.Build and deliver customer-facing CRM experiences across email, push notifications, in-app notifications, hub, and future owned-channel surfaces. Our Opportunity:

This individual will also be responsible for collaborating with Learning and Legal teams to review loss prevention training and standard processes based on trends to ensure that all Chewy Asset Protection policies and processes remain compliant and current.

What You'll Do

Support the development and management of the Asset Protection Program (strategy, policy, and procedures) for Chewy’s Fulfillment Centers and Pharmacy. Partner with site leadership, human resources, and internal customers to ensure internal policies and procedures are developed, improved, and adhered to. Work with internal customers and Site leadership to develop physical security and loss-reduction strategies. Conduct ongoing risk assessments and outline corrective measures. Monitor and report statistical data relating to Chewy inventory comprehensive audits in compliance with Chewy and industry standards. Review and analyze activities and records to determine compliance with Chewy policies and SOPs. Support and monitor third-party security staffing standard work execution and findings.Initiate, conduct, and support confidential internal/external investigations involving company assets and Team Members. Assist with incident investigations; prepare investigation reports including recommendations on corrective and preventive actions; and monitor implementation. Ensure Fulfillment Centers and Pharmacy compliance with all laws and workplace standards. Participate as a member of the Fulfillment Management team in the planning, formulating, and implementing risk control strategies in line with the Fulfillment Centers’ missions and goals. Advise Site Environmental Health and Safety team on matters related to Physical Security and Loss Prevention. Detect, resolve, and mitigate situations involving team member theft, abuse, or unsafe acts involving company assets, policies, or procedures. Ensure that all physical security systems are operational (i.e., alarms, CCTV, etc.). Assist with developing and conducting facility and compliance program audits and inspections. 

What You'll Need

Bachelor's degree in related field (criminal justice, loss prevention and asset protection) or equivalent work experience or military service. 8+ years of loss prevention, asset protection, or law enforcement experience. 3 -5 years of experience in a role supporting fulfillment, distribution centers, manufacturing plants, and multiple stores focused on progressive Asset Protection and Audit roles or equivalent combination of experience and education. Proficiency and experience with data visualization and reporting tools such as Microsoft Office, Tableau, Service Now, or Smartsheet. Strong communication, partnership, analysis, judgment, and customer focus skills. Working knowledge of Wicklander – Zulawski Interview/Investigation techniques. Ability to train and empower associates and delegate tasks and duties to staff in a fast-paced fulfillment center environment. Excellent written, verbal and negotiation skills to effectively communicate with a diverse workforce. Effective people management, project management and time management skills. Ability to effectively problem solve by analyzing situations and applying creative and timely solutions. Change Management – Adaptable to a fast-paced, shifting work environment; willing to remain flexible to accommodate changing business conditions, work requirements, and customer scheduling needs. Detail Oriented – Attention to detail, ability to focus on the task, adherence to Company policies and requirements while consistently delivering error-free results. Demonstrate the ability to work independently and efficiently under pressure while handling challenging demands and tight deadlines. Experience leading changes in multiple site environments and implementing asset protection policies and procedures. Required to live within a commutable distance from the Fulfillment Center Must be willing to travel up to 40%.

Bring Your Amazing Self to Work

At Macy's, Inc. we're on a mission to create a brighter future with bold representation for all. This is our Mission Every One. We know that each person here is unique. So we respect and invest in each individual to create growth, pride, and satisfaction. If we are able to bring our whole selves to work, it translates into a more abundant and wider array of ideas and energy for all to benefit from. Our success will be built on amazing colleagues, working together.

Job Overview

The Staff, Vulnerability Engineer is a specialist in Penetration Testing and Information Security Vulnerability Management. This hands-on role involves conducting penetration tests and vulnerability assessments on complex applications, operating systems, and wired and wireless networks. In response to an ever-changing threat landscape, they establish a proactive program to assess Macy’s resilience against real-world tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs).

What You Will Do

Establish a risk-based approach for evaluating and prioritizing new and emerging threats.Stay current on emerging technology trends and the threat landscape, providing subject matter knowledge on specific adversarial threats and risks to assist with mitigation strategies.Design, coordinate, and lead simulations based on organizationally defined threat scenarios.Participate in reviewing and developing security strategies, best practices, policies, and procedures.Provide leadership, share knowledge, and mentor team members.Build working relationships with Macy’s TMRC, leadership, and third parties to identify top threats.Develop standard Rules of Engagement for real-time testing.Document detailed findings, analysis, and recommendations.

Skills You Will Need

AI & Machine Learning: Expertise in Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, Prompt Engineering, LangChain/LangGraph, anomaly detection, NLP, transformers, and security-focused ML solutions.

Security Engineering: Strong experience in detection engineering, threat hunting, SIEM/XDR/EDR, MITRE ATT&CK, Sigma, OCSF, threat intelligence, and enterprise security operations.

Cloud & Infrastructure: Advanced knowledge of AWS, Azure, GCP, Databricks, Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD, and scalable cloud-native security architectures.

Software Development: Strong programming skills in Python, SQL, JavaScript, C/C++, API development, automation, and distributed systems engineering.

Threat Protection: Experience protecting large enterprise environments through advanced analytics, behavioral detection, adversary simulation, and AI-powered security automation.

Research & Innovation: Proven track record of cybersecurity research, patents, publications, and development of innovative security technologies.

Leadership & Collaboration: Ability to lead cross-functional initiatives, influence architecture decisions, mentor engineers, and partner effectively across security and engineering organizations.

Communication: Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, with experience communicating technical concepts to executive and technical audiences.

Education/Certifications: PhD or Master's degree in a technical discipline preferred; AI, Cloud, or Cybersecurity certifications are a plus.

Experience: 10+ years of experience in software engineering, cybersecurity, AI/ML, or related fields with production-scale deployments.

Who You Are

This role involves performing essential job functions such as communication, collaboration, and use of office and computer systems. Responsibilities include the ability to access and review written and electronic information, and to move within the work environment and interact with workplace materials as needed to carry out job responsibilities.

What We Can Offer You

An inclusive, challenging, and refreshingly fun work environmentCompetitive pay and benefits rooted in principles of equityPerformance incentives and annual merit reviewMerchandise discountsHealth and Wellness Benefits across medical, dental, vision, and additional insuranceRetirement Savings Plan with 401k match opportunityEmployee Assistance Program (mental health counseling and legal/financial advice)Resources for continuous learning, career growth, and leadership development8 paid holidaysPaid Time Off (first year prorated depending on start date)Tuition reimbursement programColleague Resource Groups (CRGs) and give-back/volunteer opportunitiesEmpowerment and autonomy to perform impactful work with tangible results

About Macy’s

Now is an exciting time for a Macy's career as we continue to focus on creating exciting and memorable experiences for every Macy's customer, whether their journey starts online or in the store. Our opportunities in Sales, Merchandise, Operations, Customer Service, Warehouse, Marketing, and other areas let you express your creativity and commitment to excellence, grow your career and make a difference to your Macy's colleagues and customers.

Bring your creativity, energy, and ideas to the Macy's team – Apply Today!

rows.descriptionText:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

Sr. Product Manager - Technical, Offers CRM Communications

About The Team And Role

This role is part of eBay’s Buying Conversion team and will lead the Buyer and Seller Initiated Offers CRM Communications portfolio. You will serve as the portfolio lead across strategy, roadmap, experimentation, execution, and measurable business impact for customer-facing communications that help buyers and sellers move through offer-based shopping moments.

Offers are one of eBay’s most important marketplace conversion mechanics. These experiences span email, push notifications, in-app notifications, and emerging CRM channels.

In this highly visible role, you will develop how eBay delivers the right offer, right message, and right timing to customers while balancing conversion growth, customer relevance, marketplace health, and notification fatigue. You will collaborate closely with Engineering, Build, Analytics, CRM, Data Science, and cross-functional product teams across the customer experience to improve the intelligence, quality, and efficiency of offer communications.

This is a product role for someone who enjoys operating at the intersection of marketplace dynamics, customer psychology, lifecycle communications, experimentation, and technical systems. You will help define how Offers experiences should leverage customer intent, offer signals, personalization, trigger logic, contact strategy, recommendation inputs, and platform capabilities to drive better customer and business outcomes.

If you are passionate about marketplace negotiation, customer-centric growth, and performance optimization, this is an outstanding opportunity. You can help build communications that guide customers to confidently take the next best action and influence how eBay’s offer-based conversion experiences evolve.

What You Will Accomplish

Lead the Offers CRM Communications area, including vision, strategy, roadmap, experimentation, performance, and measurable business outcomes.Build and deliver customer-facing CRM experiences across email, push notifications, in-app notifications, hub, and future owned-channel surfaces. These experiences support buyers and sellers navigating promotions and deal-based shopping interactions.Lead roadmap planning and prioritization across multiple programs and features, balancing customer value, conversion impact, operational complexity, technical feasibility, marketplace dynamics, and long-term strategic value.Partner with Engineering, data analysis, insight generation, CRM, Build, and partner product teams to improve offer signal quality, trigger logic, audience eligibility, ranking, suppression, frequency capping, send-time optimization, channel orchestration, and measurement.Translate customer problems, marketplace opportunities, and portfolio priorities into clear product requirements, MVPs, experiments, and execution plans; create PRDs, manage dependencies, and drive execution from discovery to launch.Lead and mentor PM partners, helping them increase their impact, sharpen product judgment, and deliver high-quality outcomes across the Offers roadmap.


What You Will Bring

7–9 years of product management experience, including experience in technical product management, growth product management, lifecycle/CRM communications, marketplace products, personalization, conversion optimization, or user behavior-based trigger systems.Experience owning complex customer-facing product portfolios with measurable business outcomes, ideally in a marketplace, e-commerce, consumer technology, or large-scale digital platform environment.Proven experience building or optimizing lifecycle communications across email, push, in-app, hub, or similar owned channels, including audience strategy, trigger logic, messaging, experimentation, and measurement.Strong customer and product judgment, showing proficiency in grasping buyer and seller needs, customer fatigue, offer dynamics, urgency, marketplace incentives, and conversion trade-offs.Solid understanding of AI/ML-powered product systems, with the ability to partner effectively with Data Science, Analytics, Recommendations, and Engineering teams on signal quality, model or rules-based decisioning, inputs and outputs, performance measurement, and governance.A growth mindset and proven track record to lead complex cross-functional initiatives, communicate clearly with technical and non-technical partners, influence without authority, and turn ambiguity into actionable strategy and execution.


Location: Bellevue/Seattle, WA; San Jose, CA; or New York, NY

Additional Details

The base pay range for this position is expected in the range below:

$183,600 - $245,100

Base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including location, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a target bonus and restricted stock units (as applicable) in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits (including 401(k) eligibility and various paid time off benefits, such as PTO and parental leave). Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.

If hired, employees will be in an “at-will position” and the Company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors.

rows.title: VP, Customer Care and Credit Services
rows.descriptionText:
Be part of an amazing story.

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

The Vice President, Macy’s Customer Care & Credit Services is a transformational leader at the center of how Macy’s, Bloomingdale’s, and Bluemercury serve, understand, and engage millions of customers each year. This role is an opportunity to reimagine customer care as a powerful engine for service excellence, customer insight, and sales growth using AI, automation, analytics, and human-centered leadership to make every interaction more personal, productive, and connected. The ideal leader is energized by the possibilities of AI and emerging technologies and knows how to translate that excitement into practical strategies that improve the customer experience, empower colleagues, strengthen credit and care operations, and unlock new sources of enterprise value. Leading customer care, credit services, selling, collections, and strategic BPO partnerships, this executive will build high-performing teams, modernize capabilities, and create experiences that deepen loyalty, drive operational excellence, and advance Macy’s bold new chapter strategy.

This role will be based in Cincinnati and will require domestic and international travel.

What You Will Do

Develop and execute the vision and multi-year strategy for Customer Care, Credit Services, Selling, and BPO operations.Lead the transformation and modernization of customer service capabilities through AI, automation, analytics, digital self-service, and emerging technologies.Oversee customer care call centers, credit service, collections, selling, and issue resolution operations across Macy’s, Bloomingdale’s and Bluemercury.Provide strategic leadership and governance for BPO partnerships, ensuring operational excellence, service quality, cost efficiency, and alignment with customer experience goals.Foster a culture of hospitality, accountability, and continuous improvement to deliver exceptional customer and colleague experiences.Lead a large-scale customer engagement organization, ensuring achievement of customer, operational, financial, quality, compliance, and performance objectives.Build, develop, and inspire high-performing leadership teams while strengthening organizational capability, colleague engagement, succession planning, and talent development.Establish performance management disciplines, operating rhythms, and governance frameworks that drive execution, accountability, and measurable results.Optimize operating models, workforce strategies, business processes, and resource allocation to enhance efficiency, scalability, and service performance.Partner across Credit, Digital, Stores, Technology, Finance, HR, Legal, and external organizations to drive customer experience excellence, business transformation, and enterprise-wide operational strategy.Foster an environment of acceptance and respect that strengthens relationships, and ensures authentic connections with colleagues, customers, and communities. In addition to the essential duties mentioned above, other duties may be assigned.

Skills You Will Need

Executive Leadership: Proven success leading large-scale, complex customer organizations, driving performance through strategic vision, strong leadership, operational discipline, and a people-first approach.

Customer Experience Strategy: Demonstrated ability to define and execute customer experience and service transformation strategies that strengthen loyalty, engagement, and business performance.

Hospitality Mindset: Passion for creating customer and colleague experiences that are welcoming, seamless, and memorable, while fostering a culture of care, respect, and service excellence.

Enterprise Influence and Partnership: Proven ability to build trusted relationships, influence senior leaders, and drive alignment across functions, brands, business units, and external partners.

Operational Excellence: Deep expertise in customer care operations, credit services, collections, workforce management, quality assurance, compliance, and continuous improvement.

Technology & Innovation: Experience leading customer service modernization through AI, automation, digital self-service, analytics, and workforce optimization technologies.

Data-Driven Leadership: Strong analytical capabilities with the ability to translate customer, operational, financial, and colleague insights into strategic priorities and measurable business outcomes.

Talent & Culture Development: Track record of building high-performing organizations, developing future leaders, engagement, and leading teams through growth, transformation, and change.

Financial & BPO Leadership: Experience managing budgets, capital investments, business cases, and strategic BPO partnerships, with accountability for service delivery, operational performance, customer outcomes, and financial results.

Workforce Management & Resource Planning: Experience leveraging workforce planning strategies, scheduling optimization, forecasting, and capacity management to drive service performance and operational efficiency.

Center of Excellence (COE) Leadership: Experience partnering with Centers of Excellence to establish best practices, standardize processes, build organizational capability, and drive enterprise-wide continuous improvement.

Product & Business Acumen: Strong understanding of retail, credit, customer care, and service operations, with the ability to connect customer needs, business goals, and operational execution.

Who You Are

Candidates with a bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience in a related field are encouraged to apply. 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in customer care, customer experience, customer center operations, selling or related service-driven environments.A hospitality-centered executive who creates exceptional customer and colleague experiences while driving operational excellence, business performance, and sustainable growth.A transformational executive who inspires high-performing teams, develops talent, drives innovation, and turns strategy into measurable outcomes through collaboration, accountability, and disciplined execution.This role involves performing essential job functions such as communication, collaboration, and use of office and computer systems. Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Description & Requirements

Bloomberg Marketing partners with forward-looking business leaders to seize and create opportunities and to drive difference. We use data to understand markets and audiences, and creative ideas to build stories and brands. We create campaigns that capture attention and drive a reaction. We move fast, and our core approach is integrated and pioneering.

The Content Marketing Strategy team transforms Bloomberg’s market insights and research into compelling content that resonates with customers and prospects. We drive engagement at scale by connecting Bloomberg’s unmatched expertise to client priorities and broader business goals. Sitting within Business Marketing, our team focuses on turning market intelligence into meaningful impact. Our ambition is to redefine how we approach marketing—moving beyond promotion to find new ways to surface, package, and distribute Bloomberg’s research to the audiences who value it most.

The Opportunity 

We are seeking a Content Research & Activation Analyst to help Bloomberg maximize the reach and impact of our in-house research. In this role, you will combine content activation, audience analysis, and experimentation to connect the right research with the right audiences, channels, and moments.

You will help us better understand how clients consume Bloomberg research, what they use it for, and how content discovery is evolving in the age of AI, search, and ASKB. rows.title: Product Manager – Cross Asset Instrument Strategy
rows.descriptionText:
Location

London

Business Area

Product

Ref #

10052598

Description & Requirements

The Team

The Instruments, Pricing & Quant Analytics (IPQA) group is responsible for the foundational instrument management, data, pricing, risk and quantitative analytics capabilities that feed all of Bloomberg's products. We work across Bloomberg Terminal, Enterprise Data and Enterprise Products, ensuring consistency and interoperability across all of Bloomberg.

Within this organisation, the Instruments & Analytics Platform team delivers core instrument management, lifecycle and scalable analytics that support Bloomberg's cross-asset workflows.

What’s the Role?

We are looking for a senior product manager to lead Bloomberg's cross-asset instrument strategy, continuing to advance the unification of our instrument system across asset classes and producers. This is a pivotal role at the heart of IPQA's instrument strategy, sitting at the intersection of instrument strategy, cross-asset domain expertise and client engagement.

IMS (Instrument Management System) is Bloomberg's next-generation instrument management layer, built on advanced contract algebra and a unified interface that enables upstream systems to operate in a fully instrument-agnostic manner. As asset classes continue to adopt and extend this architecture, they unlock significant advantages, from automatic lifecycle management to richer analytics capabilities. This role is to partner with business owners across Fixed Income, Mortgages, Money Markets, Listed Markets, Derivatives and Private Markets to shape the integration approach that works best for each, delivering outcomes that serve both internal workflows and client needs.

Accelerating adoption across asset classes requires more than a compelling architecture. Bloomberg's approach is rooted in deep collaboration with business owners and clients, understanding what each team and their clients need and finding the migration path that delivers the most value for them. This role embodies that culture, combining conviction in where IMS can take us with the ability to bring each asset class team on the journey in the way that works best for them.

We’ll Trust You To

Own and evolve the cross-asset instrument strategy, coordinating priorities across asset classes and ensuring delivery is sustained across parallel workstreamsDrive the unification of instrument types within IMS, working with asset class teams across Fixed Income, Mortgages, Money Markets, Listed Markets, Derivatives and Private Markets to advise on approach, align on priorities and deliver resultsBuild and sustain strong relationships with producer teams inside and outside your immediate organisation, fostering alignment through clear communication, credibility and a relentless focus on outcomesAdvance instrument representation, lifecycle and data modelling capabilities across asset classes and in line with the broader product vision, in close partnership with engineering, quant, financial engineering and Data Management teams and in collaboration with sales and market specialist partnersCoordinate across product, engineering, financial engineering and business stakeholders to manage complex, multi-workstream initiatives end to end, holding teams accountable and maintaining delivery momentum with speed and clarityEngage directly with strategic buy-side and sell-side clients to present the instrument strategy vision, gather requirements and translate client insights into roadmap prioritiesStay ahead of market and regulatory developments that shape instrument data requirements, ensuring our instrument strategy remains at the forefront of client and market needs
